raw.title: DRG Appeals Writer
raw.excerpt: OverviewAt Piedmont Healthcare, you’ll love a shared purpose, be motivated to be your best, and be recognized for your contributions.
raw.description:
Overview

At Piedmont Healthcare, you’ll love a shared purpose, be motivated to be your best, and be recognized for your contributions. Piedmont Healthcare leaders are in your corner and invested in your success. Our wellness programs and comprehensive total benefits and rewards will meet your needs for today and help you plan for the future.

Responsibilities

The individual in this position on behalf of the entire Piedmont System will be responsible for managing the administrative appeal of reimbursement claims denied by Medicare or Medicaid on the grounds that the medical coding was incorrect. These duties involve coordination of activities with the managers of coding at each of the Piedmont affiliated hospitals and physician practices as well as the Senior Director of Government Appeals. The incumbent must maintain a high level of understanding of DRGs and MS/DRGs. ICD-9-CM Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, American Hospital Association Coding Clinic guidelines, federal guidelines for coding Medicare inpatient records, state guidelines for coding Medicaid records, Utilization Review ("UR") regulations and Medicare guidelines regarding medical necessity, inpatient, outpatient and observation. In the context of managing the appeals, the incumbent will be responsible for resolving differences of opinions among coders as to the most appropriate code.The incumbent will be responsible for preparing the coding appeals; performing a detailed review, analysis and extraction of clinical and coding information from patient medical records and drafting effective narratives for Medicare and Medicaid appeals briefs in support of denied cases throughout appeals at all levels of the government appeals process. In addition, the incumbent will be qualified and available to testify in appeal hearing before an administrative law judge as an expert in medical coding.

Qualifications

Education
  • Bachelor’s Degree Required
  • In Lieu of degree six (6) years of relevant work experience will be accepted in addition to the experience requirement Required or
  • Coding Certificate program (AHIMA accredited) Preferred
  • Master’s Degree Preferred
Work Experience
  • 5 years of inpatient coding experience and of DRG-MS/DRG auditing experience in a healthcare setting Required
  • Experienced medical record/DRG coder/auditor with a working knowledge of ICD-10 guidelines, case management, government and contracted payers Required
  • Must be experienced in clinical, coding and patient financial services software such as 3-M Encoder, SCM / Quest, STAR, EPIC, Client Tracking, and I-Suites Required
  • In lieu of degree (, a total of eleven (11) years of experience ) Required
  • Experience in coding at a multi-facility organization and remote coding experience is a plus Required
  • Previous experience writing DRG Appeals Preferred
  • Previous experience with RAC claims denials Preferred
Licenses and Certifications
  • One or more certifications
  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator Upon Hire Required or
  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician Upon Hire Required or
  • Health Services\CCS-Certified Coding Specialist Upon Hire Required or
  • CCA - Certified Coding Associate Upon Hire Required or
  • CCS-P - Certified Coding Specialist – Physician-based Upon Hire Required or
  • CPC-H - Certified Professional Coder - Hospital Outpatient/Facility Upon Hire Required or
  • CPC - Certified Professional Coder Upon Hire Required
  • Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC Preferred

raw.title: HR Director, Latin America Region
raw.excerpt: What We Can Achieve Together: As a hands-on team leader and comprehensive strategic Human Resources business partner, the HR Director will drive, implement, operationalize, and follow-through on all HR activities and relevant people initiatives across the Latin America Region (LAR).
raw.description:
What We Can Achieve Together:


As a hands-on team leader and comprehensive strategic Human Resources business partner, the HR Director will drive, implement, operationalize, and follow-through on all HR activities and relevant people initiatives across the Latin America Region (LAR). They will play a crucial role in understanding business needs and developing change and talent management strategies to achieve outcomes that meet TNC’s organizational goals in support of its mission. Reporting to the Managing Director HR Global Programs and partnering with the Regional Managing Director and senior Leaders, collaborating with colleagues across the People Team and other global regions, the HR Director ensures a consistent approach in applying HR policies and practices across the Region and organization. They lead a team of HR professionals to deliver comprehensive and robust HR services aligned with TNC’s vision for people and culture.

The ideal location for this position is in any country located within the Region, including Argentina, Belize, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guatemala, Mexico, and Peru. US-based applicants may be considered on a case-by-case basis yet will be limited to Miami, FL only. Other US locations will not be considered.

The HR Director is fully integrated into the LAR senior leadership team and provides proactive, strategic advice covering a range of complex issues from evolving program needs and alignment of new skills, to thoughtful management of potential conflicts. The HR Director must be agile, responsive and resourceful, working to find solutions to the myriad issues that arise. They are an integral part of the LAR Cultura Viva effort, a linchpin of work across the region that focuses on fostering an organizational culture of high performance, accountability and agency.


We're Looking For You:

  • Support a dedicated client base within the Region on a day to day basis as a hands on leader. (This is not a position for a leader who doesn't also participate in tactical work given the small team size.)
  • Proactively provide direct strategic advice and counsel and subject matter expertise to the LAR Managing Director and Leaders throughout the Region, including through participation in regional governance bodies such as the Regional Process Team (RPT).
  • Serve as a change agent, strategic HR business partner and resource to senior leadership and managers for all people and culture initiatives.
  • Lead and strengthen the Cultura Viva undertaking, building out a regional culture that values transparency and accountability and promotes agency.
  • Understand business needs and develop talent management strategies that support and advance organizational goals including managerial excellence for leaders.
  • Lead, manage and develop a team of HR professionals delivering comprehensive HR services and support across the full range of the employee life cycle from the tactical to strategic.
  • Ensure talent planning, succession planning, professional development, organizational design, and organizational development efforts are aligned with business needs and consistent with TNC’s overall strategic direction and approach.
  • Integrate, adapt, and contextualize global people strategies (talent, culture, inclusion, equity) to meet the unique needs of the LA Region. Ensure people strategies align with TNC’s effort to promote TNC Values and a culture of belonging.
  • Collaborate with the Global Talent Acquisition Team to build a highly performing diverse workforce; ensure access to effective recruitment support to attract and retain top talent.
  • Coach and develop the HR team to ensure a high level of service, team effectiveness, and alignment around HR strategy to include addressing employee relations matters with empathy and clarity and consistent with policy.
  • Help LAR leaders to model a culture of accountability, holding oneself and others accountable for their contributions.
  • Engage with Business Unit leaders and line managers to address complex employee relations issues and ensure compliance with TNC policies and relevant international employment laws;
  • Acts as the primary point of contact with the Employee Relations and Ethics and Compliance Teams.
  • Partner and collaborate with leadership, working teams and HR SMEs to foster a positive organizational culture, employee wellbeing, and drive change management initiatives.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 8 years related experience as a senior leader in Human Resources.
  • Professional experience must encompass an HR generalist role to include all of the following: talent management, employee relations, training and development, organizational development, and recruiting.
  • Excellent proficiency in English and Spanish is required and a working proficiency in Portuguese is helpful, but not required.
  • Experience in strategic talent management environment for a diverse, geographically dispersed, highly matrixed and multicultural international organization.
  • Direct experience working with international programs in the HR arena, particularly within Latin America.
  • Experience leading and managing a large team of HR professionals.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring senior leaders, professionals, and mid-level managers with all types of people management needs.
  • Experience as a facilitator and public presenter.
  • Experience in conflict resolution techniques.
  • Experience with leading projects and managing the work of others.
  • Experience using MS Office software with experience in constructing and producing reports, presentations, data manipulation, and analysis.
  • Ability to travel as needed both within the LA Region and internationally.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experience appreciated.
  • High degree of cultural agility and intelligence with a demonstrated ability to integrate and adapt global HR strategies to local contexts in a culturally competent way.
  • Between 10-15 years Senior level HR Generalist experience.
  • Advanced degree in Human Resources Management or related discipline.
  • SPHR, SHRM-SCP or equivalent professional certification or license as required by local labor law.
  • Strong experience influencing without authority.
  • Knowledge of Latin America labor laws.
  • Experience in Workday HRIS.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and strong client service orientation.
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal, with all levels of individuals.
  • Ability to negotiate and deal effectively, tactfully, and honestly.
  • A proven strategic thinker with sound technical skills, analytical ability, and good judgment.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of relevant conservation issues.
  • Proven ability to work in a fast paced, stressful, and highly visible environment.

*Please apply with an English CV. Thank you!

Salary Information:

This position may be based in any Latin American country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S.-based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $150,000 - $160,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate’s qualifications, specific skills, and experience.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

Keywords Studios is looking for an organised and proactive Associate Producer to support the delivery of high-quality game-development projects on time and within budget.

Working closely with the Producer or Lead Producer, you will help coordinate multidisciplinary development teams, maintain project schedules, track deliverables, facilitate communication, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect production.

This role is well suited to someone with early production or project-coordination experience who is looking to develop their career within the video game industry.

Only those with relevant work rights for Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines (Remote), or Singapore (on-site) will be considered. Sponsorship and relocation are not being offered as part of this package.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Producer or Lead Producer in the planning, coordination and delivery of the assigned development project.
  • Assist the team in delivering a high-quality product on time and within the agreed budget and scope.
  • Help organise, execute and monitor project activities across one or more areas of development.
  • Prepare, maintain and monitor development schedules, task boards, project documentation and production reports.
  • Track progress against agreed milestones and follow up with team members on outstanding tasks, dependencies and deliverables.
  • Facilitate and chair regular team or sub-team meetings, ensuring that actions and decisions are clearly documented and communicated.
  • Maintain effective communication between development disciplines, project leadership, clients and other business stakeholders.
  • Support the preparation, review and submission of milestone deliverables to clients and internal management.
  • Identify production risks, blockers and resource constraints, and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Help remove impediments affecting the development team and support the resolution of cross-discipline dependencies.
  • Work with team leads to establish clear priorities, goals and expectations.
  • Help monitor team capacity, workload and productivity, highlighting potential issues before they affect delivery.
  • Support the onboarding and integration of new team members.
  • Contribute to retrospectives, project reviews and continuous improvements to production processes.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within the relevant production and project-management tools.
  • Promote open communication, collaboration and a positive working environment across the team.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience in project coordination, production, project management or team coordination.
  • Previous experience supporting or coordinating a PC, console or live-operations game project is preferred.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Good working knowledge of productivity and project-management tools such as Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Jira, Hansoft, Confluence or Microsoft Project.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain schedules, task trackers, meeting notes, status reports and other production documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams across areas such as art, design, engineering, QA and audio.
  • Ability to identify potential risks, dependencies and problem areas and raise them with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Proactive, adaptable and able to work effectively in a fast-paced development environment.
  • Able to balance quality, scope, schedule, cost and team considerations when supporting production decisions.
  • Able to work independently while maintaining regular communication with project leadership.
  • A collaborative and supportive approach to working with team members and stakeholders.
  • An enthusiasm for video games and a good understanding of the PC and console gaming market.

Nice to Have:

Please let us know if you have experience in any of the following:

  • Scrum, Agile or other iterative project-management methodologies.
  • SAFe or another scaled Agile framework.
  • Live Operations or post-launch content delivery.
  • PC and console game development.
  • Console certification and submission processes.
  • Co-development or work-for-hire projects.
  • Working with distributed or international development teams.
  • Client-facing project coordination.
  • Supporting external development partners or vendors.
  • Relevant project-management training or certification.

Benefits

Our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) Commitment: Keywords Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, ethnicity, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. If you require any adjustments during the process please let us know in your application. We are committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation. We especially welcome applications from candidates of underrepresented groups in the industry.

PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION POLICY

raw.description:
Title: Senior Analyst, Digital Marketing Analytics

Location: Nashville, TN or Remote


Overview:

Asurion is seeking a curious, performance-driven Senior Analyst of Digital Marketing Analytics to join the team at our Nashville corporate office or remotely. This role sits in the marketing organization and will provide analytical/data support to digital growth initiatives led by the marketing and partner teams in a B2B2C sales model. You’ll own the analysis behind our digital marketing programs for some of our biggest partners: reading conversion funnels, spotting where they break, and recommending fixes across paid media, email, and web.


You'll work on a technically sophisticated team and partner closely with stakeholders to turn data into clear, compelling narratives that drive decisions. Success in this role requires data analytics expertise, creative problem-solving, strong communication skills, an ownership mindset, and demonstrated experience working with cross-functional teams.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for standard and ad-hoc reporting on performance of our digital marketing, organic, email, web properties and voice/chat channels
  • Analyze digital conversion funnels, identify where they break, and recommend improvements to growth marketing, paid media, and email teams
  • Support ad-hoc and exploratory analyses of key partner initiatives, tests, and emerging growth opportunities, helping to identify opportunities and provide data-driven recommendations
  • Produce succinct reports highlighting results and key insights of digital programs using a combination of business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI) and Excel
  • Help define KPIs and develop requirements for measurement planning, tagging, sourcing digital data across platforms, including web analytics, DSPs, websites/apps, etc.
  • Help evolve measurement and attribution approach, triangulating performance across client platform data and internal data sources
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and partner teams to ensure we can define and effectively measure customer and business success to effect positive change
  • Stay up to date with AI technology, effectively leveraging LLMs, automation, and alerting to improve productivity and enhance insights generation

What You’ll Bring to The Team:

  • 2-4 years of professional experience in marketing analytics, including digital funnel measurement and paid media performance
  • BA/BS in data analytics, information systems, internet technologies, marketing, business, or a related field preferred; relevant data/analytics certifications and/or equivalent hands-on experience will also be considered.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities with excellent attention to detail
  • Strong technical fluency in analytics tools and methods, primarily SQL, and experience with Python, R, or similar analytical tools.
  • Experience working with Amazon data through platforms such as Amazon Ads or Amazon Seller Central strongly preferred
  • Experience measuring digital funnel, cross channel attribution, and initiative performance via web analytics platforms (Google/Adobe Analytics), digital A/B testing experience preferred
  • Experience working with subscription model performance analytics preferred
  • Experience working with customer segmentation or audience data is a plus

Why Asurion?

Simply put, Asurion helps people stay connected. We are a privately held company which enables us to focus on long term customer and client value. We provide over 290 million consumers around the world with simple, intuitive technology advice to help them get the most from their devices; support to fix their issues and connectivity crisis, and device protection to ensure they receive a replacement or repair. When a product is missing or simply doesn't work properly, Asurion’s 17,000 employees are focused on solving the problem with people and processes operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week, speaking six languages, and working across any device, platform, or provider. By partnering with leading retailers, mobile carriers, and pay-tv providers, Asurion helps make customers lives a little easier and their technology a lot more amazing.

raw.description:
ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a consumer finance company that empowers people to achieve their goals through simple, transparent loans funded by trusted financial institutions. Through its proprietary lending platform, Hive, Happy Money delivers a fully digital experience that simplifies borrowing for consumers and helps credit unions, banks and asset managers diversify balance sheets and scale with confidence.

Happy Money’s end-to-end loan origination and participation programs provide partners with turnkey access to high-performing assets, underpinned by disciplined credit expertise and robust risk management. Together with its lending partners, Happy Money has originated more than $6.5 billion in loans to help nearly 350,000 people take greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com. View our Employee Privacy Policy here.

Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed company. Remote work doesn’t mean less work, we work full-time jobs and show up to them fully every day: Read more in our Happy Money Way overview.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Role: Hourly, Full-time
Main Work Shift: 8AM - 5PM PST / 11AM - 8PM EST (occasional weekends)
Training Work Shift: 9AM - 6PM EST (~6 weeks) Pay: $48,000 - $55,000 (annualized based on 40-hour work weeks)
Bonus: Eligible for up to $8,500 annually
Work Location: Fully Remote within U.S.A. but must be able to work Main Work Shift hours.
Visa Sponsorship: Not Available

Our Senior Loan Fulfillment Specialists are responsible for managing loan application workflows from submission to decisioning, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and compliance with internal and regulatory standards. The role requires proactive communication with applicants, collaboration with internal teams, and strict adherence to performance and quality standards.

This role plays a key part in shaping the Applicant experience. Loan Fulfillment Specialists are expected to bring professionalism and positivity to every interaction, ensuring our Applicants feel supported, understood, and confident throughout the process.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Responsibilities

  • Process applications as assigned.
  • Handle Applicant calls with care, accuracy, and urgency - demonstrating our core values of Love, Trust, and Hustle in every interaction to ensure applicants feel supported and informed.
  • Review, validate, and process critical documents such as proof of income and identification, to ensure compliance, authenticity, and accuracy prior to decisioning.
  • Daily follow-up outreach (phone call and email) to applicants whose applications are pending documentation or information to be approved.
  • Reviewing applications in their active pipelines that have received new documentation or other information provided by the applicant.
  • Follow-up on applications that have been escalated for Fraud Team review and have not been responded to within 24 hours.
  • Adhere to Genesys schedule for breaks, lunches and other assigned activities.
  • Maintain high levels of efficiency, quality, and speed while reviewing loan applications, ensuring deadlines and SLAs are consistently met without increasing risk exposure
  • Proactively identify potential risks, inconsistencies, or fraud indicators within applications and take appropriate action to mitigate exposure
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with fraud, BPO, and operations teams to ensure alignment on processes, procedures, and decisioning
  • Identify process gaps or inefficiencies and propose actionable solutions to improve workflow, scalability, and overall performance
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by sharing feedback, trends, and insights from day-to-day processing activities

Team Participation

  • Monitor and quickly respond to Slack updates and follow-up requests.
  • Attend Team Huddles, meetings and training as scheduled.

Training and Compliance

  • Complete all BVS training assignments as required by the Compliance Team.
  • Review QA scorecards and dispute findings as needed.

ABOUT YOU

  • 2+ years of experience working in a loan origination environment
  • Comfortable handling large application volumes while maintaining accuracy
  • Comfortable juggling application/case work with inbound phone calls
  • Strong attention to detail and time management.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Adaptability to changing priorities and process updates.
  • Team collaboration and accountability.
  • Problem solving and escalation judgment.
  • A positive, can-do mindset and curiosity about how your work impacts the Applicant journey

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Generous medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Eligible for quarterly bonus
  • 401k Plan with a matching contribution
  • Generous PTO including sick leave, vacation, volunteer, and more
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work
  • Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce
Base Salary Range
$48,000—$55,000 USD

raw.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PCMag, WRS Health delivers fully integrated, cloud-based EMR and practice management solutions. We support physicians through continuous enhancements to our products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

Job Purpose and Role

We are seeking a highly skilled AI/Data Architect to design and manage the data infrastructure that supports reporting, advanced analytics, and AI applications across WRS Health. This role will work closely with AI Engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to make healthcare data accessible, reliable, secure, and ready for use in machine learning and large language model (LLM) applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain scalable data architectures and pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and AI applications.

  • Define data models, storage strategies, and integration patterns for structured and unstructured healthcare data.

  • Build and maintain pipelines to collect, clean, transform, and validate data from clinical, financial, operational, and marketing systems.

  • Partner with AI Engineers to define data requirements and prepare datasets for model development, fine-tuning, and evaluation.

  • Design the data foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including document processing, embeddings, vector storage, and retrieval.

  • Establish shared data interfaces and APIs that enable AI Engineers to integrate LLM capabilities into EHR applications.

  • Manage data storage and retrieval for patient records, IoT, genomic, microbiome, and government datasets.

  • Support healthcare interoperability using FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, C-CDA, NCPDP, and X12 standards.

  • Design and manage AWS data and analytics infrastructure supporting QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Develop reports and dashboards that provide actionable insights across departments.

  • Establish data quality checks, lineage, versioning, and documentation so datasets and AI outputs can be traced to their sources.

  • Implement access controls and appropriate handling of sensitive healthcare data across analytics and AI workflows.

  • Collaborate with AI Engineers on MLOps and LLMOps requirements, including reproducible data pipelines, monitoring, and deployment integration.

  • Monitor and improve infrastructure reliability, retrieval performance, processing speed, and operating costs.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into technical specifications and maintain architecture documentation.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in data architecture and engineering, including infrastructure supporting AI or machine learning applications.

  • Strong expertise in data modeling, database design, and scalable data processing.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building data pipelines and API integrations.

  • Experience designing solutions using relational databases, data warehouses or data lakes, and vector databases.

  • Hands-on experience with data preparation for LLM applications, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation.

  • Understanding of how data quality, retrieval design, and source context affect LLM response accuracy and relevance.

  • Experience with AWS data and AI services, including familiarity with QuickSight, SageMaker, Bedrock, and Amazon Q.

  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices, including dataset versioning, evaluation datasets, and production monitoring.

  • Working knowledge of LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex to collaborate effectively with AI Engineers.

  • Understanding of data governance, privacy, security, and access controls for sensitive healthcare information.

  • Experience with FHIR, HL7, JSON, XML, X12, and healthcare data exchange is highly preferred.

  • Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

  • Healthcare industry experience and familiarity with HubSpot are a plus.

A Day in the Life

You’ll review pipeline health and data quality, collaborate with AI Engineers to prepare datasets and improve data retrieval, and build data models, integrations, and dashboards. Throughout the day, you’ll work with stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure the infrastructure supports reporting and AI application needs.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline reliability, data freshness, and data quality meet agreed targets.

  • AI Engineers receive validated, traceable datasets within agreed timelines.

  • Retrieval accuracy, response times, and infrastructure costs meet project targets.

  • Reporting and data automation reduce manual work and support stakeholder adoption.

If you are passionate about building the data foundation for practical healthcare AI solutions, we encourage you to apply.

Hours: Available during standard U.S. Eastern business hours (9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. or 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.)
Location: Remote | Full-time

Who we are:

At FRX Pennsylvania, exceptional cannabis begins with exceptional cultivation. As one of the largest Certified Kind cannabis cultivators in the United States, we are committed to growing cannabis with integrity, transparency, and an unwavering focus on quality. Because cannabis cannot be certified USDA Organic under current federal law, the Certified Kind program provides an independent, third-party verification modeled after internationally recognized organic standards. Through rigorous inspections and accountability, Certified Kind cultivators demonstrate their commitment to producing cannabis with respect for both people and the planet.

Everything we do starts with our living soil, which is an active ecosystem of beneficial bacteria, fungi, and other microorganisms that naturally cycle nutrients, support vigorous plant growth, and promote resilience. Rather than simply feeding the plant, we cultivate a thriving soil food web that allows each cultivar to fully express its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile while producing healthy, vibrant plants. By working with biological systems instead of relying on synthetic inputs, we produce cannabis that is true to its genetics and rich in the compounds that make every cultivar unique.

We proudly offer flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vaporizers, and edibles through our family of brands, including FRX, Anthos Organics, Common Citizen, Local Edibles, and Cannarocks. Every product reflects the same care, consistency, and attention to detail that goes into every harvest.

What we offer:

  • Compensation: $85,000-95,000
  • Health/Vision/Dental insurance coverage with HSA contribution plans
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Develop and execute initiatives to promote a culture that reflects HEART core values of Hard Work, Excellent Customer Service, (positive) Attitude, Respect, and Teamwork and build a culture that lives by the operating principals of Fast, Fresh, Full, Friendly, Fair, and Clean.

raw.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Commercial Finance
raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

Mozilla Finance partners with business units to drive strategic resource allocation and financial insight across our product portfolio. Our team of analysts supports revenue and cost ownership across Search, Advertising, Firefox, Marketing, and New Products.

We're adding a commercially-minded analyst will cover three areas: New Products (revenue and costs for B2B and SaaS-type initiatives), Ads revenue analysis in partnership with our Data Science team, and Marketing cost including labor and program spend reconciliation through close.

Beyond ownership of those areas, you'll contribute to the team's broader push to standardize how we plan and report. This role reports to the Senior Director, Finance and works alongside three senior analysts.

The right person has done commercial finance in a B2B environment, is comfortable working with data scientists, and doesn't wait to be asked before making something better.

What you'll do:
  • Own New Products financials: Maintain the forecast for New Products revenue and costs (labor + program spend). Validate inputs, reconcile actuals through close, and document drivers. Maintain position-level detail on how labor is forecasted and reported
  • B2B Financial Modelling. Once a B2B deal or New Products initiative is live, maintain an ongoing financial model, updating commercial assumptions as the business evolves. Keep operating view current as actuals come in and support with ad hoc scenarios as needed.
  • Support Ads revenue analysis. Partner with Data Science to conduct deep-dive research into Ads revenue trends, building the analytical frameworks and recurring views that help the business understand performance and pursue growth. Translate findings into clear insights.
  • Marketing cost reconciliation. Support reconciliation of Marketing program spend, coordinating with the Marketing cost lead to ensure accuracy through close and flagging issues before they compound.
  • Drive team standardization and reporting: Help build shared processes and templates so results can be presented as a unified view.
  • Be a reliable business partner. Field data and reporting questions, anticipate stakeholder needs, and communicate complex information in terms non-finance partners can use — escalating items that call for a broader partnership discussion.
  • Apply AI and automation to recurring work: Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort across forecast, close, and reporting cycles.
What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in commercial finance, B2B finance, FP&A, or a comparable analytical finance role, including hands-on work through a full budget and forecast cycle with close and variance analysis.
  • B2B commercial experience required. Familiarity with revenue modeling, deal economics, or partner, SaaS, or subscription revenue models in a B2B context.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced spreadsheet and financial modeling skills. You care about formula cleanliness, auditability, and accuracy.
  • Experience with enterprise planning tools (Pigment, Adaptive, Workday, etc.) and accounting systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Grounding in accounting fundamentals, including accruals and the monthly close cycle.
  • Comfort working with data science or analytics teams. Able to interpret analytical outputs, ask the right questions, and translate findings into financial terms.
  • Experience with revenue analysis or commercial modeling, including reconciling actuals to forecast in a multi-product or multi-channel environment.
  • Interest in applying AI, automation, and systems thinking to reduce manual effort in recurring finance work.
  • Ability to balance multiple competing priorities and cycle deadlines without loss of accuracy.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a variance, a revenue trend, or a forecast assumption clearly to a non-finance audience.
  • Experience building effective working relationships across functions. You know when to loop people in, can adjust how you present depending on who's in the room, and back your points with both numbers and context.
  • Ability to distill complex detail into structured summaries that business partners and senior stakeholders can act on.
  • Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and the drive to learn a new business quickly.
Nice to have:
  • Experience in B2B SaaS revenue analysis, digital advertising, and search monetization
  • Familiarity with revenue reconciliation or commercial reporting in a multi-product environment
  • Experience building automations or AI-assisted workflows within a Finance context, or the drive and resourcefulness to learn.
  • Experience with BI tools, SQL, Python, Power Query, or other data querying and programming languages.
Success Factors

You will likely be happy and productive in this role if you…

  • Possess an ownership mentality. You get things done accurately with minimal oversight, proactively flagging risks to timelines.
  • Have low ego and high flexibility. You approach problems with your opinion on the best solution, but can accommodate and adjust to differing viewpoints.
  • Are resourceful. You identify alternative solutions and resources to continue progress.
  • Learn new businesses fast. You ask the right questions, connect dots quickly, and build credibility with stakeholders through understanding what drives their results — not just the numbers.
  • See process gaps as opportunities. You spot inefficiencies and fix them without being asked. By the end of your first year, New Products is running on a clean forecast model, the team has at least one shared reporting process it didn't have before, and you've made the Ads revenue picture meaningfully clearer.
What you'll get:
  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly wellbeing stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

Project Manager - People & Talent

Are you an organized, detail-oriented project manager with a passion for people, talent acquisition and performance management? Do you enjoy building efficient recruitment processes, driving projects from start to finish, enhancing the candidate and employee experience, and helping people grow and do their best work? If so, Codekeeper offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

We’re looking for a proactive, hands-on and ownership-driven individual to drive recruitment, coordinate our performance management cycle, and manage people projects from inception to completion. You’ll play a key role in running goal-setting and review processes, supporting managers in giving meaningful feedback, and turning performance insights into development opportunities for our team. Along the way, you’ll refine processes, drive continuous improvement, and help us attract, develop, and retain top talent. The ideal candidate is eager to grow within the role, comfortable working cross-functionally, and ready to bring fresh ideas to strengthen our evolving HR practices.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit, so we encourage early applications.


Role Description

The Project Manager - People & Talent will be responsible for managing HR projects, systems, and procedures across Codekeeper. They will oversee recruitment activities, including sourcing, attracting, screening, interviewing, and assessing potential candidates, and onboarding new employees. They will also coordinate the performance management cycle, including goal-setting, performance reviews, and feedback processes, and work with managers to support employee development, recognize strong performance, and address performance concerns constructively. Each of these areas is run as a project: you’ll plan the work, set deadlines, keep stakeholders aligned, and see it through to completion.


Key Responsibilities

Recruiting

  • Source, post, and optimize job openings on various platforms
  • Design and manage application and screening processes according to company policies
  • Expand recruitment reach and improve candidate engagement

Screening & Interviewing

  • Collaborate with department managers to define role requirements
  • Conduct initial screening calls and evaluate candidates based on established criteria

Offer Management

  • Present job offers to successful candidates, detailing position terms, remuneration, and benefits

Performance Management

  • Coordinate performance management processes, including goal-setting, reviews, and feedback
  • Support managers and employees throughout the performance cycle
  • Help identify development needs and support employee growth

Project Management ​​​​​

  • Plan and lead people projects from inception to completion, setting realistic deadlines and monitoring progress
  • Act as the bridge between HR, team leads, and department heads, ensuring a clear flow of information
  • Identify obstacles early and find practical solutions to keep projects moving
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects across the company

Process Optimization​

  • Explore new platforms, tools, and strategies to enhance recruitment and performance processes
  • Document procedures and workflows in the relevant HR folders

HR Management

  • Develop, structure, and document HR procedures aligned with company policies
  • Manage onboarding processes to ensure a seamless transition for new hires

Employee Relations

  • Organize three online team gatherings and one offline team event per year to foster engagement and a strong company culture


About the Company

Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.


What We Offer

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues
  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth
  • Regular team activities and gatherings
  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period
  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback
  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference


Skills We Are Looking For

  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal
  • Ability to adapt and multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and strategic thinking skills
  • Proficiency in contemporary web tools such as Zapier, Linear, and Google Docs

Required Experience

  • Professional Experience: A minimum of 1–2 years in a similar HR, recruitment, or people-focused project role
  • Background in recruitment, with experience in screening, interviewing, and assessing candidates
  • Experience in performance coaching, training and development
  • Experience managing projects or leading process improvements, in HR or another field

Additional Info

  • Job Location: Remote
  • Join us to shape the future of software escrow!

How To Apply

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us.

raw.description:
Role Summary

Alpha Lion is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to be the performance engine behind our paid and organic visibility on Amazon and Walmart. You'll own the marketing levers available on the marketplace — PPC campaigns, listing conversion, deals and promotions, and alignment with our DTC campaigns — and make sure every dollar of ad spend is tracked, tested, and optimized with precision. Your work will drive efficient, scalable growth and profitable revenue across our marketplace channels.

Responsibilities

  • Build, launch, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns on Amazon and Walmart to hit target ACOS, TACOS, and ROAS goals.
  • Use automation tools (such as Scale Insights) and bulk file operations to manage bids, rules, and keyword changes efficiently across the full catalog.
  • Run search term analysis, negative keyword mining, and keyword harvesting to sharpen targeting and cut wasted spend.
  • Improve listing conversion and organic ranking through structured A/B tests, content updates, and keyword strategy, working closely with our creative team.
  • Plan and execute deals, coupons, and promotions, keeping them in sync with DTC launches and hero product pushes.
  • Deliver weekly performance reports and post-event recaps that come with insights and recommendations, not just numbers.
  • Help build out Walmart advertising, applying what works on Amazon while adapting to the differences between platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently hit or beat ACOS and TACOS targets while growing ad-attributed revenue quarter over quarter.
  • You run a self-sustaining PPC system, with automation handling the routine so you can focus on strategic improvements.
  • Your structured testing lifts conversion rates and improves organic rank on hero products without a proportional increase in ad spend.
  • Promotions go live on time and perform at or above forecasted lift.

Who You Are:

  • You have an extreme eye for detail. You catch keyword cannibalization, bid errors, and budget pacing issues before they hurt performance.
  • You think in systems: you document what works, build templates, and create repeatable processes.
  • You treat PPC as a business lever, not a task list, and connect every ad decision to revenue, margin, and brand outcomes.
  • You take ownership. When a metric trends the wrong way, you flag it and come with solutions, and you meet every deadline without reminders.
  • You play to win. You're not satisfied with "running ads" — you want to outperform the category and beat competitors.
  • You communicate proactively, sharing trends, risks, and wins without being asked

Experience & Skills:

  • 2–4 years of hands-on Amazon PPC management, with direct ownership of ad budgets and performance targets.
  • Proven experience with an ad automation tool (Scale Insights, Pacvue, Quartile, or Perpetua) for automation rules, bid management, and bulk optimizations.
  • Strong command of the Amazon Advertising console and Amazon CRO: A/B testing with Manage Your Experiments, keyword research (Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar), and listing optimization.
  • Experience planning and running Amazon promotions: lightning deals, coupons, best deals, and Prime Exclusive Discounts.
  • Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets, and a clear understanding of TACOS and contribution margin and how ad spend connects to profitability.

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing PPC for supplement, health and wellness, or CPG brands on Amazon (regulated categories a plus), ideally on high-revenue accounts in a DTC environment.
  • Exposure to Walmart Connect, and an Amazon Ads certification.

Why Alpha Lion:

Alpha Lion is a fast-growing, performance-driven brand focused on helping people unleash their Superhuman potential. We are building scalable systems, raising the bar on execution, and creating long-term competitive advantage in our category.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, learn rapidly, and grow alongside a company that values ownership, curiosity, and results. If you’re excited by optimization, experimentation, and building systems that scale, Alpha Lion is a place where your work will matter.

Application Process

  • Apply: Submit your resume + a brief note explaining why you’d crush it in this role.
  • Screen: TA team reviews for skills and cultural alignment.
  • Cultural + Behavioral: In this step, you will take a personality assessment to see how you will perform in the role, then review it on a call with a cultural specialist here.
  • Interview: Conversations with the hiring manager and team.
  • Final Round: Case study or work simulation (role-specific).
  • Decision & Offer: We move fast — typically within 2–4 weeks.

Compensation:

We believe in competing at a high level — and that includes how we approach pay. This is a remote-first role, open to candidates anywhere in the U.S.

The expected base salary range for this position is 2.000-2,500(USD).

Your offer will reflect your experience, skill set, and where you live — we calibrate pay to ensure fairness and alignment with local markets.

Beyond base pay, team members may be eligible for performance bonuses, growth incentives, and benefits built to support their health, wellness, and professional goals.

raw.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Engagement Manager, PS Sales focused on Germany, you will play a critical role in driving GitLab’s growth in the region by structuring services engagements that create true partnership and shared success with our customers. You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives. In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.

Some examples of our projects

  • Designing and structuring outcome-based professional services engagements that align GitLab capabilities to customers needs
  • Partnering with account executives, solutions architects, and delivery leaders to turn complex DevSecOps transformations into clear, actionable implementation roadmaps and statements of work

What you'll do

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, and technical leaders
  • Conduct discovery sessions with with prospects and Systems Integrators to understand current-state capabilities, requirements and desired business outcomes
  • Design outcome-oriented services proposals that align GitLab capabilities with customer success metrics and objectives
  • Structure engagements and commercial proposals to clear outcomes maintaining flexibility for staff augmentation and packaged offerings when needed
  • Develop custom-scoped SOWs and staffing plans for complex implementations, engaging with technical architects and delivery leadership to ensure deliverability
  • Articulate GitLab's services value proposition, catalog offerings, and implementation methodologies in the context of customer requirements
  • Gain agreement on scope and price while guiding customers through commercial terms, procurement processes, and contracting structures
  • Manage project- and account-level escalations, ensuring rapid resolution and maintaining customer confidence
  • Position consulting, training, success tiers, and additional solutions proactively to ensure successful outcomes and long-term customer retention
  • Facilitate solutioning sessions including implementation roadmapping, enterprise strategy discussions, and executive-level requirements gathering
  • Drive measurable outcomes by structuring services that support customer success metrics, accurately forecasting services bookings, and tracking key performance indicators related to bookings, margin, and attachment to strategic opportunities.
  • Own the engagement lifecycle from initial discovery and pre-sales solutioning through scoping, SOW development, staffing alignment, and transition to delivery, ensuring engagements are deliverable, clearly defined, and outcome-oriented.
  • Influence cross-functional teams by articulating GitLab’s professional services value proposition in the context of federal requirements and compliance frameworks, and by feeding customer insights back into sales, delivery, and practice management.
  • Partner with regional sales and engagement leadership to prioritize and manage services opportunities that support critical deals and strategic initiatives, providing clear recommendations on risk management, negotiation strategies, and commercial structures.
  • Foster a culture of enablement and continuous improvement by training field teams on how to position and sell professional services by sharing trends, feedback, and suggestions that improve go-to-market content and operational processes.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated progressive experience structuring, scoping, and selling professional services engagements in the region
  • Proven success operating in a pre-sales context, conducting discovery, designing outcome-oriented proposals, and developing custom statements of work (SOWs) and staffing plans for large, complex implementation projects.
  • Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps practices, and cloud transformation initiatives, with the ability to connect technical solutions to mission objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills with executive presence, able to build trusted advisor relationships with division chiefs, program managers, contracting stakeholders, and senior technical leaders.
  • Highly developed facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to guide customers through acquisition processes, commercial structures, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with sales, solutions architecture, delivery, and operations teams to align on deal strategy, staffing, and successful execution in a fast-paced environment.
  • Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote setting, managing multiple complex opportunities while maintaining accurate forecasting and consistent alignment with GitLab values and goals.

The Professional Services Engagement Management team at GitLab is dedicated to designing and structuring services engagements that set our customers up for successful, long-term adoption of our DevSecOps platform. We build and manage strategic relationships with customers to understand their goals, surface their services needs, and translate complex transformation initiatives into clear, outcome-oriented engagement plans. Composed of experienced services, consulting, and delivery professionals distributed across multiple regions, we operate asynchronously to support field teams, shape implementation strategies, and guide customers through their services journey. We focus on creating scalable engagement models, fostering open communication with internal stakeholders, and adapting our services offerings to the evolving needs of a rapidly maturing organization and its customers. For more on how our team works, see the Professional Services Engagement Management handbook page.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.
