raw.description:
Category: Technology

Location: Bahçelievler Bahçelievler Turkey


About Zella Technologies

Zella Technologies is a Managed Services Provider (MSP), VoIP Provider, and Fiber Internet Service Provider (ISP) delivering cutting-edge technology solutions to businesses. Our services include managed IT support, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, VoIP systems, cloud platforms, and fiber internet connectivity.

We support a wide range of business technology environments and pride ourselves on delivering reliable solutions, responsive technical support, and exceptional customer service.

We are expanding our team and looking for an experienced, dependable, and hands-on Support & Systems Engineer (Level 2 / Level 3) to support our customers, technical operations, and infrastructure.

Position Overview

This is a remote, hands-on engineering position combining advanced technical support, systems administration, network and telecommunications troubleshooting, cloud and identity management, infrastructure projects, and technical leadership.

The engineer will independently own and resolve Level 2 and Level 3 support tickets, investigate complex technical problems, lead assigned infrastructure and cloud migrations, maintain service quality, and help improve support operations.

This role requires strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, networking, VoIP, cybersecurity, automation, virtualization, cloud platforms, and identity systems.

The ideal candidate has substantial hands-on experience supporting business technology environments, can work independently, communicates effectively with customers and internal teams, and takes ownership of technical issues through resolution.

Because Zella supports customers and infrastructure across multiple locations, this position requires the ability to coordinate working hours with U.S.-based operations, participate in scheduled meetings, and support an assigned on-call rotation.

This is not a traditional Level 1 help desk position. The engineer is expected to investigate complex issues, make sound technical decisions, execute approved infrastructure changes, and contribute to the reliability and improvement of customer environments.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Independently own, troubleshoot, and resolve escalated Level 2 and Level 3 support tickets across customer environments.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting for Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems.
  • Administer and troubleshoot Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPOs), Organizational Units (OUs), DNS, DHCP, and hybrid Active Directory configurations.
  • Diagnose complex system issues involving operating systems, applications, services, hardware, storage, authentication, and network connectivity.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of recurring technical problems and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking issues involving firewalls, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, DHCP, DNS, switching, and routing.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot MikroTik, Juniper, and other enterprise networking equipment.
  • Diagnose and resolve VoIP issues involving SIP, PBX systems, Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, Kazoo, QoS, and network connectivity.
  • Perform packet capture and traffic analysis using tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and MikroTik Torch.
  • Troubleshoot Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, and identity management platforms including Okta and Zero Trust access solutions.
  • Investigate complex or recurring incidents and coordinate with vendors, carriers, customers, and internal teams as necessary.
  • Escalate issues requiring specialized expertise while maintaining ownership of communication, documentation, and follow-through.

Systems Administration, Virtualization & Infrastructure

  • Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux systems across customer and internal infrastructure.
  • Monitor and investigate system performance, operating system events, resource utilization, services, and infrastructure health.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot virtualized and hyper-converged environments, including Hyper-V, VMware, StarWind, TrueNAS Scale, and Proxmox.
  • Diagnose issues involving virtual machines, hypervisors, virtual networking, storage, replication, and related infrastructure components.
  • Perform approved system maintenance, patching, upgrades, configuration changes, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Identify infrastructure risks, capacity limitations, recurring failures, and opportunities for improved reliability.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure changes using documented procedures, appropriate testing, and rollback strategies.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation of systems, configurations, dependencies, and changes.

Cloud, Identity & Microsoft 365 Administration

  • Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and related services.
  • Support Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, hybrid identity environments, MFA, Conditional Access, and identity management platforms.
  • Diagnose authentication, synchronization, licensing, mail flow, permissions, and device management issues.
  • Configure and maintain approved identity, access management, and Zero Trust security controls.
  • Assist with cloud platform administration, infrastructure deployment, performance troubleshooting, and optimization.
  • Identify and implement approved improvements to cloud configurations, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.

VoIP, Telecommunications & Network Services

  • Troubleshoot customer VoIP services, SIP trunks, hosted PBX systems, and related telecommunications infrastructure.
  • Diagnose SIP signaling, registration, call routing, call quality, one-way audio, RTP, NAT, firewall, and QoS issues.
  • Investigate service interruptions and connectivity issues involving customer networks, internet services, and telecommunications providers.
  • Analyze packet captures, system logs, and service diagnostics to identify the source of voice and network problems.
  • Support troubleshooting and maintenance of enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and network connectivity services.
  • Coordinate with carriers, vendors, and senior engineering resources when resolving complex service incidents.
  • Assist with approved network and telecommunications deployments, configuration changes, upgrades, and migrations.

Monitoring, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Monitor and investigate escalated alerts from remote monitoring and management (RMM), network monitoring, backup, and infrastructure monitoring systems.
  • Diagnose server, endpoint, network, security, and infrastructure alerts and implement appropriate remediation.
  • Investigate recurring alerts and system issues to identify underlying causes and reduce unnecessary operational noise.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot backup and disaster recovery solutions, including Veeam and other supported platforms.
  • Investigate backup failures, repository issues, backup infrastructure problems, and recovery-related incidents.
  • Perform and validate approved backup restorations and recovery testing.
  • Assist with developing, maintaining, and executing disaster recovery procedures.
  • Validate the recoverability of protected systems and escalate issues affecting backup integrity or recovery readiness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, backup reliability, and system availability.

Cybersecurity & Incident Response

  • Implement and maintain approved security hardening, endpoint protection, MFA, Zero Trust, and compliance best practices.
  • Troubleshoot endpoint detection and response (EDR), antivirus, access control, and other managed security solutions.
  • Investigate suspicious activity, security alerts, authentication anomalies, and potential cybersecurity incidents.
  • Assist with security incident identification, containment, remediation, recovery, and documentation according to established procedures.
  • Review relevant system logs, security alerts, and technical evidence to determine incident scope and appropriate next steps.
  • Apply approved security configurations, patches, and remediation procedures.
  • Recognize security risks associated with system changes and follow appropriate change management and authorization procedures.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and specialized security resources when advanced investigation or escalation is required.

Migrations, Projects & Systems Engineering

  • Plan and execute cloud, infrastructure, and identity migrations, including Google Workspace to Microsoft 365, Active Directory to Entra ID, and hybrid identity environments.
  • Perform migrations involving Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, user accounts, authentication, and related business systems.
  • Serve as the technical owner for assigned infrastructure and cloud migration projects from discovery through completion.
  • Define project scope, technical requirements, timelines, risks, dependencies, and success criteria.
  • Build detailed project plans including milestones, dependencies, rollback strategies, and validation steps.
  • Perform discovery and assess existing infrastructure, applications, configurations, integrations, and customer requirements.
  • Execute migrations with minimal downtime and clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with customers before, during, and after migrations to establish expectations and provide progress updates.
  • Perform post-migration validation, troubleshooting, documentation, and optimization.
  • Ensure completed projects include accurate documentation, configuration records, and operational handoff.
  • Identify and communicate technical risks, unexpected dependencies, or project blockers requiring escalation.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Automate repetitive tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, and other appropriate tools.
  • Develop, troubleshoot, and maintain scripts used for administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify inefficient or repetitive support processes and recommend improvements.
  • Implement approved automation to reduce manual work, improve consistency, and minimize human error.
  • Follow company security, testing, change management, and documentation requirements when implementing automation.
  • Collaborate with other technical team members to improve service delivery and operational workflows.

Documentation, SOPs & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain and improve technical documentation within ITGlue, Hudu, Confluence, and internal Wiki systems.
  • Create and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer infrastructure, network configurations, systems, credentials references, and service dependencies using approved documentation platforms.
  • Meet established weekly documentation expectations to ensure systems, processes, configurations, and resolutions are consistently documented.
  • Document troubleshooting findings, root causes, corrective actions, system changes, migrations, and recovery procedures.
  • Ensure documentation is clear, accurate, current, and usable by other technical team members.
  • Identify documentation gaps and contribute to improvements in technical processes and knowledge sharing.

SLA, KPIs & Support Operations

  • Ensure assigned tickets and technical work meet established service level agreements (SLAs), response times, and resolution expectations.
  • Track and maintain performance against applicable KPIs related to support, migrations, documentation, and service delivery.
  • Prioritize work based on urgency, business impact, customer requirements, and operational commitments.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, work logs, time entries, customer communications, and resolution details.
  • Communicate ticket status, technical findings, service interruptions, and expected next steps to customers and internal teams.
  • Coordinate complex incidents, escalations, and technical activities with other engineers and support staff.
  • Identify recurring service issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve response and resolution performance.
  • Contribute to support process improvements, consistent service delivery, and operational reporting.

Technical Leadership & Team Collaboration

  • Provide technical guidance and escalation assistance to Level 1 technicians and other support team members.
  • Assist junior technicians with troubleshooting techniques, diagnostics, documentation, and technical development.
  • Share technical knowledge and contribute to internal training and knowledge transfer.
  • Help improve escalation procedures, support workflows, and overall technical service quality.
  • Collaborate with engineering, support, management, and other internal teams on technical incidents and projects.
  • Demonstrate accountability, sound technical judgment, professionalism, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Support the improvement of technical operations without requiring formal people-management responsibilities.

Remote Work, Customer Communication & On-Call Responsibilities

  • Work remotely while maintaining reliable communication and availability during assigned working hours.
  • Coordinate working schedules, customer meetings, and technical activities with Zella's U.S.-based operations.
  • Participate in an assigned on-call rotation for nights, weekends, and critical support incidents as required.
  • Respond to assigned after-hours incidents according to established response, escalation, and communication procedures.
  • Maintain a reliable, secure, and professional remote working environment.
  • Follow company security policies for remote access, customer data, authentication, and use of company systems.
  • Attend virtual meetings, project discussions, technical reviews, and customer calls as needed.
  • Travel occasionally to customer locations, data centers, or other designated locations when required and authorized.
  • Maintain clear, professional, and timely communication with customers and internal team members.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an engineer who takes ownership of technical problems, thinks critically, and can independently work through complex issues.

The right candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting Windows and Linux systems, investigating network and VoIP problems, planning migrations, and working across different customer environments.

We especially value individuals who:

  • Take ownership: Follow through on technical issues and projects until resolution or documented handoff.
  • Troubleshoot methodically: Use evidence, diagnostics, and logical investigation rather than guessing.
  • Work independently: Manage responsibilities effectively in a remote environment.
  • Communicate clearly: Explain technical issues, project progress, and service impacts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Think proactively: Identify recurring problems, infrastructure risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Document consistently: Produce accurate, useful technical records and troubleshooting documentation.
  • Understand risk: Follow authorization, security, testing, and change management requirements.
  • Support the team: Share knowledge, help junior technicians, and collaborate across departments.
  • Continue learning: Adapt to new technologies, products, systems, and technical challenges.
  • Put customers first: Maintain professional relationships, clear communication, and a strong commitment to service quality.

Why Join Zella Technologies?

At Zella Technologies, you'll work across a broad range of business and enterprise technologies in an environment that combines managed IT, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, networking, and cybersecurity.

Unlike positions limited to supporting a single platform or internal IT environment, this role offers exposure to diverse customers, infrastructure, services, and technical challenges.

You'll have opportunities to take ownership of complex support incidents, participate in infrastructure and cloud migration projects, contribute to technical improvements, and work alongside other experienced engineers.

If you enjoy solving challenging technical problems, working with modern infrastructure, improving systems, and helping businesses succeed, we encourage you to apply.

Join Zella Technologies and help deliver reliable managed IT, networking, telecommunications, and cloud solutions to businesses.


Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience providing Level 2 and/or Level 3 technical support in an MSP, ISP, enterprise IT, or similar business technology environment.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across Windows, Windows Server, Linux, and common business applications.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, user permissions, and Windows domain environments.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID, and identity management technologies.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and firewall technologies.
  • Ability to investigate complex network connectivity and performance issues using appropriate diagnostic tools.
  • Experience administering or troubleshooting virtualized environments such as Hyper-V, VMware, or Proxmox.
  • Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery solutions, including troubleshooting backup failures and performing restorations.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including endpoint protection, MFA, access controls, security hardening, and incident response procedures.
  • Ability to troubleshoot Linux systems using SSH, command-line utilities, system logs, and service management tools.
  • Experience troubleshooting technical incidents independently and determining when escalation or additional assistance is required.
  • Ability to perform root-cause analysis and recommend or implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Familiarity with remote monitoring and management (RMM), ticketing, and technical documentation platforms.
  • Understanding of SLAs, incident priorities, change management, and professional IT service delivery practices.
  • Ability to create and maintain accurate technical documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting records.
  • Experience with technical project execution, infrastructure changes, system upgrades, or migrations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English for interactions with customers and internal teams.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining accountability, responsiveness, and consistent communication.
  • Ability to coordinate working hours with U.S.-based operations and participate in scheduled meetings and on-call rotations.
  • Reliable internet connectivity and an appropriate environment for secure remote work.
  • Ability to follow established security policies, change management procedures, and customer data protection requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of relevant experience in managed IT services, systems engineering, network administration, or advanced technical support.
  • Experience working for an MSP or supporting multiple independent customer environments.
  • Advanced Windows Server administration, Active Directory, hybrid identity, and Group Policy troubleshooting.
  • Linux administration experience with Ubuntu, Debian, Rocky Linux, or similar distributions.
  • Experience administering Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID, and Intune.
  • Experience with Conditional Access, hybrid identity synchronization, Zero Trust technologies, and identity management solutions such as Okta.
  • Hands-on experience with MikroTik, Juniper, and other enterprise routers, switches, and firewalls.
  • Experience troubleshooting advanced networking issues involving BGP, OSPF, complex routing, VPNs, and multi-site connectivity.
  • Experience with network analysis and troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, and MikroTik Torch.
  • Experience troubleshooting SIP, RTP, VoIP, PBX systems, Asterisk, FreePBX, 3CX, Kazoo, and related telecommunications services.
  • Experience with session border controllers (SBCs), SIP trunks, call routing, QoS, and VoIP call-quality troubleshooting.
  • Experience administering and troubleshooting Hyper-V, VMware, Proxmox, StarWind, and TrueNAS Scale environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Veeam backup and disaster recovery solutions, including restoration testing and recovery procedures.
  • Familiarity with NinjaOne, Auvik, Hudu, ITGlue, Confluence, or similar monitoring and documentation platforms.
  • Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR), security monitoring, incident investigation, and security remediation.
  • Experience planning and executing Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations.
  • Experience with Active Directory to Entra ID migrations and hybrid identity implementations.
  • Experience developing automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Experience managing infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations, or other technical projects from planning through completion.
  • Experience mentoring junior technicians, assisting with escalations, or providing technical leadership.
  • Familiarity with IT service management practices, SLA reporting, KPIs, and operational process improvement.

Certifications (Preferred but Not Required)

  • CompTIA Network+ or Security+
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate or related Microsoft certifications
  • Microsoft 365 or Microsoft Entra certifications
  • Cisco CCNA or Juniper JNCIA
  • VMware, Proxmox, or other virtualization-related certifications
  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE) or related backup certifications
  • Relevant cybersecurity, networking, Linux, or cloud certifications

Candidates who demonstrate strong hands-on engineering experience, advanced troubleshooting skills, and the ability to independently resolve complex technical issues are encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet every preferred qualification or hold specific certifications.

Remote Work & Availability Requirements

  • Ability to work full-time in a remote position.
  • Ability to coordinate working hours with Zella Technologies' U.S.-based operations.
  • Availability for scheduled customer meetings, project activities, and internal collaboration.
  • Participation in an assigned on-call rotation for after-hours, weekend, and critical incidents.
  • Reliable internet connectivity and a professional remote working environment.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and follow company security requirements when accessing customer infrastructure and systems.
  • Occasional travel may be required based on operational or project needs.

raw.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Enterprise Change Manager supports the delivery of RSM’s Enterprise Change Management strategy and federated change management model by providing change management expertise across priority initiatives and helping strengthen visibility, consistency, readiness, and adoption across the firm.


The role partners with initiative sponsors, project and product teams, business leaders, change practitioners, and other stakeholders to assess change impacts, develop and execute change strategies, identify risks and dependencies, and support successful adoption and sustainment.


Working across lines of business and functions, the Enterprise Change Manager brings an enterprise perspective to assigned work by identifying connections between initiatives, stakeholder impacts, competing change demands, and opportunities for coordination. The role also supports the continued development of enterprise change management practices, tools, insights, and capabilities.

Responsibilities

Change Management Delivery

  • Independently lead change management activities for assigned enterprise and priority initiatives.
  • Assess the scope, complexity, stakeholder impact, readiness, and change management needs of assigned initiatives and recommend an appropriate change approach.
  • Develop and execute fit-for-purpose change management strategies and plans aligned with the Enterprise Change Management framework and tiered support model.
  • Create and maintain change deliverables including stakeholder assessments, change impact analyses, readiness assessments, communications plans, learning and enablement plans, sponsor activities, resistance management approaches, and adoption plans.
  • Integrate change management activities with project, product, communications, learning, technology, and implementation plans.
  • Monitor progress against change plans and adjust activities based on business needs, stakeholder feedback, readiness, and emerging risks.

Stakeholder and Leadership Enablement

  • Build effective relationships with sponsors, project leaders, business leaders, change practitioners, and impacted stakeholders.
  • Provide practical change management guidance and recommendations to initiative and business leaders.
  • Support sponsors and people leaders in understanding and carrying out their role in leading change.
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussions, workshops, readiness conversations, impact assessments, and other change-related sessions.
  • Translate complex project, process, technology, and organizational information into clear implications for impacted audiences.
  • Gather stakeholder feedback and help project teams translate findings into appropriate actions.

Enterprise Change Visibility

  • Support visibility into significant change occurring across lines of business and functions.
  • Gather and maintain information related to initiative timing, impacted populations, change magnitude, readiness, dependencies, and other relevant change indicators.
  • Analyze assigned initiatives and portfolio information to identify potential stakeholder overlap, competing changes, sequencing concerns, change saturation, and dependencies.
  • Surface patterns, emerging risks, or cross-enterprise impacts to Enterprise Change Management leadership.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations that support enterprise change planning and decision-making.

Federated Change Management Support

  • Partner with change practitioners embedded within lines of business and functions to promote alignment and connectivity across the federated model.
  • Apply and reinforce enterprise change management standards, tools, methods, and practices.
  • Support business-aligned change practitioners with tools, guidance, coaching, and enterprise context as appropriate.
  • Identify initiatives or issues that may require broader Enterprise Change Management involvement and escalate them to Enterprise Change Management leadership.
  • Share lessons learned, reusable assets, and effective practices across the enterprise change community.

Readiness, Adoption and Sustainment

  • Assess stakeholder and organizational readiness for assigned changes.
  • Identify adoption risks, resistance, capability gaps, and other barriers that could affect implementation success.
  • Develop and implement interventions to address identified readiness and adoption concerns.
  • Establish appropriate measures for readiness, adoption, and sustainment in partnership with initiative teams.
  • Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback to evaluate how change is being experienced and adopted.
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on adoption and readiness data.
  • Support the transition of changes from project or product teams into ongoing business operations.

Change Capability Building

  • Support the development and delivery of change management tools, resources, learning experiences, communities of practice, and leader enablement activities.
  • Coach project teams, business partners, and change practitioners on effective change management practices.
  • Help increase change management capability across the firm by making tools and practices practical, accessible, and scalable.
  • Contribute insights and recommendations that improve Enterprise Change Management methods and ways of working.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to simplify and improve change management processes, tools, and deliverables.
  • Leverage AI, technology, data, and automation to improve change analysis, communications, stakeholder insights, reporting, and delivery efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging change management practices and apply relevant approaches to assigned work.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of the Enterprise Change Management capability.

People Development

  • Support the development of less-experienced change practitioners through coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • May serve as a Performance Advisor, including regular feedback, coaching, goal setting, and development with assigned advisees.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; business, organizational development, human resources, communications, technology, psychology, or related discipline preferred.
  • Minimum five years of experience supporting or leading change management for organizational, technology, process, operating model, or transformation initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop and execute change management plans for moderately to highly complex initiatives.
  • Experience working with business leaders, project teams, managers, and employees across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Working knowledge of change management disciplines including stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, learning and enablement, readiness, resistance management, adoption, and sustainment.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation, communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively across organizational boundaries.
  • Ability to analyze complex information, identify patterns and risks, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed environment.
  • Strong judgment, business acumen, curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Experience using data, stakeholder feedback, and other insights to inform change management decisions.
  • Professional services, public accounting, consulting, or other complex matrixed organization experience preferred.
  • Change management certification such as Prosci, CCMP, or equivalent preferred.

Ready to make a difference?

To support our growth, we are seeking candidates with an interest in utility energy efficiency programs and knowledge of energy-efficient technologies associated with commercial building systems.

As an Associate Operations Specialist, you will play a crucial role in supporting the efficient and effective management of energy and environmental programs and projects. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities for process improvements, sharing best practices, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and conducting thorough analyses of program operations.

Why you will love working here:

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan

raw.description:
This is an individual contributor role with a primary focus on administering U.S. health & welfare programs and leaves of absence processes. This individual will work closely with Human Resources and Payroll to drive consistency and compliance in all benefit and leave-related matters.

Working with the Benefits leader, you will analyze current and proposed benefits programs for alignment with Enviri’s Total Rewards philosophy, market competitiveness, compliance with applicable regulatory and legislative requirements and for cost effectiveness.

You will be the primary liaison for employees in all divisions and corporate personnel, including the HR team, regarding escalated member issues (eligibility, coverage, claims, etc.). You'll work with vendor partners to ensure resolution of eligibility and claim issues, prepare accounting as needed for vendor remittance and reconcile employee contributions and partner with Payroll, HRIS and division HR teams to ensure smooth operation of plans and value-added employee experience.

This position will review and administer leave requests, including but not limited to Short- and Long-Term Disability, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Parental Bonding Leave. You will provide assistance to and partner with vendor management, employees, human resources and business operations, develop and maintain various leave administration databases and spreadsheets, and track compliance and generate reports as requested.

This position may assist with and/or lead special projects as directed, and may prepare communication materials and conduct employee meetings/orientations for division HR teams as needed.

This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in the U.S. and able to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

US Health & Welfare and LOA

  • Administer U.S. health & welfare programs and leave of absence processes across multiple vendors and systems, ensuring consistent application and operational continuity.
  • Manage end-to-end leave administration (FMLA, state leave, disability, workers’ compensation, paid parental), including case tracking, documentation, and employment status coordination.
  • First line contact with employees related to health & welfare benefits, leave and other benefits related questions.
  • Assist with the management of the U.S. Wellness program including biometric screenings, immunizations, health assessments and more.
  • Audit and monitor employee leave accrual banks and provide corrections and adjustments to Payroll.
  • Assist with the process for preparing, communicating, and tracking benefits related matters for collective bargaining agreements.
  • Prepare written employee communications, plan employee communication meetings and presentations.
  • Support Benefits Team and division HR Team on benefit-related matters and transactions that require intervention and interpretation. Ascertain appropriate resources and assist in resolution.
  • Communicate with employees, retirees, dependents and beneficiaries regarding eligibility, coverage, and other benefits matters.

Benefit, Payroll & Vendor Administration

  • Oversee benefits eligibility, enrollment, and payroll reconciliation.
  • Responsible for benefits invoicing processes.
  • Serve as primary operational liaison for external vendors supporting benefits and leave.
  • Assist with annual benefits open enrollment: coordinate internal and external resources to ensure system updates, communications, and all materials are accurately and timely distributed.
  • Support proxy-related reporting requirements.

Benefit Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ACA, ERISA, CMS, PCORI and other related regulatory reporting requirements, supporting audit readiness across benefits and leave programs.
  • Maintain data integrity through reconciliation, reporting, and resolution of discrepancies across benefits, leave, payroll, and carrier systems.
  • Gather information for and assist with the Americans with Disabilities (ADA) Accommodation processes as needed.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Five or more years of progressive experience administering employee health and wellness benefit plans and leave administration.
    • Leave Administration regulations and processes with emphasis on FMLA administration and multi-state paid leave laws.
    • Benefit experience in large, public company to include self-insured/self-funded plans.
    • Experience with stoploss insurance, ERISA, HIPAA, ACA, and other legislative and compliance requirements.
    • Familiarity with retirement plans and collective bargaining agreements.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication, organizational and analytical skills.
  • Ability to interact effectively with employees at all levels
  • Ability to maintain confidential information at all times.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions
  • Ability to manage numerous initiatives to meet deadlines and to deliver high-quality outputs including the ability to re-order work and priorities.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret benefit plan documents, general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Ability to write benefit communications, reports, business correspondence, and procedure documents in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from plan participants including active employees and retirees, as well as their dependents/beneficiaries and our vendor partners.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts to correct payroll deductions, invoices, and claims costs.
  • Ability to solve problems and partner effectively with internal and external teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with annual plan audits and 5500 preparation and filings.
  • Experience in developing SPDs, Plan Documents, WPDs, etc.
  • Experience with high-deductible medical plans with HSA/HRA a plus.
  • Experience with defined benefit pension and defined contribution retirement plans a plus.

raw.description:
Hello! We are Cashea 👋 and our mission is to give Venezuelans back the opportunity to access credit through a BNPL business model. Since our launch in 2022, we have been dedicated to promoting financial inclusion. Today we have more than 9 million active users, both consumers and merchants, and we have become a trusted brand in Venezuela, winning hearts and minds.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer who builds the platform the rest of engineering relies on. You’ll own our Infrastructure-as-Code on Google Cloud Platform: the modules, wrappers, networking, and pipelines that let dozens of teams ship services safely across our domains.

This is hands-on building. We run everything on GCP with OpenTofu and Terragrunt, a layered and versioned IaC platform of reusable modules and opinionated wrappers, consumed by a live repo that defines what runs in dev, staging, and production. You’ll design that platform, extend it as we grow, and answer for how it behaves when teams use it. The engineers who grow fastest here go deep, codify sensible defaults, and leave the platform safer and easier to use than they found it.

Overall you will…

  • Design and build reusable IaC modules and wrappers in OpenTofu (Terraform) and Terragrunt, with sensible, governed defaults.

  • Design least-privilege IAM with service accounts, Workload Identity, and keyless auth, so least privilege is the default for every workload.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD for infrastructure with GitHub Actions, Workload Identity Federation, plan-on-PR and apply-on-comment flows, and policy and security checks (TFLint, Trivy).

  • Make architectural and system-design decisions across our multi-environment, multi-region setup (us-east1 with us-west1 for DR), and own the trade-offs behind them.

  • Mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, leaving the team stronger than you found it.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of cloud and infrastructure engineering experience, with strong hands-on depth in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

  • Production experience with Terraform or OpenTofu, and ideally Terragrunt, building reusable and versioned infrastructure rather than only consuming it.

  • Solid grasp of GCP networking: VPCs (ideally Shared VPC), subnets, Cloud NAT, DNS, firewall policies, and private connectivity (PSA/PSC).

  • Strong IAM fundamentals: least privilege, service accounts, and Workload Identity or federation.

  • Experience operating managed GCP services such as Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL), and Memorystore Redis.

  • Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), and treating infrastructure changes with the same rigor as application code.

  • A track record of making architectural calls and owning infrastructure end-to-end in a fast-moving context.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, and to mentor others effectively.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking, with genuine curiosity about new technology.

Desirable skills

  • Experience with GKE specifics such as private and regional clusters, Workload Identity, Dataplane V2, and managed Prometheus.

  • Familiarity with data and messaging services: Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, BigQuery, Datastream (CDC), and Cloud Composer (Airflow).

  • Experience with API platforms such as Apigee, plus Artifact Registry and Cloud Build.

  • Secrets management with GCP Secret Manager.

  • Scripting in Bash or Python for operational tooling and automation.

  • Experience building in fintech, payments, or credit.

  • Spanish and English proficiency.

Why you'll love working at Cashe

At Cashea, we have a work culture based on trust and purpose. If you need a clue as to why we are a good choice, these are our core values:

  • Ability to work with incomplete or biased data and make reasonable assumptions to estimate business impact
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to solve complex problems using data processing tools

Company

team.blue is an ecosystem of 60+ successful PaaS and SaaS brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.5 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Position

As Head of Security (CISO), SaaS, you will lead security for team.blue's SaaS division. You will report to the Group CISO or Senior Director of Technology, SaaS and work in close partnership with the the other party, overseeing security across 16 SaaS brands in four clusters today, with more joining through acquisitions.

You will define and drive a consistent security strategy and framework across the division, ensuring that security standards are established, monitored and continuously improved.

Working closely with brand security leads, CTOs, the SaaS tech function and group security, you will combine strategic oversight, reporting and stakeholder management with hands-on involvement in security assessments, architecture reviews, tooling and incident escalations.

Responsibilities

Security leadership and collaboration

  • Connects and leads brand security leads through shared standards, regular 1-1s and a cross-brand security forum, acting as the link between the brands, SaaS technology and group security.

  • Represents SaaS in the group security and technology leadership teams, ensuring delivery of agreed central security services.

Reporting and assurance

  • Owns SaaS security reporting, KPI monitoring and the exception register, escalating critical vulnerabilities, deviations and overdue remediation where needed.

  • Develops data and telemetry capabilities to strengthen evidence-based security assurance across the brands.

Maturity, tooling and assessments

  • Defines secure development lifecycle best practices, leads annual security maturity assessments and tracks improvements.

  • Drives adoption of group security tooling (application security testing, EDR, bug bounty and leaked-credential monitoring), ensuring critical findings are remediated within agreed timelines.

Architecture and advisory

  • Advises on complex architecture and design matters, emerging threats, technologies and security trade-offs, supporting brands with specialist security expertise.

Architecture and advisory

  • Advises on complex architecture and design matters, emerging threats, technologies and security trade-offs, supporting brands with specialist security expertise.

ISMS and compliance

  • Establishes a SaaS-wide ISMS baseline based on group policies and standards, supporting brands with ISO 27001, ISAE 3000 and SOC 2 certifications and coordinating regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, CRA).

Risk management

  • Manages the SaaS security risk framework, consolidates brand risk assessments and reports on risk treatment to group security.

Incident response and resilience

  • Coordinates incident response between the group incident response team and brand technology teams, ensuring appropriate escalation and follow-up.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in information security, including 5+ in a senior leadership role (CISO, Head of Security or equivalent).

  • Technical background. Understands software engineering, cloud and DevSecOps well enough to be hands-on.

  • Has managed an ISMS that was ISO 27001 certified.

  • Proven record of leading without line authority, getting decisions carried through with CTOs and leadership teams.

  • Experience reporting security posture and risk to executives, boards or investors.

  • Uses AI in their own security work and understands AI-specific security risk.

  • Fluent English. Comfortable working across European markets.

Nice to have

  • Software or SaaS background.

  • Has led security across multiple entities in a federated or group structure.

  • Working knowledge of NIS2, GDPR, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), SOC 2 and ISAE 3000.

  • Security due diligence and PMI experience in M&A.

  • Has led incident response cases.

  • CISSP, CISM, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor.

  • Hands-on with application security testing, vulnerability management and pentest or bug bounty programmes.

  • A second European language.

Personal qualities

  • Clear communicator who adapts to engineers, CTOs and executives.

  • Pragmatic and risk-based rather than checklist-driven.

  • Holds a position under pressure and escalates early.

Right to Work

At any stage, please be prepared to provide proof of eligibility to work in the country you’re applying for. Unfortunately, we are unable to support relocation packages or sponsorship visas.

raw.description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager(s) to lead complex transformation and business change initiatives that deliver measurable impact across our organisation.

Everywhen is one of the UK's leading commercial insurance businesses and part of the global Ardonagh Group. As we accelerate our transformation journey, we're investing in the people, technology and wider capabilities that will help us deliver at pace to build a simpler, smarter and more digitally enabled business.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Project Manager, you'll lead the delivery of often complex transformation projects, programmes and business change initiatives that have a significant impact across our business.

Working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you'll be responsible for shaping, planning and delivering projects that span people, processes, technology and operations. You'll ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and achieve the intended business/financial outcomes while maintaining strong governance and stakeholder engagement throughout.

What you will do as a Senior Project Manager:

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of often complex projects, many of which are technology enabled

  • Shaping the business case in close collaboration with key stakeholders

  • Managing scope, governance, budgets, risks and dependencies

  • Driving stakeholder engagement across all levels of the business

  • Coordinating cross-functional teams and third-party suppliers

  • Delivering sustainable change, adoption and measurable business benefits

  • Securing measurable benefits in line with the project charter and business case

What we are looking for in a Senior Project Manager:

  • Proven experience delivering complex transformation and change projects within the insurance sector

  • Strong programme and project management expertise across the full lifecycle

  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Executive-level engagement.

  • Effective workshop facilitation and meeting management skills

  • Experience working with technology partners and suppliers

  • A commercial mindset, with a focus on outcomes, benefits and value delivery

  • Track record of delivering financial impacts to the bottom line underpinned by solid base performance measures

  • Experience of translating business strategy and vision into well designed solutions and specifications that can be delivered right first time

  • Strong organisational, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Experience leading organisational change, process redesign and business readiness activities to ensure effective landing and adoption of change in the front line

  • Experience with digital and AI-enabled transformation programmes would be advantageous.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping the future of a major UK insurance business. You'll work on strategic, high-impact initiatives, collaborate with senior leaders and build your career within Everywhen and the wider Ardonagh Group. Make an impact. Drive meaningful change. Help shape what's next.

In return you will be welcomed and supported by our Ardonagh family and be joining an organisation that cares about you as a person and your wellbeing. Some of the other benefits are:

  • Holiday entitlement of 26 days plus bank holidays

  • Opportunity to progress your career across the entire Ardonagh family

  • Award-winning learning & development offering and support to obtain professional qualifications to enhance your knowledge and career prospects

  • Pension scheme for when you feel it’s time to retire

  • 24-hour Employee Assistance support for you and your family’s physical and mental wellbeing

  • Corporate perks such as discounted gym memberships, cinema tickets, shopping, Eyecare vouchers, cycle to work and much more

  • One day paid volunteering to give back to our communities

  • Ardonagh Community Trust (ACT) - raising funds for charity with donation matching in your local community

  • The Spotlight Awards, where we celebrate the best of the Ardonagh Group and all the bright talent across our business.

We offer genuine potential for both personal and professional development, come and be part of our story and help us shape our future.

So, what are you waiting for? Apply today and one of our team will be in touch.

#AIB INDX3

Everywhen is an equal opportunities employer, with a growing and thriving diversity, equity and inclusion strategy; we are committed to a working environment that is free from discrimination, is inclusive, and empowers our people to bring their whole self to work and reach their full potential.

If your application is successful, we will conduct relevant employment checks prior to you commencing employment with us. These will include verifying your recent employment, address, credit history and a standard criminal record check.

As an Everywhen colleague, you will be expected to uphold our values, act professionally and respectfully towards others, and contribute to a workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We expect all colleagues to help maintain an environment free from bullying, harassment, victimisation and other inappropriate behaviours, supporting our commitment to an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Please note: We may close a vacancy prior to the publish end date if the required quality or number of applications has been received.

Note to recruiters and employment agencies:We will not pay for unsolicited CVs from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have requested assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

raw.description:
Sumsubis the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.4 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

We are looking for aSenior Product GTM Lead, AML & TMto drive the global scale, strategy, and market dominance of our AML & TM solutions.

In this role, you will act as the primary strategic and commercial authority for our AML & TM product ecosystem globally. You will own the overarching Go-To-Market strategy, shape high-value enterprise partnerships, and work directly with executive leadership to expand our global footprint. If you have a decade of hands-on expertise navigating complex AML & TM environments, regulatory frameworks, and enterprise sales, we want to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Global GTM Leadership & Strategy:Architect, refine, and execute the end-to-end global GTM strategy for our AML & TM suite, expanding into new geographic markets and high-growth enterprise sectors.

  • Strategic Revenue & Market Growth:Own top-line revenue growth and strategic targets. Identify untapped market opportunities, structural trends, and emerging regional demands to secure high-value enterprise accounts.

  • Product & Market Positioning:Conduct deep competitive research and risk/regulatory assessments. Partner with Product and Regulatory teams to ensure our AML & TM solutions remain best-in-class across different regional landscapes.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Act as the strategic connective tissue between Sales, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to ensure seamless execution of GTM initiatives and product adoption.

  • Large-Scale Enablement & Mentorship:Design and execute enterprise-wide enablement programs (100+ team members across Sales, Pre-Sales, and Account Management) to elevate internal domain knowledge and sales execution.

About You:

  • 5+ yearsof sales experience, experience in selling AML or Financial Crime products is a-must

  • Deep understanding of the AML/CFT regulated industries, including regulatory frameworks and competitive landscapes

  • Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, managing large enterprise deals, and expanding into new markets

  • Experience in designing and executing go-to-market strategies for regional and global expansion while staying agile in a fast-changing business environment

  • Have excellent interpersonal skills, including the ability to work across a matrixed organisation, influencing, negotiating effectively with leadership and peers

  • Experience in running large-scale education programs for 100+ people

  • Proficiency in using sales analytics, CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), and data-driven decision-making

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility.We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters.Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation.We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global.We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Celebrating your big moments.We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design.Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

The hiring stages:TA screening -> Hiring Manager Interview -> Assignment -> Final Interview.

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.

We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.

We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.

The applicable work location will be confirmed early in the recruitment process, and the relevant compensation information for that location will be shared in writing, in line with local requirements.

raw.description:
Start: immediately | Level: Senior | Location: Germany, remote | Working time: Full-time (40h/week)

Your start in the Tech & Engineering team at ESN & More!

As a Senior Java Engineer (gn), you will join our engineering team for an initial one-year fixed-term engagement, contributing to the further development of our Order Management System based on Fluent Commerce. Your main responsibility will be the evolution of the workflow engine and order orchestration logic that powers our D2C business.

You will work in a modern, event-driven and cloud-native architecture and help us build scalable, high-performance services for our ESN & More Nutrition brands. If you enjoy clean code, solid architectures and taking ownership of complex systems with real business impact, this role is for you.

Your mission

  • You continuously optimize and enhance our OMS and workflow engine using modern Java-based architectures
  • You design and implement workflows, rules and integrations within Fluent Commerce, ensuring reliable and scalable order orchestration
  • You design and implement APIs, primarily using GraphQL, complemented by REST
  • You collaborate closely with Product, DevOps and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions end to end
  • You actively contribute to architectural and technical decisions and drive best practices within the team
  • You ensure high code quality through peer reviews, testing and clean architecture principles
  • You share your knowledge and support the growth of other engineers

Your experience & skills

  • You have several years of hands-on experience in full stack software development with strong Java skills
  • You have solid knowledge of microservices architectures and distributed, event-driven systems
  • You are experienced in API design, especially GraphQL (schema design, performance, maintainability)
  • You are familiar with cloud-native development, ideally within the AWS ecosystem
  • You have experience with DevOps practices such as CI/CD, Git and Infrastructure-as-Code
  • You are comfortable working with container technologies such as Docker
  • Experience with Fluent Commerce is a strong plus, especially in the area of workflows, rulesets and platform integrations
  • Experience with Order Management Systems or e-commerce platforms is highly desirable
  • Knowledge of PHP (Symfony or Laravel) is a plus to understand upstream and downstream systems, adjacent processes, and to support our primary backend stack when needed.
  • You work in an agile environment (e.g. Scrum, Kanban) and value collaboration, peer reviews and continuous improvement
  • You have excellent English skills, both written and spoken; German is a plus
  • You have on-call availability and willingness to travel for tech days when needed

Why choose us?

Being part of our team means joining a high-performing company with a diverse and inclusive culture. In our fast-growing team of over 1,600 employees, we combine our passion for sports nutrition, supplements, and healthy foods with cutting-edge technology, production, and logistics processes. All of this serves one goal: providing our customers with top-quality products to support their healthy and active lifestyle.

You can look forward to a strong sense of team spirit, ongoing opportunities for professional growth and responsibility, and an exciting work environment that blends lifestyle and career. With locations in Germany (Hamburg, Elmshorn, Kaltenkirchen/Nützen, and Elsdorf) as well as international offices in London, Amsterdam, and Zug, Switzerland, TQG offers diverse career opportunities in areas such as technology, product development, sales, marketing, and logistics. Additionally, you’ll benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Attractive employee discounts
  • Subsidy for the E-gym Wellpass
  • Workation
  • Corporate benefits
  • 28 days vacation/year
  • and much more

About Us

The Quality Group (TQG) is an innovative provider of sports nutrition products, bringing together the successful brands ESN and More Nutrition since 2021.

ESN has been the German market leader in sports nutrition since 2004, offering products like protein powders, bars, and supplements designed for ambitious fitness goals. Founded in 2017, More Nutrition focuses on healthy, reduced-sugar foods, providing solutions for conscious nutrition and weight management without compromise.

TQG’s vision is to help people become the best version of themselves. With passion and innovation, the company develops high-quality products that promote health, performance, and joy in life. Its agile company culture and exciting career opportunities make TQG a strong partner not only for customers but also for employees.

This is us – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!
We look forward to your application! Regardless of gender, age, background, or identity – what matters to us is who you are and what you bring to the table. Join our team and grow with us!

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary


Your Career

The Regional Sales Manager partners with our larger midsize and regional customers to secure their entire digital experience.

You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment and navigate complex, matrixed organisations to connect customers with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.


Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.

Your Impact

  • You will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and sell Palo Alto Networks Products and Solutions through Channel Partners and by interacting directly with customers in your region to consistently achieve and exceed regional revenue targets
  • You will own and develop a diverse set of customers in a selected set of complex accounts, focusing on long-term value creation.
  • Leverage consultative selling experience will help you identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and existing customers, architecting comprehensive cybersecurity transformation across network, cloud and SOC environments
  • Lead multi-threaded sales engagements involving senior executive stakeholders, technical buyers, and procurement teams, to navigate enterprise purchasing complexities and secure large-scale, multi year deployments.
  • Master the competitive landscape, trends, and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.
  • Create clear goals and accurate forecasting, developing detailed, data driven territory and deep account plans aligned with the customer business priorities.
  • You will identify, prioritize, and focus on the largest opportunities within the territory, maximizing total contract value while balancing breadth of coverage with depth on higher-value deals.
  • Build and leverage C-level relationships (CIO, CISO, CSO, and equivalent) to establish Palo Alto Networks as a trusted strategic partner.
  • You will leverage channel and marketing programs as well as sales plays to drive pipeline generation and expand coverage across the region both with existing and new customers.
  • You will collaborate with the specialist sales teams driving cross-platform adoption and ensure the best solution for our customers and prospects.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
  • Experience selling into mid-size and large enterprises, typically with multi-billion-dollar revenue and global or multi-regional operations.
  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts with extended sales cycles while operating in a high-variance environment.
  • Comfort managing accounts of different sizes, deal complexity, and sales readiness; deals may range from mid-market cycles to six & seven-figure, enterprise-scale opportunities.
  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems.
  • Cultivated relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers.
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes, including legal, security, and commercial negotiations.
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process.
  • Experience collaborating closely with a specialist sales organization to position the complete portfolio with prospects and customers.
  • Excellent time management skills and a history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets in a regional sales environment.

Curious aboutlife at Palo Alto Networks in Germany? Check out this playlist for firsthand insights into our culture and the experiences of our team.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

raw.description:
Zeel is looking for a new key member of our Provider Recruiting Team. As an associate with our Recruiting group, you will be an integral part of the operations of a small, focused team dedicated to attracting and retaining highly qualified massage therapists and other wellness and medical professionals on the Zeel platform. This is a terrific opportunity to learn more about recruiting, retention, orienting, and credentialing in a supportive, challenging, and fast-paced environment. This position is fully remote; however, you must be located within the United States.

Primary responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Conduct targeted outreach to applicants in high-priority geographic areas to encourage application completion and onboarding.
  • Exercise excellent judgment and proactive outreach
  • Meet with prospective providers to answer questions about Zeel's network, opportunities, and application process.
  • Respond to applicant inquiries via phone, text, and email, providing guidance and support throughout the application process.
  • Maintain accurate records and create research and data reports
  • Support recruiting and engagement outreach campaigns through Groove, including follow-ups and re-engagement of unresponsive applicants.
  • Track applicant progress and coordinate with internal teams to help move applicants through the onboarding process.
  • Other provider support duties as required

Our ideal candidate is:

  • An excellent communicator, both written and verbal
  • Thoughtful, empathetic, flexible, smart, and proactive, with great judgment
  • Someone who genuinely enjoys cooperation and coordination with teammates
  • Interested in serving US Veterans and helping to improve Veteran access to care rk
  • Experienced with Salesforce, comfortable and experienced with technology (Slack, Zoom, Gmail)
  • Spanish language skills are a plus but not required

If this sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits include:

  • Flexible uncapped PTO
  • Medical, dental & vision benefits
  • Fully remote/WFH
  • Massages, massages, massages

About Zeel:

Zeel is redefining access to care through in-home and on-site services focused on acute and chronic pain, stress, and mental well-being. Its HIPAA-compliant platform connects patients with a nationwide network of licensed massage therapists who provide care directly in the home.

As a member of the VA Community Care Network, Zeel provides Medical Massage Therapy to veterans experiencing acute or chronic pain, PTSD, and other life-limiting conditions. Zeel also offers corporate wellness programs and staffs more than 200 five-star hotels and independent spas nationwide. Zeel combines award-winning technology with clinical excellence to deliver personalized, convenient, and impactful care.

Zeel provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Zeel complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.
