raw.excerpt: At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.
raw.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

At TE Connectivity, we help build the technologies that keep the world connected. As a global leader in connectivity and sensor solutions, we partner with customers across industries to develop innovative products that power transportation, industrial, medical, energy, aerospace, and data infrastructure applications.

The Digital Data Networks department is seeking an experienced Staff R&D Product Engineer to lead the development of embedded software, firmware, applications, and data platforms for next-generation intelligent power products. This role is responsible for designing and delivering software solutions that bring advanced monitoring, diagnostics, analytics, and device management capabilities to active power products used in AI, hyperscale data center, industrial, and other high-power applications.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in embedded software and firmware development with strong knowledge of sensing technologies, power systems, data analytics, and connected device architectures. This individual will collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to transform product telemetry into actionable intelligence while enabling differentiated intelligent power solutions for customers worldwide.

Role and Responsibilities

Embedded Software & Active Device Development

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontrollers, sensor ICs, and intelligent power devices.
  • Develop device drivers, bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), and real-time applications using bare-metal and RTOS architectures.
  • Create tools and processes for device configuration, calibration, diagnostics, firmware updates, and secure lifecycle management.
  • Lead software architecture, communication interface implementation, code reviews, and technical mentoring to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.

Sensing, Monitoring & Diagnostics

  • Develop real-time monitoring algorithms for electrical, thermal, and electromagnetic measurements in power products.
  • Implement signal processing, calibration, fault detection, event logging, alarm handling, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to define sensing architectures and measurement requirements.
  • Develop predictive monitoring solutions that improve reliability while balancing cost, manufacturability, and system constraints.

Data Management & Analytics

  • Design and develop data acquisition systems, databases, APIs, dashboards, and analytics platforms for product telemetry.
  • Establish data models, traceability frameworks, retention strategies, and data quality standards across development and production environments.
  • Create analytics solutions for performance trending, failure analysis, predictive maintenance, and continuous product improvement.
  • Integrate monitoring platforms with edge, cloud, manufacturing, and enterprise systems while ensuring cybersecurity and data integrity.

Test, Validation & Product Development

  • Develop automated test and data acquisition software supporting product validation, characterization, and manufacturing testing.
  • Integrate software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment, including power analyzers, oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and thermal chambers.
  • Execute software verification and validation activities including unit, integration, regression, hardware-in-the-loop, and system testing.
  • Support product development from concept through production launch by troubleshooting hardware-software interactions and validating performance.

Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with customers and stakeholders to define technical requirements and intelligent power system solutions.
  • Translate business and product needs into software specifications, architectures, interfaces, and development roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with Electrical, Mechanical, Thermal, Manufacturing, Quality, Test, Product Management, and Customer Engineering teams.
  • Support documentation, design reviews, product integration, deployment activities, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience developing embedded software, firmware, connected devices, monitoring systems, industrial software, or data-driven engineering applications.
  • Proven experience leading software development projects from concept through production deployment and lifecycle support.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ for embedded systems and Python for test automation, analytics, tooling, and software development.
  • Experience delivering software solutions that interface directly with sensors, hardware devices, laboratory equipment, or industrial systems.
  • Experience collaborating across global, cross-functional engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and travel up to 25% as required.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Embedded systems development including microcontrollers, RTOS and bare-metal architectures, device drivers, bootloaders, memory management, and in-system programming.
  • Software architecture, modular design, object-oriented development, API development, interface management, and system integration.
  • Strong understanding of sensing and measurement technologies including ADCs, shunts, Hall-effect sensors, thermistors, RTDs, inductive sensing, calibration, and signal processing.
  • Knowledge of power distribution systems, power integrity concepts, voltage drop, power loss, inductance, thermal behavior, and high-current interconnects.
  • Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, telemetry processing, time-series data management, data visualization, dashboards, and reporting platforms.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles including:
    • Secure boot
    • Authentication
    • Encryption
    • Signed firmware
    • Secure update processes
    • Access control
    • Vulnerability management
  • Experience with software development and engineering tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, requirements management platforms, automated testing frameworks, and debugging environments.
  • Knowledge of automated test systems, hardware-in-the-loop validation, fault injection techniques, and traceable verification methods.

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving capabilities across software, electronics, sensing technologies, data systems, and physical product behavior.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex technical projects and competing priorities independently.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to mentor and guide other engineers while promoting disciplined software development practices.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and commitment to continuous learning in embedded systems, intelligent power products, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • Self-driven focus on advancing intelligent power solutions through innovative development, validation, and optimization methodologies.

Other Information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with data center power architectures, busbars, power shelves, 48V or 54V power distribution systems, high-voltage DC systems, or high-current cable assemblies and connectors.
  • Familiarity with PMBus, Redfish, OCP specifications, BMC integration, and other power management standards.
  • Experience developing condition monitoring, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, AI/ML analytics, or digital twin solutions.
  • Experience developing web applications, dashboards, cloud-native platforms, edge computing solutions, and containerized deployments.
  • Knowledge of functional safety, product cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and software quality practices for connected products.
  • Experience supporting product development, manufacturing process development, production testing, and customer deployment activities in a global environment.
  • Understanding of low-frequency circuit behavior and power system characteristics.
  • Proven success delivering intelligent monitoring and connected-device solutions throughout the full product lifecycle.

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $145,300 - $217,900 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
  • Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
  • Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS

  • A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

Role Description:

Being a Senior Sales Enablement Manager at Defense Unicorns means building the systems that help our Growth team consistently win.Our mission is to make software a strategic deterrent. The Sales Enablement role ensures that our Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, and Sales Engineers are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes required to communicate our value clearly and move opportunities forward.

In this role, you will report to the Business Development organization and work closely with Product Marketing, Product, and Revenue leadership to operationalize our go-to-market strategy. You will own the development and delivery of enablement programs that improve sales productivity, accelerate deal cycles, and ensure consistent execution across the revenue team.

This is an execution focused role. You will design and run repeatable enablement programs, maintain the core sales knowledge system, and ensure the field has the resources they need to succeed.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who can build structure while operating in a dynamic environment.

  • Own and execute the sales enablement strategy
  • Apply prior experience supporting Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to ensure enablement programs align with DoD, IC, and federal sales motions
  • Design and deliver onboarding programs for new Account Executives, BDRs, and Sales Architects
  • Develop and maintain sales playbooks, messaging frameworks, and opportunity management guides
  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product positioning and messaging into field-ready enablement materials
  • Ensure the revenue team has consistent access to current competitive positioning, product updates, and sales assets
  • Design and run recurring enablement sessions, including product training, competitive updates, and sales skill development
  • Support major product launches by coordinating internal training and field readiness programs
  • Maintain the sales knowledge system, ensuring resources are organized, up to date, and easy for the field to access
  • Partner with Revenue leadership to identify skill gaps and develop targeted enablement programs
  • Measure and improve the effectiveness of enablement programs through feedback, usage metrics, and sales outcomes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to ensure alignment between strategy and field execution
  • Operate effectively in a remote, fast paced environment with high cross functional collaboration

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years Sales/Revenue Enablement experience with clear ownership of onboarding, playbooks, training, and enablement systems
  • Experience designing and running sales enablement programs in B2B/B2G technology company
  • Experience supporting enterprise software sales teams, including Account Executives and Sales Architects
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical products into clear sales narratives and playbooks
  • Experience building onboarding and training programs for growing revenue teams
  • Familiarity with modern sales tools and systems such as HubSpot, Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, and enablement platforms
  • Strong organizational discipline and ability to maintain structured knowledge systems
  • Comfortable presenting and facilitating training sessions for sales teams
  • Experience working cross functionally with Product Marketing, Marketing, and Product teams
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote first environment

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA
$145,000—$185,000 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

  • Design, build, and optimize data conversion and data load artifacts, SQL scripts, database views, and staging tables for smooth data migration, extraction, and validation across all project phases.
  • Support platform integrations, security model configuration, Single Sign-On (SSO) setup, and technical documentation required for system governance and compliance packages (e.g., ATO compliance).
  • Actively participate in all SDLC phases (systems analysis, design, build, configuration, and testing); perform unit testing, root-cause trace analysis, and system performance tuning on application components and custom code.
  • Identify technical risks, formulate mitigation options, and escalate unresolved blockers to project management to ensure high-quality software solutions and on-time project delivery.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of overall experience in software engineering, systems design, database management, cloud environments, or software deployment.

  • 1+ years of experience with OneStream XF configuration, installation support, or optimization.
  • Proficiency in object-oriented programming using C# or VB.NET, along with practical SQL experience (SQL Server or Oracle) for data manipulation and querying.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Functional understanding of Corporate Performance Management (CPM) or Federal Financial Management concepts (e.g., Consolidations, Budgeting/Forecasting, Reconciliation, PPBE).
  • OneStream Certified Specialist (OCS) in Reports & Dashboards or Financial Close, or OneStream Certified Professional (OCP) – Core Platform.
  • Hands-on experience setting up Single Sign-On (SSO) and assisting with federal Authority to Operate (ATO) compliance procedures.
  • Prior experience in professional services or federal IT consulting environments.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.

Clearance Requirements:

  • US Citizenship with the ability to obtain aPublic Trust clearance or higher.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and government stakeholders, which may involve delivering technical presentations.
  • Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

The projected compensation range for this position is $94,800.00-$157,200.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

The Testing Strategy Manager (TSM) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive testing strategy for the Peraton CMS Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) healthcare program. This role focuses on advancing Agile testing practices, expanding test automation, and improving overall quality outcomes across three large, complex, mainframe‑based systems. The TSM collaborates closely with account leadership, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders to drive quality excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a holistic testing strategy aligned with Agile/DevOps methodologies and prioritizing automation across all testing phases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test schedules across hardware and software platforms.
  • Define and communicate requirements for test environments, test data, and test cycles, collaborating with Infrastructure/Data Center teams.
  • Ensure adequate testing coverage prior to production releases and support production checkout planning through risk identification and mitigation.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 10–15 technical and business analyst resources, including performance monitoring and annual evaluations.
  • Provide technical leadership to Testing Engineers and promote a culture of collaboration, growth, and quality-minded thinking.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and champion strategies for increasing automation across the program, including test data automation approaches.
  • Implement and refine processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, productivity, and reduce redundancy.
  • Assist in establishing and measuring quality metrics to support process adoption and continuous improvement.

Risk, Defect, and Quality Management

  • Identify and communicate risks related to testing strategies, ensuring clear visibility into business impacts.
  • Analyze defects to support triage, drive resolution, and determine technical and business impacts.
  • Support and participate in design reviews, requirement walk‑throughs, quality assessments, and post‑release reviews.
  • Administer the problem management process, monitoring and reporting on problem resolution activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work with account and program leadership to align testing strategy with system roadmaps, transformation efforts, and software development priorities.
  • Collaborate with Release PMs, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Technical Leads on implementation planning and issue resolution.
  • Participate in requirements/user story reviews to ensure clarity, feasibility, and testability.

Strategic Insight & Recommendations

  • Provide recommendations on tools, technologies, and testing practices to improve efficiency and quality outcomes.
  • Help shape Quality Assurance policies, goals, and objectives in partnership with QA leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of combined experience in software testing, automation, technical analysis, and business analysis.
  • 5+ years managing teams of 10+ resources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • CMS contract experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills – Must have

  • Experience developing use cases, process flows, and related documentation.
  • Expertise in automated testing practices and tools, including TestRail, Open Text UFT, MS Scheduler, and WFTP Script Editor/Debugger.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and working with Confluence and Jira.
  • Strong relationship‑building abilities across QA, business, and technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Knowledge of mainframe testing and Automated testing.
  • Demonstrated success implementing test automation within Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical concepts and work independently or within distributed teams.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and influence teams toward common goals.

Knowledge & Skills – Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of testing within mid-tier and cloud environments desired.
  • Mid‑tier and cloud testing experience desired.
  • Knowledge of AI Testing tools and Methodologies desired.
  • Prior CMS or Federal Government contract experience desired.
  • Prior health insurance experience desired.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

raw.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS - Agentic Experience
raw.excerpt: About the teamThe Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience.
raw.description:
About the team

The Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience. We are the stewards of the agentic UX framework, the foundation that allows Zillow's agentic AI capabilities to come to life across its surfaces, and we operate at the intersection of product and platform: shipping meaningful agentic experiences today while building the durable infrastructure that enables teams across Zillow to build more, faster, tomorrow.
We built and launched the user experience for Zillow AI Mode, now available to every signed-in Zillow user across web, iOS, and Android, and we own and evolve that core experience every day. We also stay at the forefront of agentic UX: exploring what comes after the conversational interface, including generative, context-adaptive interfaces that personalize to each person's goals and stage of their real estate journey, and bringing the most promising of those ideas into a product used by millions.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS, to help build and evolve Zillow AI Mode in the Zillow iOS app. You will be a core contributor to the mobile experience of AI Mode, a multimodal, context-aware agentic experience that is increasingly woven into the rest of the app. Beyond the conversational experience itself, you will help shape the interfaces by which other parts of the Zillow iOS app integrate with AI Mode, so they can hand context to the agent and surface its capabilities in place. And as the team pushes into generative UX, you will have the opportunity to contribute to how we bring frontier interaction patterns into a production app used by millions. This is a hands-on engineering role on a team that is central to Zillow's AI strategy. Much of what comes next is still being defined, and you will have a real voice in defining it.


You Will Get To

  • Build and ship the iOS experience for Zillow AI Mode (conversational, multimodal, and context-aware) in Swift and SwiftUI, with a high bar for craft, performance, and reliability in a consumer app at scale.
  • Design and evolve the integration interfaces that let other surfaces in the Zillow iOS app connect to AI Mode: passing context to the agent and bringing agentic capabilities into the flows where users already are.
  • Contribute to the team's generative UX frontier, helping prototype, evaluate, and productionize AI-composed, hyper-personalized interfaces on iOS.
  • Partner closely with your web and Android counterparts to keep the AI Mode experience consistent across platforms: aligning on experience decisions, evolving the shared schema and protocol, and learning from how each platform solves the same problems, all while building natively on iOS.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and ML engineers to turn new agentic skills and model capabilities into shippable, measurable user experiences, and support rapid experimentation with real users.
  • Champion operational excellence for the iOS experience, from instrumentation and observability to testing strategy and safe, incremental rollout, so we can move fast without compromising quality or user trust.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400.00 - $262,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200.00 - $249,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • A builder at heart who takes pride in the craft of mobile engineering and has the judgment to balance speed with rigor.
  • A champion for user experience quality. You care how things look, feel, and perform, and you hold a high bar for what great mobile work is.
  • A collaborative engineer who works well across platforms and functions (product, design, AI/ML, and peer engineering teams) and drives outcomes through influence rather than authority.
  • A pragmatic technologist who is comfortable in ambiguity, breaks down complex problems, and surfaces risks and trade-offs early.
  • A clear communicator who documents designs and decisions well and can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical partners.
  • A practitioner of AI-native development. You actively use AI coding tools and assistants in your own workflow and treat them as a genuine force multiplier throughout the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, the majority of it building native iOS applications in Swift.
  • Deep proficiency in SwiftUI and UIKit, Swift concurrency, and modern iOS architecture patterns, with experience evolving a large, long-lived codebase.
  • Demonstrated experience shipping consumer-facing iOS products to a large user base, with an appreciation for performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience quality.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incremental rollout.

Desired Skills

  • Experience building AI-powered or agentic applications, including familiarity with LLMs, streaming responses, tool/function calling, and multimodal input/output (text, voice, images).
  • Experience with server-driven or dynamically composed UI, or other approaches to rendering generative, context-adaptive interfaces on mobile.
  • Experience on a cross-platform team, aligning experience decisions with web and Android counterparts and learning from how other platforms solve similar problems.
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping and iterative product development in a fast-moving, research-adjacent environment.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.


Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.


Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Parexel FSP is looking for Senior Payment Associates to join our FSP team in Mexico. Candidates must have at least 4-5 years of experience and have advanced English skills.


Job Summary

The Senior Clinical Payment Associate provides independent, specialized support for complex clinical site payment activities across the Americas portfolio. The role manages higher-risk and non-routine work, interprets complex contractual payment terms, leads issue resolution, oversees vendor delivery, and supports portfolio-level financial analysis and process improvement. The position also provides day-to-day subject matter guidance to Payment Associates.


Job Responsibilities

  • Independently manage higher-complexity study and country payment portfolios, including multiple vendors, currencies, payment models, tax or documentation requirements, and significant exception volumes.
  • Interpret complex Clinical Trial Agreement payment terms and site budgets and determine how they translate into operational payment requirements.
  • Lead resolution of aged, disputed, historical, or cross-functional payment issues, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Oversee vendor delivery against Statements of Work, challenge gaps, review performance trends, and escalate material risks to Clinical Site Payments leadership.
  • Perform budget-versus-actual analysis, funding sufficiency review, forecasting, and variance analysis for assigned portfolios.
  • Lead or co-lead regional payment projects, internalization initiatives, process design, workflow development, testing, and implementation activities.
  • Develop guidance, job aids, and controls for country-specific payment operations and support inspection- and audit-ready evidence.
  • Coach Payment Associates, provide subject matter guidance, review complex work products, and support consistent execution across the team without direct supervisory responsibility.
  • Operate with minimal supervision, independently prioritize competing deliverables, and propose risk mitigation strategies to leadership.
  • Support accurate setup, review, execution, and reconciliation of investigator grant and clinical site payments in accordance with executed Clinical Trial Agreements, approved budgets, company procedures, and country requirements.
  • Work with investigative sites, Clinical Operations, Clinical Site Contracts, Budget Development, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external payment vendors to resolve payment questions and discrepancies.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready payment records, trackers, supporting documentation, and system data throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Use applicable systems and tools, which may include ClinRun, Greenphire, Oracle CTMS, Veeva, SAP, Ariba, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
  • Monitor invoices, payment status, aging items, and outstanding actions; escalate risks and delays according to established procedures.
  • Protect confidential information and follow company controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, and applicable financial and compliance procedures.
  • Apply country-specific payment, banking, tax-documentation, invoicing, and communication requirements across the Americas.
  • Partner effectively across North American and Latin American time zones and business practices.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically 4+ years of relevant industry experience, or 5+ years in clinical research or the pharmaceutical industry, with substantial experience in clinical site payments, investigator grants, finance, or related operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex portfolios, interpret payment terms, resolve non-routine issues, and work across functions and regions.
  • Experience with clinical site payment vendors and systems; SAP and Ariba experience required or strongly preferred based on local hiring standards.
  • Strong analytical capability, including reconciliation, root cause analysis, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual review.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
  • Ability to influence without authority, coach colleagues, and communicate risks and recommendations to leadership.
  • Fluent written and spoken English is required.
  • Professional Spanish proficiency, written and spoken, is required to support sites and stakeholders in Mexico and Argentina.
  • Portuguese proficiency is strongly preferred for support of Brazilian sites.

raw.description:
Overview

The Lead Software Architect is the technical front door for new software work. Partnering with internal business units, you will turn incoming project and capability requests into clear, estimated solutions that leadership can prioritize and engineering teams can deliver. The role blends solution engineering with technical architecture: you will uncover the real business need, learn what already exists across teams and systems, design a fit-for-purpose approach, prototype quickly to prove it out, and produce estimates ranging from rough sizing to fully staffed and costed proposals. Once a project is approved, you hand a well-defined solution to the delivery team and support a smooth transition.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for new project and capability requests from internal business units
  • Lead discovery with stakeholders to understand business goals, requirements, constraints, and success criteria, asking the questions that turn loosely defined ideas into well-scoped work
  • Partner with engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and data teams to understand existing systems, in-flight work, and dependencies that affect a request
  • Identify opportunities to reuse or extend existing platforms and capabilities before building new ones
  • Design solution options with clear tradeoffs and recommend an approach aligned with architecture standards and the technology roadmap
  • Produce estimates at the right level of fidelity, from rough order-of-magnitude sizing for early prioritization to staffed and costed proposals for funding decisions
  • Quickly build prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility, reduce risk, and help stakeholders see what they are asking for

Senior Accountant, Rebates & Commercial

Come build something that matters.

It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. Join our top-notch team of more than 50,000 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®.


The Senior Accountant is responsible for overseeing critical accounting processes related to rebate and cooperative program administration, payout execution, reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, and operational accounting support for Commercial & Industrial customers. This role collaborates cross-functionally to ensure the accurate financial administration of customer programs, timely and reliable reporting, and effective resolution of accounting-related issues. In addition, the Senior Accountant supports contract-related activities and serves as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders and external customer inquiries.


Major Focus Areas:

  • Prepare and manage rebate calculations and payouts for customers
  • Complete / review required monthly customer rebate reporting for completeness and accuracy
  • Administer Co-op calculations for POP (Proof of Performance) and non-POP programs
  • Complete / Review and process end-user and Bandsaw rebate and Co-op calculations
  • Perform customer sales and rebate reconciliations, including buying group programs
  • Prepare journal entries related to rebate, Co-op, accruals, and other month-end adjustments
  • Support end-user reconciliations and close-related accounting tasks
  • Complete balance sheet reconciliations for rebate, Co-op, and related accounts and update BOA reports
  • Process check payments and support workflow-related accounting tasks
  • Maintain customer setups in SAP

  • Research and resolve customer deductions in online deduction system
  • Respond to accounting questions from internal teams and external customers

You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan.

And More:

We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to:

What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us!

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.

If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.

raw.excerpt: Stranger Soccer UAE · Reports to CEOAbout Stranger SoccerThe #1 way adults play football in the UAE.
raw.description:
Stranger Soccer UAE · Reports to CEO

About Stranger Soccer

The #1 way adults play football in the UAE. We operate across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman — 200+ games every month, 30,000+ downloads, a real community of players who show up, play, meet people, and come back. Two years in, we’re at the inflection point where financial discipline, clean reporting, and sharp commercial judgement are everything.

About the Role

You will own the health of our finance function day-to-day. You’re not doing the daily bookkeeping yourself (we have that covered), and you’re not a Finance Director or CFO (we don’t need 10+ years of experience).

You are the person who sits between the CEO and the finance operations team — making sure we have clean, accurate, timely numbers, and more importantly, telling us what those numbers mean and what to do about them.

You will report directly to the CEO. You’ll have one direct report (our Finance & Payments Coordinator, PH-based) and oversight of our external accounting firm (UAE-based).

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. If the P&L is wrong, I need you to spot it, fix it, and tell me what to change so it doesn’t happen again. If a cost line looks off, I need you proactively flagging it. If a decision I’m about to make doesn’t stack up on the numbers, I need you telling me.

This role is also about building structure, not just reading numbers. Our finance workflows, reporting cadence, and process discipline need serious upgrading. You will design, document and enforce a cleaner finance operation.

What You’ll Own

Financial reporting and oversight

Monthly rolling 3-month P&L pack delivered to CEO on the 5th of every month without fail

  • P&L accuracy — you own whether the numbers tie. If they don’t, you fix it before they reach the CEO
  • Balance sheet oversight — cash, receivables, payables, royalty accruals
  • Royalty reconciliation against licensing agreement terms (including credit mechanism)
  • Discount / promo / voucher tracking as a visible line item
  • Variance analysis month-on-month

Business health and advice

  • Interpret the numbers — tell the CEO what’s going well, what’s not, and what needs attention
  • Track and report on KPIs: revenue, gross margin, CAC, LTV, retention, membership economics
  • Model scenarios — pricing changes, membership restructures, partnership economics
  • Flag risks and opportunities proactively — don’t wait to be asked
  • Prepare financial packs for our Singapore Licensor and external stakeholders

Structure, processes and team workflow

  • Design and document the finance function end-to-end — chart of accounts, monthly close process, invoice routing, payment approval workflow, royalty calculation, VAT preparation
  • Build SOPs for the Finance & Payments Coordinator and the external accounting firm
  • Manage our Finance & Payments Coordinator — set KPIs, hold weekly check-ins, coach to higher output
  • Manage our external accounting firm — hold them accountable for quality, timeliness, and compliance
  • Run the monthly business review meeting with the CEO
  • Build and maintain the chart of accounts in our accounting software

What You WON’T Do

  • Daily bookkeeping — the Finance & Payments Coordinator and external accountants handle that
  • UAE VAT / Corporate Tax filings — external accountants do that; you supervise
  • Daily payment execution — Coordinator does that
  • Set company strategy (you support it; you don’t own it)

Requirements

Who You Are

5–8 years of finance experience, ideally some of it in SME or growth-stage startup

  • Background in consumer business, marketplace, subscription, or multi-location operations preferred
  • CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent qualification strongly preferred
  • You’ve actually run management reporting for a business — not just audit or academic finance
  • Strong commercial instinct — you can read a P&L and tell me what’s really happening, not just what it says
  • Proven track record designing or improving finance processes, workflows and chart of accounts — not just operating within an existing system someone else built
  • Experience managing external accounting firms and holding them to account
  • Experience with cloud accounting software — Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or equivalent
  • High-level Excel / Google Sheets competence
  • English fluency essential — this role runs on async communication and clear written analysis
  • Writes clearly and concisely
  • Proactive, independent operator — spots problems, proposes solutions, executes
  • Open to a part-time commitment (4 hours/day, Mon-Fri) — this role is designed to fit alongside other professional commitments

Culture fit

Honesty over politics. Tell me when I’m wrong.

  • Ownership over blame. Fix it before escalating.
  • Data over opinions. Bring the numbers.
  • Speed over perfection. Launch, measure, adjust.
  • Self-direction over supervision.

Working Hours

  • Remote, Philippines-based, part-time: 4 hours per day, Monday to Friday.
  • Working days: Monday to Friday
  • Core hours: 3:00pm–7:00pm PHT (11:00am–3:00pm UAE time) — fully online and reachable for sync with the Finance & Payments Coordinator and ad hoc CEO queries
  • Weekends off: Saturday + Sunday
  • Total effort: 20 hours per week
  • Deliverables-based: monthly reporting pack by the 5th of every month without fail; weekly one-to-one with Finance Coordinator; monthly review meeting with CEO

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that helps entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, clear communication, and practical problem-solving. Our teams work closely across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Pharmacy Operations, and leadership to improve the systems and relationships that support our customers.

Our pharmacy partnerships are an important part of how the broader platform operates. We value people who can build productive external relationships, understand commercial tradeoffs, and negotiate agreements that support sustainable growth and dependable operations.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Pharmacy Partnerships & Negotiations Manager to help Bask Health develop, negotiate, and manage commercial relationships with pharmacy partners.

This role focuses on the supply side of our business: identifying potential partners, evaluating commercial opportunities, negotiating pricing and contractual terms, and improving the economics and coverage of our pharmacy network.

You'll work closely with Pharmacy Operations, Finance, Legal, and company leadership to develop partnerships that support business requirements and operational needs.

You'll take ownership of commercial discussions from initial evaluation through negotiation, agreement coordination, and ongoing relationship management.

You'll identify pharmacy partners that may be a fit for Bask Health's approved business needs.

You'll research prospective partners and develop organized sourcing pipelines.

You'll evaluate potential partnerships based on commercial fit, operational capabilities, and relevant business requirements.

You'll coordinate with authorized pharmacy and compliance personnel when evaluating regulated capabilities.

raw.title: Billing Operations & Revenue Integrity Analyst
raw.excerpt: About Bask HealthBask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.
raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams work across Finance, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Engineering to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Billing Operations & Revenue Integrity Analyst to help ensure Bask Health's merchant billing is accurate and aligned with agreed-upon commercial terms.

You'll review merchant agreements, validate billing configurations, reconcile invoices, and investigate discrepancies involving rates, discounts, fees, and effective dates.

This is a hands-on operational and analytical role. You'll work with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to resolve billing issues, maintain accurate records, and help prevent revenue leakage or incorrect charges.

You'll also support the implementation of approved pricing changes and help improve the processes used to check billing accuracy.

We're looking for someone who is organized, comfortable working with financial data, and enjoys investigating discrepancies until they're fully resolved.

What You'll Do

  • Review signed merchant agreements and pricing schedules to identify applicable billing terms.
  • Validate that contracted rates, fees, discounts, and effective dates are accurately reflected in billing records.
  • Reconcile merchant invoices against agreed-upon commercial terms.
  • Identify billing discrepancies, including incorrect rates, duplicate charges, missing charges, and misapplied discounts.
  • Investigate differences between contracted pricing and actual billed amounts.
  • Work with Finance and Revenue Operations to resolve billing inconsistencies.
  • Support the activation of approved pricing arrangements for new and existing merchants.
  • Verify that pricing changes and contract amendments are implemented on the correct effective dates.
  • Review invoice adjustments, credits, and corrections for accuracy.
  • Maintain organized records of billing issues, investigations, and resolutions.
  • Track outstanding billing discrepancies and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
  • Support recurring billing reviews and reconciliation activities.
  • Identify potential revenue leakage caused by incorrect billing configurations or missing charges.
  • Analyze recurring billing errors to help identify their underlying causes.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to investigate merchant billing questions.
  • Work with Sales and commercial teams to clarify agreed-upon pricing when necessary.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when billing discrepancies involve system configuration or technical issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of merchant pricing arrangements and billing updates.
  • Prepare reports on billing discrepancies, corrections, and outstanding issues.
  • Support the development of consistent billing validation procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy and efficiency of billing workflows.
  • Help establish checks for new pricing configurations and contract changes.
  • Monitor billing exceptions and escalate issues requiring additional review.
  • Support month-end billing reconciliation and financial reporting activities.
  • Assist with internal reviews of billing accuracy and commercial compliance.
  • Verify that resolved billing issues have been corrected in the relevant records or systems.
  • Help improve communication between Finance, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations regarding billing changes.
  • Maintain clear documentation of reconciliation methods and supporting financial information.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring billing checks and reporting.
  • Support additional billing operations and revenue integrity projects as business needs evolve.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in billing operations, revenue operations, financial operations, accounts receivable operations, or a related field.
  • Experience reviewing invoices, pricing schedules, or commercial billing records.
  • Experience reconciling billed amounts against contracts, pricing agreements, or approved rates.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills, including formulas, data comparisons, and reconciliation.
  • Ability to investigate billing discrepancies and identify their causes.
  • Familiarity with billing adjustments, credits, discounts, and effective dates.
  • Strong understanding of financial accuracy and basic billing controls.
  • Experience working with billing platforms, financial systems, or operational reporting tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accurate recordkeeping.
  • Ability to manage multiple billing issues and follow through on outstanding items.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Experience maintaining documentation of financial investigations and corrections.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain billing discrepancies clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with Finance, Customer Success, Sales, or Operations teams.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
  • Ability to handle confidential financial and merchant information responsibly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SaaS or merchant billing operations.
  • Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based billing.
  • Experience working with Stripe Billing or similar billing platforms.
  • Experience translating commercial agreements into billing configurations.
  • Experience identifying revenue leakage or incorrect customer charges.
  • Familiarity with pricing activation and contract-to-billing validation.
  • Experience supporting merchant-facing technology platforms.
  • Familiarity with telehealth, healthcare technology, or e-commerce.
  • Understanding of cash-pay business models.
  • Experience reconciling nonstandard pricing arrangements or discounts.
  • Experience using SQL to investigate billing data.
  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience automating recurring billing reconciliations.
  • Experience supporting financial close or internal billing reviews.
  • Experience working in a growing SaaS or technology company.

raw.excerpt: Position Summary RethinkFirst is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Associate Product Manager to support the continued development and enhancement of BillAI, our revenue cycle management (RCM) platform.
raw.description:
Position Summary

RethinkFirst is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Associate Product Manager to support the continued development and enhancement of BillAI, our revenue cycle management (RCM) platform.

This position will work closely with the Senior Product Manager, engineering, QA, customer support, billing operations, and other internal stakeholders to manage product requirements, coordinate development activities, and support successful feature releases.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with technical and non-technical teams, and interested in developing a career in product management.

This role will focus on product execution, operational support, and assisting the Senior Product Manager with strategic initiatives, roadmap planning, and complex product decisions. As the individual develops product knowledge and experience, they will take increasing ownership of assigned features and enhancements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Requirements & Documentation

  • Assist the Senior Product Manager in gathering, documenting, and refining product requirements.

  • Create and maintain user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements for development.

  • Work with stakeholders to clarify business needs, identify workflow challenges, and define expected functionality.

  • Maintain accurate product documentation, workflows, and feature specifications.

  • Ensure development tickets contain sufficient information for engineering and QA teams.

2. Product Backlog & Sprint Support

  • Assist with maintaining, organizing, and refining the product backlog.

  • Prepare user stories and requirements for sprint planning and backlog refinement sessions.

  • Track the progress of assigned development initiatives and identify potential blockers.

  • Coordinate with engineering and QA to clarify requirements throughout development.

  • Verify that completed work aligns with documented requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Support the Senior Product Manager in monitoring sprint commitments and release timelines.

3. Stakeholder Coordination

  • Serve as a point of contact for internal stakeholders submitting product enhancement requests or reporting workflow gaps.

  • Gather additional information needed to evaluate requests and understand business impact.

  • Track stakeholder requests and provide regular updates on their status.

  • Coordinate meetings to review requirements, proposed solutions, and completed functionality.

  • Document meeting outcomes, action items, and follow-up activities.

  • Maintain visibility into product initiatives, customer-impacting issues, and development progress.

4. Product Testing & Release Support

  • Participate in reviewing completed functionality before release.

  • Assist with user acceptance testing (UAT) to verify that features meet business requirements.

  • Coordinate and conduct product demonstrations with internal stakeholders.

  • Prepare release notes and assist with communicating upcoming product changes.

  • Support post-release follow-up to identify issues or opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with QA and engineering to ensure reported defects are clearly documented and reproducible.

5. Customer Support & Product Operations

  • Partner with customer support and billing operations to understand recurring customer challenges.

  • Investigate reported product issues and help determine whether they are defects, training opportunities, or enhancement requests.

  • Document common product workflows and frequently asked questions.

  • Assist in creating internal training materials and product demonstrations.

  • Identify opportunities to improve existing workflows, reduce manual processes, and enhance the user experience.

6. Product Ownership & Continuous Improvement

  • Take ownership of assigned product enhancements, including requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, development coordination, and release validation, with guidance from the Senior Product Manager.

  • Develop an understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, including claims processing, payment posting, denials, and reporting.

  • Become familiar with healthcare EDI transactions, including 837 claims, 835 remittances, and claim acknowledgments.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the BillAI platform's functionality, configurations, and integration workflows.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product processes, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

  • Gradually assume responsibility for independently managing smaller product features and enhancements.

  • Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to evaluate potential solutions and recommend improvements based on customer needs and business impact.

Required Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software implementation, project coordination, or a related role.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies.

  • Experience using product management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with healthcare software or SaaS platforms.

  • Familiarity with healthcare revenue cycle management workflows.

  • Basic understanding of medical claims, insurance payments, denials, and adjustments.

  • Exposure to healthcare EDI transactions, including 837, 835, 999, and 277.

  • Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience supporting software testing or user acceptance testing.

  • Familiarity with behavioral health or ABA billing is a plus.

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the individual's ability to:

  • Maintain well-documented, organized, and actionable product requirements.

  • Improve the readiness of development tickets before sprint planning.

  • Ensure stakeholder requests are tracked, evaluated, and communicated effectively.

  • Support timely completion of product demonstrations and release activities.

  • Reduce the administrative and coordination workload of the Senior Product Manager.

  • Demonstrate increasing ownership of assigned product enhancements from requirements through release.

  • Develop sufficient product knowledge to independently manage smaller features and enhancements.

  • Build effective working relationships with engineering, QA, customer support, and billing operations.

  • Contribute to improvements in product workflows, stakeholder communication, and overall team efficiency.

Full-time employment

  • Provide medical oversight throughout the conduct of clinical trials, in accordance with the protocol, applicable regulations, and ICH-GCP requirements

  • Participate in bid defense meetings and proposal activities
  • Provide support with Pharmacovigilance activities
  • Identify medical trial risks, and collaborate with relevant functions to define appropriate mitigation and escalation measures
  • Support or participate in advisory boards, safety monitoring boards, and other medical or scientific committees, as applicable.
  • Help ensure that trial conduct and medical oversight activities comply with the approved protocol, applicable regulatory requirements, and quality standards

You will be a strong fit for this role if you have

  • Medical Doctor degree
  • Board certification in Oncology
  • Previous experience as a practicing Oncologist
  • Previous experience in clinical research or the pharmaceutical or CRO industry is a plus
  • Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English
  • Strong medical judgement, analytical thinking, and attention to detail
  • Clear communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex medical information to different stakeholders
  • A collaborative and solution-oriented approach to working within international, cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and confidence working with clinical trial systems and digital collaboration tools.

About us

Infomineo is a pioneering global AI-enhanced research company that transforms how businesses access, analyze, and act on critical intelligence. We’ve evolved from traditional business research outsourcing to become the strategic partner that combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with deep human expertise. We offer 3 services to our global clients (leading consulting companies, Fortune 500 companies, and government entities): AI and Data Advisory, Next-Gen Insights and Resource Scaling. This is made possible by relying on 3 pillars of excellence:

  1. 350+ industry experts spread across 5 offices (Cairo, Casablanca, Mexico City, Dubai, Barcelona).
  2. Our proprietary AI orchestrator.
  3. Extensive knowledge assets combining 500,000+ delivered case studies and database subscriptions.

Ready to kick start your career with us?

About this role

This role will give you the opportunity to work on high added value data governance and data quality projects, building robust data management frameworks for our clients within a growing service company.

As our Data Governance Specialist, you will help clients take control of their data assets — defining policies, enforcing quality standards, managing metadata, and deploying governance tooling. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, analysts, and client stakeholders to embed governance practices across the full data lifecycle.

What will you do?

Design, implement, and operationalize data governance frameworks across client engagements, covering the following areas:

DATA GOVERNANCE & POLICY

  • Define and implement data governance frameworks, policies, and standards tailored to client environments.
  • Establish data ownership, stewardship models, and accountability structures across business and technical teams.
  • Develop and maintain data dictionaries, business glossaries, and classification taxonomies.
  • Ensure compliance with data regulations and internal data management policies (GDPR, BCBS 239, etc.).

DATA QUALITY & LINEAGE

  • Design and implement data quality rules, profiling routines, and monitoring dashboards.
  • Investigate and remediate data quality issues across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Map and document end-to-end data lineage to support auditability and impact analysis.
  • Define and track data quality KPIs and SLAs in collaboration with data owners.

METADATA & CATALOGUING

  • Deploy and administer data catalog and metadata management tools (e.g. Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview).
  • Enrich metadata assets with business context, ownership, sensitivity classification, and usage information.
  • Drive adoption of the data catalog across business and technical teams.

TOOLING & INTEGRATION

  • Configure and operate data governance platforms, primarily Informatica (IDMC, Axon, EDC, DQ) and equivalent tools.
  • Integrate governance tooling with existing data pipelines, warehouses, and BI environments.
  • Automate data quality checks and governance workflows within ETL/ELT pipelines.

OTHER

  • Provide internal training and knowledge-sharing sessions on data governance best practices.
  • Support the Team Lead/Manager on client relationships, business development, and internal projects.

Who are you?

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

  • Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Statistics, or Applied Mathematics.
  • Full proficiency in English + 1 additional language (French, Arabic, Spanish, German...).
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in data governance, data management, or data engineering with a strong governance focus.
  • Experience working in a consulting, financial services, or multi-client environment is a plus.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

DATA GOVERNANCE TOOLS

  • Proven hands-on experience with Informatica (IDMC / Intelligent Data Management Cloud, Axon Data Governance, Enterprise Data Catalog, Data Quality).
  • Experience with other governance and cataloguing platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Ataccama, or Microsoft Purview.
  • Familiarity with data quality tools: Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Soda, or equivalent.

DATA ENGINEERING & QUERYING

  • Solid experience with SQL for data profiling, querying, and quality rule implementation across relational databases and data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Synapse, Redshift).
  • Experience in Python for automating data quality checks, metadata extraction, and governance workflows.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines and ability to embed governance controls within them (dbt, Airflow, Informatica PowerCenter/IDMC).

DATA ARCHITECTURE & PLATFORMS

  • Good understanding of data platform architectures: data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and their native governance services: Azure Purview, AWS Glue Data Catalog, Google Dataplex.
  • Understanding of data modelling concepts and their impact on governance (dimensional modelling, data vault, etc.).

STANDARDS & COMPLIANCE

  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks and standards: DAMA-DMBOK, BCBS 239, GDPR, ISO 8000.
  • Experience defining and applying data classification schemes (sensitivity labels, PII tagging, retention policies).
  • Exposure to master data management (MDM) concepts and tools is a plus.

INTERPERSONAL SKILLS

  • Ability to engage and influence both technical teams and business stakeholders on data governance topics.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose data quality issues and translate them into actionable remediation plans.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to document governance frameworks clearly and present findings to senior audiences.
  • Detail-oriented, rigorous, and comfortable working across multiple client contexts simultaneously.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary.
  • A great working environment.
  • A steep learning curve with interesting and diverse topics to work on.
  • A healthy work-life balance.
  • Health insurance benefits.

Equal opportunity employer

If you believe you match our requirements and values, we would be happy to hear from you. Visit our website to know more about us, our services and company culture.
