We Are:

Supply Chain & Engineering, and we work at the point where transportation and warehousing meet. The yard is still one of the least digitized parts of the supply chain, and it is becoming a strategic control point as autonomous trucks, AMRs, and real-time asset tracking arrive. We help clients turn yard operations from a hidden cost into a source of throughput, visibility, and competitive advantage. Our teams work in AI-native ways, where operations experts and engineering and technology specialists design, test, and refine solutions together.


You Are:

A yard and site operations professional who understands that the yard connects inbound, outbound, warehouse capacity, and carrier management, and that a process problem in the yard shows up everywhere else. You have implemented or configured a YMS, or led yard process redesign, and you can walk a yard and see where time and risk are lost. You are curious about automation and autonomy, and you think about the people who work in the yard as well as the throughput numbers.


The Work:

  • Lead YMS implementation and yard process workstreams, from requirements through go-live and hypercare.
  • Assess current-state yard operations, including gate check-in, dock and door assignment, trailer moves, shunting, and yard-to-WMS/TMS handoffs.
  • Design future-state yard processes, including AMR shunting, computer vision gate validation, and AI-driven dock and move scheduling.
  • Define integration requirements between the YMS and WMS, TMS, ERP, and tracking platforms such as RFID, GPS, and telematics.
  • Build business cases and KPI frameworks covering dwell time, trailer turn, dock utilization, labor productivity, and safety.
  • Design the operating model for automated yards, including roles, governance, exception management, and human override.
  • Lead workforce transition planning for yard roles such as drivers, spotters, and gate staff as automation changes the task mix. This covers reskilling, role redesign, and safety.
  • Validate designs against real site conditions, including layout, peak volume, multi-site variation, and labor constraints.
  • Drive adoption with site operations, carriers, and client IT teams.
  • Contribute to business development through client workshops, points of view, and proposal support.

Travel Requirements:

Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here's What You Need:

  • A minimum of 7 years in transportation, warehousing, or yard and site operations, including at least 3 years in yard management, YMS implementation, or yard process consulting.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or configuring at least one major YMS platform, from design through go-live.
  • Experience diagnosing and redesigning yard processes, including KPI design and baseline measurement.
  • Working knowledge of how yards interface with transportation (TMS, carrier appointments, drayage) and warehousing (WMS, dock scheduling, inbound and outbound flows).
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If associate degree, must have a minimum of 6 years’ work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • Working understanding of yard tracking and automation technologies, including RFID, GPS/telematics, ANPR/OCR gate automation, and yard sensors.
  • Experience leading cross-functional workstreams with operations, IT, and client executives.
  • You have hands-on exposure to AMRs, autonomous yard tractors, or autonomous shunting.
  • You have worked with digital twin tools or simulation for yard or site planning.
  • You understand readiness requirements for autonomous trucks, including V2X and yard access rules.
  • You have applied computer vision or AI-based scheduling in a logistics setting.
  • You know yard safety requirements, including powered industrial vehicle rules and yard labor considerations.
  • You have consulting or transformation program experience.
  • You hold Lean, Six Sigma, or process improvement certifications.

You will find top talent through proactive sourcing, relationship building, and an active presence on all of our social media channels. That presence will also grow our talent communities and make Broadway Ventures more visible to both candidates and clients.

Our ideal candidate is friendly and outgoing and provides excellent service to both potential hires and our client employers. You must be detail-oriented, organized, and self-motivated so you meet deadlines and prepare accurate status reports for your supervisor.

Recruiting & Pipeline Building

  • Build and maintain candidate pipelines for current openings, upcoming contract proposals, and expected contract awards

Social Media & Employer Brand

raw.description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wing’s fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

Wing is looking for a Head of Product & Partner Marketingto join our Marketing team. This role is based remotely in the United States. As the central commercial marketing leader and primary strategic counterpart to the Product/UX and Strategic Partnership organizations, you will lead the "commercial engine" bridging our product, the market, and our ecosystem. Leading a specialized pod focused on B2C Demand, B2B Merchant Enablement, and Customer Insights, you will help set the core narrative and positioning of Wing’s competitive advantage, and relentlessly pursue what makes our experience unique and differentiated to serve the needs of everyone we serve across the ecosystem. You will ensure tight alignment with our cross-functional teams to set a clear strategic blueprint for our integrated activities across Growth, Content, and Creative teams to scale. The ideal candidate will simplify complex technical operations into audience-first, benefit-driven value propositions and experiences, while managing the end-to-end partner marketing lifecycle.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build a deeply embedded 'Interlock' model with Product, UX, and Engineering—specifically across Demand Generation and Fulfillment. Ensure marketing strategy shapes product development from day one to accelerate commercial adoption.
  • Craft the foundational positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy for both end-users (B2C) and merchant partners (B2B).
  • Serve as the strategic marketing counterpart to BD and Partnerships. Manage the partner lifecycle end-to-end, from developing foundational pitch narratives to executing multi-channel co-marketing campaigns with enterprise brands.
  • Define the Wing value proposition and orchestrate the commercial positioning in the web, app, packaging, and partner ecosystem. Responsible for consumer experience and engagement strategies across our digital delivery applications.
  • Partner across Policy, Comms, Legal, and Marketing to align commercial messaging with aviation and safety standards.
  • Partner closely with our Growth & Media teams to test positioning and scale direct user acquisition, including implementation of promotions strategy.
  • Build insights and intelligence capabilities to combine product usability feedback with market and competitive data, feeding structured truth back to Product and BD to refine roadmaps.

What You’ll Need:

  • 15+ years of experience in product marketing, partner marketing, and/or commercial marketing and P&L responsibilities, ideally within a B2B2C marketplace, e-commerce and logistics, or deep-tech company.
  • Bachelor's degree in a directly related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience building, scaling, operationalizing, or commercializing at a previous company, with a track record of building and managing high-performing strategic marketing pods.
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary strategic counterpart to senior Product, UX, and Business Development and Partnerships leadership, as well as executive leadership.
  • Deep experience crafting GTM strategies that serve both consumers and enterprise merchants, including managing high-stakes co-marketing campaigns.
  • Proven ability to translate complex operational or regulatory constraints into simple, benefit-driven positioning.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is the salary range below + bonus + equity + benefits. Wing’s salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

$224,000—$281,000 USD

raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Associate Director, IIT Supply Chain owns drug supply for Investigator Initiated Trials (IITs) across planning, label development, label & pack, and distribution for multiple global clinical studies. Serving as the primary interface with Global Clinical Supply Chain and internal stakeholders, and managing relationships with external supply partners, this role ensures accurate, continuous, and compliant supply to patients while minimizing risk and waste. The Associate Director brings working knowledge of clinical supply best practices and supply chain systems, experience in a cGMP environment, and a commitment to building processes that prepare the organization for the future. As business needs evolve, responsibilities may expand to include supply planning for other Global Medical Affairs (GMA) Medical Operations programs, such as expanded access and Phase IV studies.


Essential Functions of the Job:


Clinical & Commercial Supply Planning and Strategy

  • Develop and oversee supply and inventory plans for assigned IITs to ensure accurate and continuous supply to patients.
  • Partner with the IIT team, investigators, and study sites to understand clinical demand and timelines, and align supply plans accordingly.
  • Forecast and aggregate anticipated IIT drug demand across the portfolio to enable proactive supply decisions.
  • Maintain Excel-based planning tools and dashboards to support decision-making.
  • Develop supply strategies that maximize supply efficiency and minimize waste.
  • Identify supply risks, and develop and execute risk mitigation plans
  • Manage inventory throughout the supply chain, including inventory reporting, expiry management, and drug accountability and reconciliation.

Label Development, Label & Pack, and Distribution

  • Lead label development, ensuring label text and proofs comply with applicable regulations, product specifications, and study protocol(s).
  • Coordinate label review and approval with Regulatory, Quality, Global Clinical Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Plan and coordinate label & pack operations.
  • Plan and coordinate distribution of investigational and commercially approved product to depots, sites, and patients across multiple countries, including temperature-controlled shipments.
  • Coordinate and track shipments to CDMOs, depots, and vendors, and maintain shipping documentation.
  • Support IRT/RTSM user acceptance testing, supply strategy and parameter setup, and ongoing supply activities within the system, as applicable.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

  • Represent the IIT team and serve as the primary interface with Global Clinical Supply Chain.
  • Provide a high level of service to internal stakeholders (e.g., Global Medical Affairs, Global R&D Sourcing, Regulatory, Quality, Legal, Finance).
  • Manage relationships with, and oversee the daily activities of, external supply partners such as CMOs/CDMOs, depots, couriers, and IRT vendors.

Quality and Compliance

  • Ensure supply activities are conducted in compliance with cGMP, GDP, and GCP requirements, applicable regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Investigate exceptions (e.g., temperature excursions, shipment deviations, product complaints) to determine root cause, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and drive closure.
  • Support audits and inspections related to IIT drug supply.

Budget Management

  • Develop and manage IIT drug supply budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide input to Finance on accruals and planned spend.
  • Manage purchase orders, and review and pay invoices for supply vendors.

Process Improvement and Leadership

  • Work with management to develop and implement process improvements, tools, and best practices that build the organization for the future.
  • Lead cross-functional projects related to IIT drug supply.
  • Create and revise process documents such as SOPs and working instructions.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This position does not have direct reports at this time. The role may provide guidance, training, and informal mentoring to IIT team members and colleagues on clinical supply planning processes and tools.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, life sciences, or a related field required; Master’s degree/MBA preferred.

Qualifications:


Required:

  • Bachelors degree with 8+ years of progressive supply chain experience, including at least 5 years in clinical supply chain within the biotech, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry.
  • Experience managing investigational product supply for global, multi-country clinical trials.
  • Working knowledge of clinical supply best practices, supply chain systems, and cGMP, GDP, and GCP requirements.
  • Experience managing CMOs/CDMOs, label & pack vendors, depots, and couriers, including deviation investigation and CAPA implementation.
  • Strong analytical and Excel modeling skills for demand forecasting and supply planning.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple studies and projects, and to work independently and within multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural teams.
  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills; fluent in spoken and written English.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience collaborating with external sponsors on IITs
  • APICS CPIM certification or equivalent.

Computer Skills:

  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel (including supply modeling), PowerPoint, Smartsheet, and Outlook.
  • Working knowledge of IRT/RTSM systems, SAP or comparable ERP/planning systems, Ariba Buying & Invoicing/Guided Buying or similar purchasing systems, and Veeva Vault or similar quality/document management systems.

Travel:

  • Work-related travel approximately 5-10%, including face-to-face department meetings.

Work Arrangement:

  • Remote

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $160,100.00 - $210,100.00 annually

raw.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We work with businesses that want to operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're an entrepreneurial team that values initiative, clear communication, and people who take ownership of their work. Our teams collaborate closely across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Operations to solve problems and improve how our platform works.

About the Role

We're looking for a Pharmacy Implementation Program Manager to lead the onboarding and implementation of new pharmacy partners and pharmacy-related operational workflows at Bask Health.

You'll manage implementation projects from kickoff through launch, coordinating with pharmacy partners, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and internal operations teams.

Your focus will be ensuring that technical dependencies, operational processes, partner requirements, testing, and launch readiness activities are completed before new pharmacy workflows go live.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can bring structure to complicated implementations, keep stakeholders aligned, and take ownership of delivering projects on time.

What You'll Do

  • Own pharmacy implementation projects from initial kickoff through launch and post-launch stabilization.
  • Develop implementation plans with clear timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and completion criteria.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities for new pharmacy partners.
  • Work with pharmacy partners to gather operational requirements and document existing workflows.
  • Translate partner requirements into clear implementation tasks for internal teams.
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on pharmacy integrations and technical dependencies.
  • Track integration progress and ensure outstanding technical requirements have clear owners.
  • Organize implementation meetings and maintain accurate action-item trackers.
  • Identify implementation risks, blockers, and dependencies early.
  • Escalate issues that may affect launch timelines or operational readiness.
  • Coordinate testing of pharmacy order workflows, fulfillment processes, and partner integrations.
  • Maintain testing checklists, issue logs, and readiness documentation.
  • Work with internal teams and pharmacy partners to resolve issues identified during implementation testing.
  • Coordinate go-live readiness reviews and ensure required operational tasks are completed.
  • Develop launch checklists and confirm that responsibilities are clearly assigned.
  • Help establish escalation procedures and communication workflows for newly onboarded pharmacy partners.
  • Coordinate training and operational handoffs for internal teams supporting new pharmacy workflows.
  • Monitor outstanding issues during the initial post-launch period.
  • Coordinate post-launch issue resolution and stabilization activities.
  • Document implementation outcomes, lessons learned, and opportunities for improvement.

Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Position Summary

The Senior Accountant – Corporate Accounting will take ownership of assigned corporate accounting areas and play a key role in the Company's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close. Areas of responsibility include debt, cash and investments, payroll-related activities, employee travel and expenses, account reconciliations, and financial statement support. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, possesses strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, and thrives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close

  • Prepare and record monthly journal entries, including operating expense accruals, debt and financing related activity, and other recurring close activities.
  • Prepare and maintain account reconciliations and supporting schedules for assigned balance sheet accounts, including timely resolution of reconciling items.
  • Own assigned close tasks through the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, meeting close calendar deadlines and preparing support for management review.

Debt & Financing

  • Maintain debt schedules and record debt and financing-related activity, including interest expense accruals and amortization of debt issuance costs.
  • Reconcile debt and related balances to lender statements and supporting agreements.

Cash & Investments

  • Prepare bank and investment account reconciliations and supporting schedules, including investigation of reconciling items.
  • Record bank, investment, and other cash-related activities.

Payroll & Employee Related Accounting

  • Prepare payroll and employee-related journal entries, including accruals, bonuses, benefits, and other employee-related balances.
  • Reconcile related accounts to supporting records and investigate and resolve accounting differences in coordination with Payroll, HR, and Finance.

Travel & Expense

  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations related to employee travel and expense activity.
  • Analyze and resolve outstanding, unrecorded, or reconciling travel and expense items as part of month-end close.

Financial Reporting Support

  • Assist with the preparation of financial reporting packages and related supporting schedules, including support for quarterly and annual SEC filings (Forms 10-Q and 10-K).
  • Perform variance analyses for assigned accounts and provide explanations of key account fluctuations.
  • Support quarterly reviews and annual financial statement audits by external auditors, including preparing requested schedules and responding to auditor inquiries for assigned areas.

Controls & Process Improvement

  • Execute and document internal controls over financial reporting for assigned accounts, including SOX compliance activities, and support control testing performed by internal and external auditors.
  • Identify and help implement opportunities to streamline accounting processes, strengthen controls, and improve close efficiency.
  • Support other accounting areas as needed for backup coverage and assist with ad-hoc accounting activities.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for month-end close and general ledger accounting.
  • Experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing account reconciliations and supporting external audits.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and building reconciliation and supporting schedules.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system.

Preferred

  • Experience with corporate accounting areas such as cash and investments, debt, payroll, or employee travel and expense accounting.
  • Experience in a publicly traded company environment.
  • Public accounting experience.
  • CPA or CPA candidate.
  • Experience supporting internal controls and SOX compliance processes.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and handle confidential information, including payroll and compensation data, with discretion while collaborating effectively across departments.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

Travel

This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

US Salary Range: $100,000 - $110,000

Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 4–6 hours per day)

Rate: 18 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of speech and language AI technologies by providing high-quality voice recordings in your native language and dialect.

You will complete recording tasks using our internal platform by reading provided text prompts aloud. The goal is to capture natural speech from native speakers of specific language variants to help improve AI systems' ability to understand diverse languages, dialects, and accents.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

Your recordings will be used to evaluate how agents respond to spoken instructions and to compare that evaluation with an evaluation of text-based instructions. The collected audio may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Read provided text cards aloud and record them exactly as written (there approximately 640 cards per person).
  • Produce clear, natural, and high-quality speech recordings following the guidelines and instructions provided.
  • Speak using your natural dialect and accent.
  • Ensure no words are added, omitted, or altered.
  • Re-record submissions if requested to meet quality standards.
  • Complete tasks using our internal recording platform.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Mandarin Chinese.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target dialect or accent through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Ability to complete a trial voice recording to verify language variant and accent.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow detailed instructions and maintain recording accuracy.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

We're looking for a Personal Injury Case Manager (Pre-Litigation) who can independently manage an assigned portfolio of California personal injury cases from day one.

You'll take ownership of case progression, client communication, medical treatment coordination, insurance follow-ups, and pre-litigation preparation. You'll work directly with attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants, and case manager assistants to ensure cases are thoroughly developed and positioned for resolution.

This is a hands-on position for someone who already understands U.S. personal injury case management. The firm expects you to work independently with minimal supervision and does not provide foundational training for remote hires.

Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of California pre-litigation personal injury cases, ensuring claims progress toward resolution and critical deadlines are met.

  • Experience coordinating medical treatment, including MRIs, injections, and follow-up care, as well as reviewing medical records and identifying treatment gaps.
  • Strong working knowledge of bodily injury insurance claims, policy searches, coverage verification, and policy limits, including commercial liability coverage.
  • Familiarity with medical liens, demand preparation, settlement workflows, and knowing when an issue requires attorney involvement.
  • Strong caseload management, organization, and deadline-tracking skills, with experience using legal case management software and working independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience handling California premises liability claims, particularly slip-and-fall and trip-and-fall cases involving commercial properties.
  • Experience preparing attorney-ready case summaries, medical chronologies, or demand-support packages.
  • Familiarity with remote desktop systems used to access U.S. law firm software and case files.
  • Experience coordinating or overseeing case manager assistants in a personal injury practice.

Who We Are

At IPID, we're building trust in global payments. Our account verification solutions help financial institutions, payment service providers, and enterprises verify account ownership before payments are sent, reducing fraud, improving compliance, and helping money reach the right recipient with confidence.

Founded by industry veterans from organisations including SWIFT and Thomson Reuters, IPID combines deep payments expertise with modern technology to help make global payments safer, simpler, and more reliable. As we continue to grow, we're looking for talented people who enjoy solving meaningful problems and want to make a visible impact in a fast-moving global fintech.

The Opportunity

Our customers—including global banks and payment providers—rely on IPID whenever they send a payment. As our customer base and global network grow, we’re looking for a senior, hands-on practitioner to lead post-go-live technical support and service operations.

You’ll take ownership of customer support delivery, escalations and high-severity incidents while helping us build a scalable support function. You’ll work cases and lead incidents directly, improve our processes, knowledge and tooling, and set the operational standard as the team grows.

Working closely with Technology, Product, Implementation and Customer Success, you’ll have significant influence over how we support customers worldwide.

What You'll Be Doing

Customer support

  • Own the end-to-end support process: intake, triage, investigation, resolution and customer communication.
  • Lead high-severity incidents and customer escalations, with clear ownership, timely updates and effective resolution.
  • Run service requests, technical investigations and root-cause analysis, turning lessons learned into lasting improvements.
  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders during cases and incidents, and manage maintenance and outage communications to customers.
  • Build the support knowledge base and strengthen L1 and L2 capability across the team.

Service operations

  • Monitor service quality and health against agreed service levels, and act on emerging issues.
  • Act as incident commander, coordinating remediation across technical teams.
  • Escalate operational issues to data providers in our global network and follow them through to resolution.
  • Carry out approved failover and switch-over procedures, and help define and test business-continuity capabilities.
  • Improve workflow automation and data quality across support processes and tools.
  • Apply working knowledge of networking, cryptography and information security principles when investigating incidents and assessing service risk.

Scaling support

  • Lead a cross-functional virtual support team across Technology and other functions.
  • Refine support-readiness criteria so every customer has clear escalation paths and a named support owner before go-live.
  • Track support and service performance, identify recurring issues and drive improvements with Product and Technology.
  • Help shape IPID's next generation of support, including AI-assisted capabilities, and establish practices that scale to a growing, globally distributed customer base.

Requirements

  • Experience: 8+ years in technical support, production support or service operations, including senior L2/L3 work on mission-critical production services.
  • Incident leadership: Proven experience personally managing high-severity incidents and customer escalations, coordinating technical responders and communicating clearly with customers under pressure.
  • Business-critical environments: Experience supporting services where availability, reliability and response times are critical, ideally in payments, banking, fintech, financial infrastructure or another regulated, high-availability environment.
  • Service management: Strong practical knowledge of incident, problem and change management (ITIL-style), SLA governance and root-cause analysis.
  • ICT foundation: Broad foundational knowledge of information and communications technology (ICT), including computer networking, cryptography and information security principles, acquired through specialised study in a relevant field or proven practical experience.
  • Hands-on investigation: Ability to investigate technical issues using logs, monitoring and observability tools, and API request/response data. Comfortable being the senior hands-on practitioner, not only managing a team.
  • Tooling: Experience with ticketing and observability platforms such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Elastic or Grafana, or similar.
  • Vendor and partner oversight: Experience managing an outsourced support provider against SLAs, or equivalent vendor and partner management.
  • Continuous improvement: Demonstrated ability to turn recurring support issues into runbooks, monitoring, automation, knowledge or product improvements.
  • Communication and mindset: Excellent written and spoken English, with the judgement to explain technical incidents to customers and senior non-technical stakeholders. Calm, structured and decisive, with strong ownership, and comfortable in an international, fast-changing start-up where the support model is still being established.
  • Right to work: Legal authorisation to work in the country where the role is based.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with payments infrastructure, account validation, verification of payee or financial networks.
  • Exposure to business continuity (BCP), disaster recovery (DR) or failover planning.
  • Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with vulnerability management in a live service environment, including coordinating remediation with Technology.
  • Experience working in a globally distributed start-up or high-growth company.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification or strong practical IT service-management experience.

You'll also analyze recurring delivery challenges, identify opportunities to improve technical workflows, and help leadership make informed decisions about customer engineering capacity and operational priorities.

About Bask Health

Bask Health is a telehealth technology platform that helps entrepreneurs, healthcare businesses, and brands launch, manage, and grow their own telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and business management tools in one place.

We help businesses operate their own healthcare brands without having to build all the technology and operational infrastructure themselves.

We're a fast-moving team that values initiative, ownership, and clear communication. Our teams collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to improve how our platform works and support the businesses that rely on it.

About the Role

We're looking for a GTM Strategy & Planning Lead to help Bask Health develop the commercial plans, capacity models, and investment analyses that support our growth.

You'll partner with Sales, Finance, Revenue Operations, and other commercial leaders to evaluate how our go-to-market organization is performing, understand future resource requirements, and develop plans for improving productivity and revenue outcomes.

This role combines strategic planning with financial and operational analysis. You'll build models that connect sales capacity, hiring assumptions, ramp periods, pipeline requirements, and expected productivity to commercial objectives.

You'll also evaluate different growth scenarios, help leadership understand the trade-offs behind resource decisions, and support longer-term GTM planning.

We're looking for someone who is analytical, comfortable working with complex business assumptions, and able to turn financial and operational data into practical recommendations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead strategic planning initiatives supporting Bask's go-to-market organization.
  • Develop sales capacity models that connect team resources with commercial growth objectives.
  • Analyze sales productivity and identify opportunities to improve commercial performance.
  • Build models that evaluate hiring plans, ramp periods, and expected sales output.
  • Partner with Finance to align GTM planning assumptions with financial objectives.
  • Support the development of annual and quarterly commercial operating plans.
  • Evaluate revenue scenarios based on different staffing, productivity, and investment assumptions.
  • Analyze historical sales performance to inform future planning decisions.
  • Develop pipeline coverage models to support commercial growth planning.
  • Evaluate sales cycle trends, conversion rates, and productivity assumptions.
  • Support the development and evaluation of quota-setting assumptions.
  • Analyze the impact of new sales capacity on expected pipeline and revenue.
  • Build scenario models comparing different GTM investment options.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand commercial priorities and resource requirements.
  • Evaluate merchant segments and acquisition strategies to support resource planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the allocation of commercial resources.
  • Develop recommendations for balancing growth objectives with operational efficiency.
  • Analyze differences in performance across sales roles, merchant segments, and commercial activities.
  • Support planning for new GTM initiatives and commercial expansion opportunities.
  • Evaluate the financial and operational implications of changes to the commercial operating model.
  • Work with Revenue Operations to ensure planning models use consistent performance data.
  • Collaborate with Sales Operations to understand current processes without duplicating day-to-day execution responsibilities.
  • Develop reporting that compares planned performance against actual results.
  • Identify significant differences between planning assumptions and business outcomes.
  • Recommend adjustments to capacity, productivity, or investment assumptions based on performance.
  • Prepare planning materials and strategic recommendations for commercial leadership.
  • Develop clear documentation of model assumptions, methodologies, and scenarios.
  • Support recurring strategic planning and business performance reviews.
  • Partner with Customer Success leadership when retention or expansion assumptions affect commercial planning.
  • Evaluate how merchant acquisition trends affect future commercial resource needs.
  • Develop frameworks for assessing the expected return on GTM investments.
  • Support leadership discussions involving prioritization of commercial initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the accuracy and consistency of GTM planning models.
  • Build reusable templates for capacity planning, productivity analysis, and scenario evaluation.
  • Help establish consistent definitions for planning metrics and commercial performance assumptions.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to validate business planning inputs.
  • Monitor changes in commercial performance that may affect longer-term plans.
  • Support continuous improvements to Bask's GTM planning and decision-making processes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy, Revenue Strategy, Strategic Finance, Business Operations, or a related field.
  • Experience developing strategic plans for B2B sales or go-to-market organizations.
  • Strong understanding of sales capacity planning, productivity modeling, and revenue forecasting.
  • Experience building financial or operational models involving hiring, ramp, and performance assumptions.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex financial models, scenario analysis, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience analyzing sales productivity, conversion rates, and pipeline performance.
  • Ability to evaluate quota assumptions and commercial capacity requirements.
  • Strong understanding of business planning and investment trade-offs.
  • Experience partnering with Sales, Finance, or Revenue Operations leadership.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to develop recommendations from complex business data.
  • Experience preparing planning materials and strategic analyses for leadership.
  • Strong understanding of B2B commercial metrics and revenue drivers.
  • Ability to identify and explain the assumptions behind planning models.
  • Experience comparing planned performance with actual business results.
  • Strong project management and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to model accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate financial and operational trade-offs clearly.
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of strategic initiatives.
  • Ability to manage competing planning priorities and deadlines.
  • Availability to collaborate during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in GTM strategy or planning at a SaaS company.
  • Experience supporting high-growth B2B sales organizations.
  • Familiarity with subscription, transaction-based, or usage-based revenue models.
  • Experience developing annual sales capacity and quota planning models.

  • Experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting platforms.

  • Strong organisational and CRM management skills, with a proactive approach to managing customer relationships, progressing opportunities and delivering results.

The Company offer excellent competitive benefits including enhanced annual leave, sick pay and monthly pension contributions alongside private medical cover and a discount benefit hub.

This role will also come with a Company vehicle available for personal use.

Sumsubis the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, and Kaizen Gaming.

Sumsub is recognized as a Great Place To Work® in the US and rated 4.5 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

Now we are looking for a Senior Finance Manager to help business teams make informed financial decisions across multiple entities and jurisdictions. This role is an exciting opportunity to combine business partnership with ownership of entity reporting, from month-end close to IFRS financial statements.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Partner with business stakeholders on commercial arrangements and operational changes, challenge assumptions and flag financial risks early.

  • Analyse revenue, costs, margins and collections, explain the underlying business drivers and work with stakeholders to act on your recommendations.

  • Own month-end close for assigned entities, coordinating accountants and functional owners on postings, accruals and reconciliations. Review P&L, balance sheet and receivables, explain movements and reconcile preliminary and final results on time.

  • Prepare standalone financial statements and reporting packages under group IFRS requirements, and coordinate local statutory reporting and audits with external advisers.

  • Work with Tax on calculations, balances and reporting inputs, ensuring correct accounting treatment and resolving discrepancies.

  • Review intercompany balances, charges and supporting calculations, and coordinate with the consolidation owner.

  • Improve NetSuite reporting, financial controls and data quality, investigate integration issues and follow corrective actions through to completion.

About You:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Audit or a related field, with 4+ years of experience in external financial audit or financial reporting.

  • An external financial audit background, with Senior-level ownership of significant audit areas or engagements. Big Four experience is a plus.

  • Strong IFRS knowledge and a practical understanding of financial statements, month-end close and balance sheet reconciliations. ACCA Financial Reporting (formerly F7) or DipIFR is required.

  • The ability to connect financial results with business operations, assess proposed changes and explain recommendations clearly to non-finance colleagues.

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP data. NetSuite experience is a plus.

  • A curious, proactive approach, sound judgement and the ability to manage deadlines and follow issues through independently.

  • Fluent English.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility.We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters.Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation.We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global.We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Celebrating your big moments.We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design.Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

The hiring stages:TA screening -> Hiring Manager Interview -> Final Interview.

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.

We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.

This role is open to candidates in multiple countries, and compensation differs based on the candidate’s confirmed work location. For this reason, a single universal salary range is not included in this job posting.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Vice President, Solutions Architecture – Cyber and National Security to join our team!


Position Overview

The Vice President, Solutions Architecture – Cyber and National Security will provide executive leadership across a complex portfolio of cybersecurity, intelligence, engineering, and mission-focused technology programs.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, this leader will oversee technical strategy for a portfolio exceeding $50 million and will support leading organizations of at least 100 employees, including technical delivery teams, solution architects, engineers, mission specialists, and program leaders.


The Vice President will be a recognized expert and trusted leader in cybersecurity, national security technology, systems engineering, and mission solutions. This executive will operate at the intersection of technology, mission, customer relationships, people, and business—using technical credibility to build trusted partnerships, shape strategic opportunities, grow the portfolio responsibly, and develop high-performing organizations capable of delivering against complex national security challenges.


The role will coordinate closely with the Senior Vice President’s business groups, the Chief Technology Officer, chief engineers, technical fellows, business unit leaders, and other enterprise technical authorities. The objective is to align business-segment technology strategies with customer missions, operational capabilities, and long-term organizational goals.


Key Leadership Responsibilities

Enterprise and Portfolio Leadership

  • Provide executive technical leadership and business management for a national security technology portfolio exceeding $50 million.
  • Oversee complex technical delivery teams, including geographically dispersed and matrixed personnel.
  • Establish the portfolio’s strategic direction, operating priorities, technology roadmap, investment strategy, and growth objectives.
  • Balance near-term operational delivery with long-term capability development, customer engagement, workforce planning, and strategic growth.
  • Maintain accountability for portfolio performance, customer satisfaction, technical quality, financial results, staffing, risk management, and contract execution.
  • Build an organization capable of sustaining mission impact and growth beyond the executive’s direct involvement.
  • Develop and empower project, technical, and functional leaders by providing context, decision space, accountability, and clear strategic direction.
  • Establish succession plans and leadership development strategies for critical technical and operational roles.
  • Promote a culture of mission focus, technical excellence, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Technical and Mission Leadership

  • Serve as a recognized technical authority and strategic leader in cybersecurity, cyber operations, systems engineering, mission engineering, intelligence technologies, architecture, or related disciplines.
  • Set the technical vision and direction for the portfolio in alignment with customer mission priorities and enterprise technology strategy.
  • Translate complex national security challenges into executable engineering, architecture, staffing, and delivery strategies.
  • Lead the development of practical, scalable, and differentiated technology solutions for difficult customer requirements.
  • Partner with technical leaders and subject matter experts in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and machine learning, digital engineering, signals intelligence, geospatial intelligence, cryptography, cloud, software engineering, and related fields.
  • Promote technical quality and disciplined systems engineering across architectures, tools, platforms, prototypes, and mission solutions.
  • Shape internal research and development priorities, technical investments, capability roadmaps, and transition strategies based on future customer demand.
  • Identify capability gaps, emerging mission requirements, technology trends, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
  • Ensure that proposed and delivered solutions are technically sound, operationally relevant, executable, and aligned with customer authorities and constraints.
  • Guide the transition of prototypes, research, and innovative concepts into operational capabilities and sustainable customer solutions.

Customer and Strategic Relationship Leadership

  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with senior government, military, intelligence, and industry stakeholders.
  • Engage directly with senior customers to understand mission priorities, emerging requirements, capability gaps, and long-term objectives.
  • Build credibility through technical fluency, mission understanding, candid advice, sound judgment, and consistent delivery.
  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that define:
    • Customer priorities and mission outcomes
    • The technical value proposition
    • Appropriate relationship pathways
    • Required internal capabilities and leadership
    • Near-term and long-term engagement objectives
  • Translate customer challenges into differentiated technical solutions and actionable growth strategies.
  • Lead strategic engagements with domestic and international mission partners, as appropriate.
  • Build coalitions across organizational boundaries and align multidisciplinary expertise around shared mission outcomes.
  • Sustain relationships through delivery excellence, transparent communication, responsible stewardship, and measurable mission impact.

Growth, Capture, and Solution Architecture

  • Provide executive leadership for major pursuits, proposals, capture efforts, whitepapers, requests for information, and customer solution engagements.
  • Lead the architecture of integrated solutions that combine technology, people, processes, staffing, management, transition, and operational delivery components.
  • Ensure solution strategies are aligned with customer objectives, organizational strengths, available talent, affordability, and execution risk.
  • Guide proposal and capture teams in developing innovative, compelling, compliant, and executable solutions.
  • Work with business development and operations leaders to identify emerging requirements and position the organization for long-term growth.
  • Connect embedded personnel, project leaders, technical experts, and executive stakeholders to develop a comprehensive understanding of customer needs.
  • Enable delivery and technical leaders to engage customers with purpose and connect executive strategy to technical execution.
  • Establish differentiated value propositions based on mission relevance, technical excellence, delivery credibility, and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Sustain responsible portfolio growth through trusted customer relationships, strong program performance, and the development of capabilities that address meaningful mission needs.
  • Support strategic account planning, market analysis, competitive positioning, pricing strategy, staffing models, transition planning, and investment decisions.

Enterprise Technology Alignment

  • Coordinate with the Senior Vice President, CTO, chief engineers, Fellows, business unit leaders, and other technical executives to align technology strategies across the organization.
  • Connect business-segment technology solutions with enterprise priorities, customer missions, and long-term organizational strategy.
  • Promote reuse of proven architectures, tools, frameworks, talent, and technical capabilities across business units.
  • Identify opportunities for collaboration, integration, and cross-portfolio capability development.
  • Establish governance mechanisms to ensure consistency in architecture, engineering quality, technical risk management, and technology investment.
  • Represent the organization in executive, customer, industry, and technical forums.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams supporting cybersecurity, intelligence, engineering, and mission-focused programs.
  • Provide technical and organizational leadership for complex programs and delivery environments.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to understand current capabilities, delivery performance, customer outcomes, lessons learned, and differentiators.
  • Use delivery insights to improve future solutions, strengthen customer relationships, and inform investment priorities.
  • Lead the creation of technical architectures, operating models, staffing strategies, management approaches, and transition plans.
  • Deliver executive briefings, technical presentations, whitepapers, proposal content, and customer-facing recommendations.
  • Establish standards, methodologies, templates, and processes that improve the quality and efficiency of solution development and technical delivery.
  • Ensure that technical concepts are communicated effectively to both technical and nontechnical decision-makers.
  • Monitor emerging technologies, market trends, mission priorities, and competitive developments.
  • Drive continuous improvement across solution architecture, technical delivery, customer engagement, and organizational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable security, contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

What Required Skills You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, computer engineering, systems engineering, information technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically, 15 or more years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, cyber operations, national security technology, engineering, intelligence, mission systems, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees and managing complex technical or mission delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio exceeding $50 million, including responsibility for financial performance, customer relationships, delivery outcomes, workforce planning, and growth.
  • Recognized expertise and leadership in at least one relevant technical discipline, such as:
    • Offensive or defensive cyber operations
    • Cybersecurity engineering
    • Systems engineering and architecture
    • Intelligence mission systems
    • Cloud and software engineering
    • Artificial intelligence and machine learning
    • Signals or geospatial intelligence
    • Cryptography or advanced mission technologies
  • Demonstrated success aligning technical strategy with customer mission needs and long-term business objectives.
  • Experience coordinating across business units and partnering with senior executives, CTO organizations, chief engineers, technical fellows, and other enterprise leaders.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior government, military, intelligence, and industry customers.
  • Demonstrated success leading major proposals, captures, solution architectures, RFIs, whitepapers, strategic engagements, or other growth initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of government contracting, federal acquisition, customer engagement, program delivery, and technical solution development.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex customer challenges into practical, differentiated, and executable technical solutions.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, customer, and nontechnical audiences.
  • Experience developing technical leaders and building high-performing, multidisciplinary organizations.
  • Active TS/SCI clearance, with the ability to maintain the clearance. Polygraph eligibility or an existing CI or full-scope polygraph is preferred.

What Desired Skills You'll Bring:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant technical, business, national security, or management discipline.
  • Experience leading national security portfolios with more than 50 programs or major customer engagements.
  • Experience leading matrixed organizations with more than 300 personnel in addition to direct staff.
  • Experience supporting senior-level cyber, intelligence, defense, or national security organizations.
  • Experience integrating government civilians, military personnel, contractors, mission partners, and technical specialists around high-priority requirements.

Our Team:

Cimpress is creating a new business called Cimpress Open whose mandate will be to excel at serving customers via third-party channels. We will partner with companies that have strong customer relationships with end-customers who need mass-customized print products. In its initial stage, Cimpress Open will pursue opportunities with digital design software partners and established ecommerce marketplace platforms. This approach will evolve and expand over time as we establish a presence in these new segments.

We're looking for a Category Manager to own category execution across a growing part of our marketplace portfolio, reporting to the Senior Category Manager. You'll take direct, end-to-end ownership of category management for one or more partners beyond Amazon as we expand outside our initial marketplace, while also driving the NPI pipeline, forecasting rigor, and cross-functional coordination that keep product launches on track.

This is a genuine category ownership role, not a pure coordination or operations position. You'll be accountable for launch outcomes, forecast accuracy, and performance for your slice of the business, working closely with the Senior Category Manager on overall category strategy and Amazon execution.

What You Will Do:

  • Own category management for partners beyond Amazon, end to end — launch pipeline, category forecast, and performance
  • Manage NPI operations discovery: partner with Operations to gather and validate SKU-level details — specs, production feasibility, fulfillment requirements — for every new product launch
  • Own and drive adoption of the NPI workflow (currently piloting on Jira), taking it from pilot to steady-state process
  • Build and maintain category-level forecasts (volume, revenue, margin) for your scope, extending to weekly-level granularity and actuals-vs-forecast tracking
  • Support product lifecycle management execution, including running PLM independently when the Senior Category Manager is unavailable
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Channel, Operations, Product Owners, Production, and Fulfillment for your category scope
  • Define and supervise category KPIs for your scope, flagging risks before they show up in retrospective reporting
  • Present category performance, forecasts, and risks to the Senior Category Manager and, as scope grows, to broader leadership

Your Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of category management, ecommerce, or related commercial experience, including some ownership of a product portfolio and/or launch pipeline
  • Self-starter comfortable in a fast-moving, evolving setup, with scope expected to grow over time
  • Data-driven and structured, with the judgment to flag risks early and manage performance proactively
  • Proficient using AI tools to accelerate category work — comfortable with using LLMs to synthesize market and competitive research, draft category reporting, and support forecasting and variance analysis. Nice-to-have: familiar with Amazon's AI-powered seller tools (Brand Analytics / Search Query Performance, Assortment Opportunity Explorer)
  • Experience coordinating cross-functionally (Operations, Fulfillment, Finance, Merchandising, Creatives, Advertising, Pricing, Product, Analytics)
  • Fluent English required; German, French, Italian, or Spanish is a plus

Why You'll Love Working Here:

Being at Cimpress means that you don’t see work as just a building, a desk or a manufacturing floor. You see it as a chance to take a step forward in your career journey – and your life. We strive to give you everything you need to learn, grow, and succeed. Through innovation, collaboration, and perpetual exposure to what’s next, we’re always pushing boundaries and broadening our horizons. We embrace the chance to operate outside of our comfort zone to discover what we’re capable of. Some might call that a challenge; we just call it another great day at work.

We're Remote-First:

In 2020, Cimpress adopted a Remote-First operating model and culture. We heard from our team members that having the freedom, autonomy and trust in each other to work from home and, the ability to operate when they are most productive, empowers them to be their best. Cimpress also provides collaboration spaces for team members to work physically together when it's safe to do so and when in-person collaboration will deliver the best results.

About Us:

Led by founder and CEO Robert Keane, Cimpress invests in and helps build customer-focused, entrepreneurial mass customization businesses. Through the personalized physical (and digital) products these companies create, we empower over 17 million global customers to make an impression. Last year, Cimpress generated $2.88B in revenue through customized print products, signage, apparel, packaging and more. The Cimpress family includes a dynamic, international group of businesses and central teams, all working to solve problems, build businesses, innovate and improve.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion:

We believe in the unique contributions of everyone within a diverse global organization. We are collaborative, inclusive, and innovative. We strive to role model and live an inclusive culture of fairness, respect and belonging for all. And we work together to empower each other, creating a space in which each of us can spark our next great idea.

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national or ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion, citizenship, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender presentation, legal or preferred name, marital status, pregnancy, family structure, veteran status or any other basis protected by human rights laws or regulations. raw.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is a telepsychiatry platform delivering psychiatric evaluation, medication management, and ongoing behavioral health care to patients in approximately 35 states.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is a telepsychiatry platform delivering psychiatric evaluation, medication management, and ongoing behavioral health care to patients in approximately 35 states. We operate through a management services organization supporting affiliated professional corporations, and our clinicians treat conditions that require careful, closely governed prescribing, including controlled substances.

We are now building the commercial insurance infrastructure that will define our next phase of growth. Seeing insured patients and being reimbursed for that care depends on three things moving together: contracts with the right payers, provider credentialing and enrollment in every state we serve, and the operating infrastructure behind them. Each one gates the others. This role brings them under one owner.

About the Role

We are hiring a Head of Payer Strategy & Operations to own MEDvidi’s insurance business end to end, from zero to a scalable, commercially successful offering.

This is a hands-on executive role reporting to the CEO. You will set payer strategy, negotiate with payers, own provider credentialing and enrollment, and define the operational infrastructure needed to see insured patients and get paid, doing much of that work yourself while building the function around you.

You will work daily with Clinical leadership, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and Compliance, and Provider Recruiting. Revenue cycle management sits within Finance with a dotted line to this role. This is a full-time, remote position based in the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Payer strategy. Map the payer and state landscape: which commercial payers cover the most of our patients and provider licenses, ranked by commercial value; deliver a sequenced contracting roadmap.
  • Payer contracting. Identify, approach, and negotiate with payers on rates, fee schedules, telehealth coverage and parity terms, and codes relevant to psychiatric evaluation and medication management visits. Model contract economics with Finance and set walk-away positions before every negotiation.
  • Payer relationships. Own relationships after signature: escalations, rate renewals, policy changes, network adequacy, and performance reviews.
  • Credentialing and enrollment. Own the end-to-end process across CAQH, payer applications, licensure alignment, and re-attestation; set cycle-time targets and track status by provider, payer, and state. Decide build vs. vendor vs. delegated credentialing, and run the chosen setup.
  • Provider coverage. Work with Provider Recruiting so that hiring and licensing priorities follow payer-state coverage, not the other way round.
  • Billing infrastructure. Define requirements for insurance intake, eligibility verification, claims submission, ERA/EFT, clearinghouse, and billing data across the Patient Portal, Provider Portal, and EHR, and agree priorities with Product and Engineering.
  • Revenue cycle performance. Jointly own RCM KPIs with Finance (clean-claim rate, denial rate, days in A/R, payment posting lag), build payer performance dashboards, and set documentation and coding standards with Clinical and Compliance so visits are billed correctly from the first claim.
  • Commercial and partnerships. Develop a point of view on B2B opportunities and alternative distribution channels, such as employer, health-system, payer-referral, and enterprise partnerships; size them and recommend whether and how to pursue them.
  • Team and vendors. Start as a hands-on builder; hire and lead payer contracting, credentialing, and analytics roles as volume justifies it. Select and manage vendors and advisors (credentialing, clearinghouse, RCM, consulting) against defined SLAs.

Requirements

  • 10+ years in payer strategy, provider or network contracting, or payer-facing leadership in healthcare, including 5+ years in senior leadership.
  • A track record of having done this before: launched or scaled in-network commercial insurance for a provider organization, telehealth, or digital health company, and personally negotiated contracts with national or regional commercial payers.
  • Hands-on experience with multi-state credentialing and enrollment, including CAQH, payer applications, and licensure dependencies.
  • Working knowledge of fee-for-service reimbursement, fee schedules, telehealth coverage and parity, E&M and behavioral health coding, denials and appeals, and core RCM metrics.
  • Financial modeling skills: able to build and defend a contract-economics model with Finance.
  • Comfort operating without a team at the start: a player-coach who builds from zero and reports directly to a CEO.
  • Based in the U.S. and authorized to work in the U.S.; fluent English; able to work core hours across U.S. time zones.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience at a telehealth or digital health company, ideally in behavioral health or psychiatry with medication management.
  • Strategic partnerships or business development experience, including B2B or channel work with payers, employers, or health systems.
  • Medicare Advantage, TRICARE, or Medicaid managed care contracting experience.
  • Payer-side background (network strategy or provider contracting at a health plan) with active relationships.
  • Experience in a professional corporation / management services organization structure.
  • Value-based or outcomes-based contract design experience.
  • MBA, MHA, or J.D.

What we offer

  • Time off: Paid time off (PTO), plus paid sick leave.
  • Wellness: Dedicated wellness days each year to rest and recharge.
  • Retirement: 401(k) with company matching.
  • Health & insurance: QSEHRA eligibility toward medical and dental insurance coverage.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Your primary focus will be managing creators and their agents, from discovery and negotiation through to content approval and publication. You’ll also take on wider campaign-management responsibilities when required, coordinating stakeholders and keeping delivery on track against tight deadlines.

Some flexibility will be required around live events and fixed go-live dates, with working arrangements agreed before booking.

  • Collaborate with strategy, data and client-service teams.

  • Proven responsibility for delivering creator campaigns from briefing through to completion.

  • Experience managing mid-tier, macro or VIP creators and their agents.

  • Strong negotiation, relationship-management and stakeholder-coordination skills.

  • Excellent organisation and confidence managing competing deadlines independently.

  • Experience with influencer platforms, campaign tracking and reporting.

  • Familiarity with UK advertising disclosure requirements and content approval processes.

  • Availability for the full booking and UK working hours.

  • Experience working in fast-paced agency environments, with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.

Live-event experience, international campaigns and high-value creator contracts would be advantageous. Portuguese is welcome but not essential.

Apply through NoSweat with:

  • Two or three campaigns you personally managed, identifying the agency, brand, creator tiers, your contribution and results.

  • Examples of managing agents, negotiations, approvals or challenging deadlines.
