About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

The Customer Success team at Anaconda is the primary relationship layer between our platform and the enterprise organizations that depend on it — from data scientists and ML engineers to IT architects and security teams managing open-source risk at scale. We help customers get real, measurable value from Anaconda's product suite by building trust, showing up prepared, and staying curious about what each customer is actually trying to solve.

As a Senior Technical Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts and operate as the voice of the customer across the organization. You bring deep technical fluency (across Python packaging, environment management, and enterprise security and governance) and you use it to close the gap between what customers deploy and the value they actually realize. You're not here to just manage relationships. You're here to set the standard for how we engage technically and commercially, and to leave the function stronger than you found it.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Build deep relationships across complex organizations (from data scientists and platform engineers to IT architects, security leads, and C-suite stakeholders) well beyond the initial point of contact.
  • Accelerate onboarding and initial adoption. Guide customers through first-use milestones: environment setup, CVE policy configuration, private repo and channel tokenization, and initial workflow adoption, coding assistant & quick start processes. Identify and resolve technical blockers before they threaten time-to-value.
  • Drive ongoing usage health and consumption. Monitor seat utilization, package and channel usage, and admin portal signals to identify underused licenses, stalled users, or shadow IT risk. Proactively engage the AE when usage patterns suggest expansion opportunity or churn risk.
  • Arrive at every customer interaction with a prepared point of view. Draw on product usage data, health scores, and technical signals to drive conversations forward and deliver clear value at each touchpoint. No filler meetings.
  • Own the technical inputs to account health scoring. Surface risk early (unresolved CVE exposure, blocked package access, unmanaged environments) and coordinate mitigation plans with the RM, Support, and FDE.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Channel technical requirements, competitive intelligence, and enhancement requests. Partner with Solutions Engineering on where Anaconda complements or competes with adjacent platforms in the customer's stack.
  • Build the technical narrative for QBRs and executive engagement. Partner with the account team to document use cases, quantify value delivered (time saved, risk reduced, packages secured), and make the business case stick at the executive level.
  • Support renewal and expansion. Bring technical proof points into renewal conversations (usage data, security posture improvements, workshop outcomes), advise the RM on churn forecast based on adoption and usage signals, and flag technical expansion whitespace — new teams, new use cases, adjacent workloads — to the AE for commercial pursuit.
  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Build AI-enabled success approaches the team actually adopts. Know where AI belongs in the customer motion and where human judgment stays central. Your standard becomes the team's standard.
  • Contribute to playbook development and team infrastructure. Senior TSMs are expected to leave the function stronger than they found it — through documentation, engagement templates, peer coaching, and process improvements that raise overall team performance.
  • Mentor and coach less experienced team members through account reviews, technical strategy sessions, and informal guidance. Translate personal experience into repeatable, teachable approaches.
  • Operate within a GTM pod. Sit alongside the Account Executive, Renewal Manager, Solutions Engineer, and other pod roles (FDE, BDR, TAM where applicable) under a shared pod leader. Attend weekly pod and pipeline meetings and collaborate closely with the AE on account plans, customer relationships, and QBRs.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Net revenue retention (NRR) across your enterprise portfolio
  • Customer health score trends and reduction in at-risk accounts
  • Time-to-value and adoption depth across your book of business
  • Quality and completeness of success plans, technical documentation, and account records
  • Expansion pipeline sourced from within existing accounts
  • AI-enabled workflows or playbook contributions adopted by peers

What You’ll Need:

  • 6+ years in a technical customer-facing role — customer success, technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar — with demonstrated ownership of a £4 million+ book of business and accountability for retention and growth outcomes at large enterprise accounts (10,000+ employees)
  • Understanding of enterprise security and governance concepts relevant to Anaconda: CVE exposure, package provenance, air-gapped and private repo deployment, SSO, and gated registration
  • Experience with data science, ML, or developer tooling platforms — Databricks, Domino, Dataiku, SageMaker, or similar — and familiarity with how Anaconda fits into or alongside these environments
  • Ability to read logs and error output to triage technical issues before escalating to Support or Professional Services — you know the difference between self-resolving, routing to Support, and escalating to Product
  • Proven ability to build relationships across complex organizations — from practitioners to VP and C-suite stakeholders — and translate technical risk and product capability into executive-level business impact
  • Familiarity with adjacent and competitive tooling — SageMaker, Databricks, Snowflake, Vertex AI — sufficient to position Anaconda's complement-vs.-compete story credibly
  • Project management skills to coordinate multi-stakeholder technical engagements: onboarding, workshops, proofs of concept
  • Strong verbal and written communication across all levels of an organization, including executive audiences
  • AI fluency in daily work — comfortable using AI tools to research, document, prepare, and draft; rigorous about reviewing what you produce under your name before it reaches a customer
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • Experience at a high-growth or early-stage company where the playbook wasn't written yet — you've helped build structure from scratch, operated with autonomy, and stayed effective when priorities shifted underneath you
  • Working fluency in Python packaging and environment management — conda, pip, pixi, and the tradeoffs between them — and the ability to hold a substantive technical conversation without SE support in routine scenarios
  • Deep familiarity with open-source ecosystems — software supply chain security, dependency management, license compliance exposure, and vulnerability workflows — and the ability to speak credibly to a CISO or VP Engineering about why it matters
  • A history of contributing to team infrastructure — playbooks, engagement templates, peer coaching, or process improvements that raised overall team performance, not just your own numbers
  • Experience in a high-growth, open-source, or data science-oriented company where customer needs evolve quickly and the product is still maturing
  • AI-enabled workflow contributions — you've built something others use, not just used AI for yourself; you've made a judgment call about where AI doesn't belong and explained why
  • You embody our values — Curious by Default, Build Together, Own It, and Lead with Guts and Heart — and our behaviors: Clarity, Care, and Candor
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise.
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor.
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth.

There is no application deadline; we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

By clicking “Submit Application”, you acknowledge you have read our Privacy Policy and that Anaconda can retain your application data for up to 1-year, unless otherwise stated. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Data Governance Analyst is an essential operational contributor on the Data Governance team, responsible for executing and sustaining governance practices across data quality, metadata, standards, and lifecycle management. Working alongside governance operations leaders, business data stewards, and technology teams, this role provides the analytical depth and hands-on execution that keeps governance processes running reliably and data assets well-documented. The Analyst plays a pivotal role in identifying, investigating, and resolving data quality issues that affect the accuracy of Medicare Advantage operations — from member eligibility and claims processing to provider data and risk adjustment reporting.

JOB DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Data Issue Analysis & Root Cause Resolution
Investigate data inconsistencies, anomalies, and quality failures across enterprise systems and data pipelines, performing thorough root cause analysis toidentifythe source and scope of issues. Document findings, recommend corrective actions, and collaborate with technical and business teams to drivetimelyresolution and prevent recurrence.

2. Data Quality Lifecycle Support
Support the definition, implementation, monitoring, and resolution of data quality rules and thresholds across key enterprise data domains. Track quality metrics over time, preparesummary reporting for governance stakeholders, and flag deteriorating trends that require escalation or intervention.

3. Metadata & Documentation Management
Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and currency of the enterprise data glossary, metadata catalog, and lineage documentation across governed data assets. Partner with data stewards and platform teams to ensure new and modified data assets are cataloged consistently andin accordance withgovernance standards.

4. Governance Lifecycle Tracking & Reporting
Track governance issues, decisions, and action items through their full lifecycle — from intake through resolution and adoption — using governance workflow tools and tracking systems. Produce regular status reports and dashboards that keep governance leaders and business stakeholders informed of open items, resolution progress, and trend patterns.

5. Data Integration & Validation Support
Support the validation of data across integration, transformation, and enrichment processes by executing data checks, comparing source-to-target results, andidentifyingdiscrepancies that require governance review. Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure governance validation standards are applied consistently within data pipelines.

6. Compliance & Regulatory Data Support
Assist in ensuring that governed data assets meet HIPAA privacy requirements, CMS reporting standards, and Medicare Advantage-specific data obligations by supporting audit documentation, data access reviews, and compliance validation activities. Maintain awareness of regulatory data requirements and flag governance gaps that could introduce compliance risk.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This is an individual contributor role with no direct supervisory responsibilities.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Experience

Required:

  • 3–8 years of experience in data analysis, data governance, data quality management, or a related discipline

  • Demonstrated experience working with both business and technical stakeholders on data-related challenges

  • Working knowledge of data quality, metadata, and documentation practices in an enterprise environment

Preferred:

  • Healthcare industry experience, particularly in a payer, managed care, or Medicare Advantage environment

  • Exposure to data catalog, MDM, or data quality tools in a production setting

  • Familiarity with CMS data requirements, HIPAA, or healthcare claims data structures

Education

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Healthcare Informatics, Business, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered

Preferred:

  • Advanced coursework or certification in data management, data analytics, or health informatics

Training

Required:

  • Working knowledge of SQL for data querying, validation, and analysis

  • Familiarity with HIPAA data handling requirements and basic data privacy principles

Preferred:

  • Exposure to enterprise data catalog platforms (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Alation) or data quality tools (e.g.,Acceldata, Informatica DQ)

  • Introductory training in DAMA-DMBOK data management principles or equivalent governance framework

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

Technical / Role-Specific Skills

  • SQL & Data Querying:Proficiencyin SQL for data extraction, validation, comparison, and ad hoc analysis across relational databases and data warehouses

  • Data Quality Analysis & Validation:Ability to define, execute, and interpret data quality checks; experienceidentifyingdata anomalies, assessing impact, and documenting findings for governance review

  • Metadata & Documentation Management:Skill inmaintainingdata glossary entries, cataloging data assets, and documenting lineage in a consistent and accessible format

  • Data Catalog & Governance Tool Exposure:Familiarity with or willingness to developproficiencyin enterprise data catalog or MDM tools; exposure to Purview, Alation, Reltio, or equivalent platforms is a plus

  • Healthcare Data Literacy:General understanding of healthcare data structures including claims, member, provider, and encounter data relevant to Medicare Advantage operations; knowledge of ICD-10/CPT coding is beneficial

  • Analytical Reporting & Communication:Ability to synthesize data findings into clear governance status reports, quality dashboards, and issue summaries for both technical and business audiences;proficiencywith Excel or BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)

raw.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

R1 is seeking a Senior Director, Technical Product Marketing to articulate the technical foundations, architecture, and innovation behind Phare OS, the company's agentic Revenue Operating System. This leader will translate complex platform capabilities into clear, credible narratives for CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, data and AI leaders, strategic customers, analysts, investors, and executive stakeholders.


The role is less about owning the market positioning of individual Phare OS solutions and more about explaining how the platform works, why its architecture matters, and how its technical elements create durable value. The Senior Director will connect product architecture to customer and business outcomes while maintaining the depth and precision expected by sophisticated technical audiences.


Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations, Sales, and portfolio product marketers, this leader will shape platform-level technical content, executive and investor communications, and high-impact product demonstrations. The ideal candidate combines technical fluency, strategic judgment, and exceptional storytelling, with the ability to move comfortably from an architecture discussion with engineers to a boardroom or investor presentation.


Key Responsibilities

Technical platform narrative

  • Develop and maintain the technical narrative for Phare OS and its foundational capabilities, including the Data Platform, Phare Intelligence, Payer Atlas, agentic AI, workflow orchestration, interoperability, and command-center experiences.
  • Explain how shared data, intelligence, governance, and orchestration work together across the platform, avoiding isolated feature-by-feature storytelling.
  • Translate architecture, product roadmaps, and engineering concepts into clear narratives that connect technical design choices to scalability, trust, workflow performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to ensure technical claims, diagrams, terminology, and proof points are accurate, differentiated, and supportable.

Technical buyer engagement

  • Create audience-specific messaging and content for CIOs, CTOs, chief digital officers, enterprise architects, AI and data leaders, security stakeholders, and revenue cycle technology teams.
  • Develop technical presentations, architecture overviews, white papers, FAQs, solution briefs, and executive briefings that support evaluation of platform maturity, extensibility, integration, governance, and AI strategy.
  • Support strategic customer conversations, executive briefing sessions, technical workshops, and high-value sales engagements where platform depth and credibility are essential.

Investor, analyst, and executive communications

  • Partner with Executive Leadership, Corporate Strategy, Finance, and Investor Relations to explain R1's technology strategy, platform investments, innovation roadmap, and sources of technical differentiation.
  • Develop concise, evidence-based materials for investor presentations, earnings-support content, board discussions, analyst briefings, and executive thought leadership.
  • Build narratives that help non-product audiences understand the relationship between technology investment, platform reuse, product expansion, operational leverage, and long-term enterprise value without overstating product readiness or outcomes.

Product demonstration strategy

  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Engineering, and Sales to define the narrative arc for strategic Phare OS demonstrations.
  • Transform product demos from feature walkthroughs into coherent stories that show how data, intelligence, agents, workflows, and human expertise work together across the revenue cycle.
  • Create reusable demo frameworks, scripts, talk tracks, proof points, and audience-specific variants for customer meetings, executive briefings, analyst sessions, investor events, and industry conferences.
  • Establish demo-readiness standards and ensure demonstrations accurately reflect available capabilities, roadmap items, data requirements, and implementation realities.

Launch and portfolio partnership

  • Partner with portfolio product marketers on launches and commercialization, providing the technical storyline behind major capabilities, releases, and platform investments.
  • Equip sales, enablement, communications, and marketing teams with technically credible content that connects individual products to the broader Phare OS architecture.
  • Monitor developments in healthcare AI, agentic systems, data platforms, interoperability, revenue cycle technology, and enterprise software architecture, translating relevant shifts into recommendations for Product and Marketing leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, marketing, business, or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.
  • 12+ years of B2B enterprise technology experience, including significant experience in technical product marketing, platform marketing, solution marketing, product strategy, or a closely related function.
  • Demonstrated ability to market complex SaaS, cloud, data, analytics, AI, automation, or platform technologies to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts, agentic systems, data platforms, APIs, integration patterns, cloud architecture, security, governance, and enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Experience developing technical demonstrations and working directly with product managers, engineers, designers, architects, sales engineers, and executive leaders.
  • Exceptional writing, presentation, and public-speaking skills, with the judgment to simplify complexity without sacrificing technical accuracy.
  • Healthcare technology, payer-provider, or revenue cycle management experience strongly preferred.

Leadership Profile

  • Technical translator: earns credibility with product and engineering teams while making complex ideas understandable and relevant.
  • Strategic storyteller: connects architecture and innovation to business, customer, and investor value.
  • Collaborative operator: influences across functions without relying on direct authority and brings structure to ambiguous, cross-functional work.
  • Trusted steward: distinguishes current capability from roadmap vision and builds confidence through precision, transparency, and sound judgment.

Measures of Success

  • A clear, consistent, and technically credible Phare OS platform narrative adopted across executive, customer, analyst, and investor communications.
  • Higher-quality strategic demos that connect technical capabilities to differentiated customer and business outcomes.

raw.title: Client Success Advisor
raw.excerpt: Why join Safeguard Global?  👀 We want to help you “work in any way” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds.
raw.description:
Why join Safeguard Global? 👀

We want to help you “work in any way” — that means making time for family, commitments, and life outside of work so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work. 🚀

Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first—they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for a job that works for you. ✅


The role in a nutshell:

The Client Success Advisor plays a critical role in building and sustaining strong, long‑term relationships across a portfolio of small to mid‑sized clients who currently leverage a limited set of Safeguard Global services but demonstrate meaningful near‑term growth potential. As the client’s primary point of contact, the Advisor develops a deep understanding of each client’s business, translating their goals into actionable plans that drive satisfaction, retention, product adoption, and expansion. Managing a portfolio of 20–50 clients utilizing 1–2 services, the Client Success Advisor partners cross‑functionally to ensure successful service delivery, mitigate risks, and identify opportunities that support both client success and Safeguard Global’s revenue growth.


How you will make a difference:

  • Establish client relationships with operating and senior level contacts (CHRO/CFO, VPs, Directors, Global Mobility, etc.) for each account within assigned client portfolio.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, and long‑term goals, and translate that insight into success plans that drive meaningful outcomes. This includes defining desired results, identifying risks, establishing governance, and guiding adoption—ultimately turning client needs into actionable initiatives that strengthen partnership value and support revenue growth.
  • Provide timely and accurate response to client queries using all appropriate communication methods and ensuring documentation in customer service tool while maintaining CRM activities in Salesforce to provide visibility of client KPIs.
  • Develop and demonstrate a holistic understanding of Safeguard Global’s service suite to educate clients on advanced product capabilities, roadmap items, and best practices to maximize adoption and value.
  • Support clients in scoping exercises, ensuring a high probability of converting opportunities into revenue. Provide structured analysis for commercial teams, supporting renewal conversations, forecasting, and upsell/cross sell readiness.
  • Identify retention risks by analyzing patterns across countries, service lines, and stakeholders; then execute client “save” motions (early warning flags, intervention plans, service recovery, executive sponsor engagement, and escalation governance) to protect renewals and restore confidence through cross‑functional corrective actions.
  • Oversee end-to-end governance of portfolio delivery, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and service standards.
  • Lead business reviews, and multi stakeholder planning sessions.

What will give you an advantage:

  • Strong relationship‑building and client partnership skills; able to establish trust with operating‑level client stakeholders.
  • Solid communication skills (written, verbal, and virtual) with ability to simplify complex information for clients.
  • Effective prioritization and time‑management across a dynamic client portfolio.
  • Foundational account governance skills, including documenting client goals, risks, and success drivers.
  • Ability to interpret operational data and apply insights to improve client outcomes.
  • Problem‑solving capability and comfort working cross‑functionally to resolve issues.
  • Growth‑oriented mindset; able to identify opportunities that support product adoption and client value.
  • High attention to detail, CRM discipline, and consistency in documentation.
  • Experience in a service delivery and/or account management role with focus on client relationship and growth (customer support, operations, HR/payroll admin, or related fields preferred).
  • Familiar with upselling techniques for products or services
  • Demonstrated use of data in building account plans.
  • History of customer growth/satisfaction, and operational KPIs.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills.
  • Global client exposure, experience working in multinational environments a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience with human resource, payroll or accounting solutions experience strongly preferred.

Who we are and what we do: 

Safeguard Global is…global! We enable global expansion without the risk by helping 1,500+ customers recruit, hire, manage, and pay employees in nearly 190 countries. Join us to meet diverse talent, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe. 🌎


Our Global Benefits 

  • 👨‍💻 Autonomy and Flexibility (work in any way): Remote first, with the flexibility to include life needs like school runs and gym breaks in your schedule, all while maintaining a high standard of work.
  • 🌴 Generous leave: Enjoy a competitive leave package including paid bonding leaves for new additions to your family   
  • 🎁 Make a difference: Get 2 paid charitable days off to contribute to causes you believe in
  • 💰 Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan. 
  • ✈️ International environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.  
  • ⭐ Human centered culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.
  • 📚 Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace. 

 

Next Steps: 

To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time. 


Welcome to the Future of Work! 🌐


At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

  • Unterstütze unsere Kunden telefonisch bei Fragen zu den Softwarelösungen MD Ambulant und MD Stationär

  • Bereitschaft zur Übernahme von Rufbereitschaften nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung
  • Interesse daran, Dich in neue Softwareprodukte, technische Themen und Prozesse einzuarbeiten

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce Service Cloud oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Fernwartungslösungen wie TeamViewer

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Serviceorientierung Du stellst die Anliegen unserer Kunden in den Mittelpunkt und schaffst durch verlässliche Unterstützung Vertrauen
  • Teamgeist Du arbeitest konstruktiv mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv
  • Lösungsorientierung Du behältst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungswege

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft

raw.description:
About the role:

The Trainer and Content Developer is a member of the Altium Training team responsible for delivering high quality, industry leading training on Altium Designer and related solutions. This role combines certified Instructor Led Training delivery with active participation in training content development, reviewing, and ongoing maintenance across both ILT (instructor-led training) and on-demand formats.

This position is intended for an experienced PCB design professional with strong hands on Altium Designer experience who is comfortable delivering technical training to professional engineering audiences. The role requires a high level of technical competence, strong communication skills, and the ability to deliver consistent, high quality training experiences aligned with approved course content and learning objectives.

Customer training is a critical component of Altium’s long term success. This role directly supports customer adoption and best practice usage through professional, technically accurate, and engaging training delivery.

A day in the life of our Trainer and Content Developer:

Training Delivery

  • Deliver certified Instructor Led Training across the full Altium training portfolio, both online and onsite.
  • Complete and maintain certification across all ILT courses prior to independent delivery.
  • Deliver training using approved course materials and defined learning objectives.
  • Demonstrate Altium Designer workflows and features using practical, real world experience and knowledge.
  • Adapt delivery style to suit different customer experience levels while maintaining consistency.
  • Represent Altium professionally in all customer interactions.

Technical Expertise

  • Maintain strong hands on proficiency with Altium Designer, including advanced functionality.
  • Apply real world PCB and system design experience to contextualise training content.
  • Stay current with product updates and changes relevant to delivered training.

Content Development and Support

  • Contribute to the development, review, and maintenance of ILT and on-demand training content.
  • Assist with creating and reviewing storyboards and scripts for on-demand training, including voiceover scripts.
  • Capture training videos and audio recordings when required, following defined standards.
  • Review training materials, recorded videos, and supporting assets for technical accuracy.
  • Update existing content to align with new releases, platform changes, and evolving best practices.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work collaboratively with internal teams involved in training delivery and content development.
  • Communicate clearly regarding content readiness, preparation status, and assigned tasks.
  • Participate in reviews, pilots, and continuous improvement activities related to training quality.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • US citizenship is required due to potential training delivery on military bases.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Five + years of hands on experience using Altium Designer in professional environments.
  • Five + years of PCB and system level design experience.
  • Strong verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts to engineering audiences.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects effectively.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Willingness to travel as required for onsite customer training, including travel outside of the United States.

Preferred

  • Previous experience delivering technical training, both onsite and online.
  • Experience supporting instructional content development or reviewing.
  • Familiarity with video capture tools such as Camtasia.
  • Experience using AI based tools for voiceover or media production.
  • Exposure to structured instructional or technical documentation workflows.

Working Conditions:

  • Remote US
  • Travel required for onsite customer training as needed.

When not traveling, time will be split between online training delivery, content development

The salary range for this role is $118,000 to $141,000. Actual compensation packages within this range are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate and role requirements, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and specific location

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

raw.description:
HubSpot is looking for a Customer Success Manager who is interested in interested in leading with AI to deliver customer value, build long-lasting relationships, and help customers unlock their full HubSpot potential to achieve their goals. Customer Success Managers are the trusted inbound advisors for each of their customers. They have an intimate understanding of how their businesses work and what the businesses need to grow and thrive. In working with your customers, you will find that no two of them are the same. In the morning, you could be working with the Marketing Manager at a carpet manufacturer about how to rank for the keyword “stain resistant carpet” through more effective blogging. In the afternoon, you could be talking to the CMO of a software company about how to convert more of their free trials into customers through marketing automation and the sales platform.

This role is open is open fully remote, hybrid or in our Dublin office

In this Role you’ll get to:

  • Manage 150 – 180 customer relationships. Some of your customers will be new while others may have been using HubSpot for several years.
  • Work with your customers on a regular basis to understand their goals and aligning them with the necessary resources to achieve them.
  • Partner with different teams at HubSpot to 'solve for the customer' including onboarding, up-sell/x-sell, and renewals. Along the way, you will get to know HubSpot’s software incredibly well and help your customers fully adopt the platform.
  • Your day-to-day is a mix of proactive and reactive work, and CSMs have a lot of autonomy in managing their “book of business”. The proactive work includes 4-5 scheduled deep-dive meetings per day with customers, where you review their progress, make strategic and tactical recommendations, and keep them up to date on the latest and greatest features from HubSpot. The reactive work runs the gamut from questions about invoices to “how to” questions about the software
  • Promote the growth of your install base by uncovering, scoping and qualifying opportunities where customers can use more Hubspot products and services to ensure customer retention and growth
  • Understand technical roadblocks and make recommendations on solution implementation and core integrations using Hubspot to overcome them

If you’re stimulated by problem solving - whether it’s a business or technical challenge – this is the role for you.

To excel in this role you will need to have:

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing or account management role,
  • Business savvy with consultative, problem solving, and issue resolution skills
  • Strong knowledge of the media/digital landscape
  • Motivated self-starter who is hungry to learn and can provide strong examples of how they have achieved results while balancing demanding expectations
  • Super organised, quick learner who works well under pressure
  • Strong negotiation skills, comfortable navigating financial conversations, and dealing with cancellations
  • It’s easy for you to build and maintain relationships, manage expectations, and identify issues that require escalation
  • Knowledge of Loop Marketing, AEO, and LLM or the aptitude to learn it quickly and independently are required
  • Support an on-going partner relationship to maximise acquisition, retention, and up-sell rates

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Individual compensation packages are determined using objective, role-related criteria, which may include skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

Annual Cash Compensation Range:
€56.900—€78.235 EUR

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

raw.description:
About the Role:

Onward Search is seeking a strategic, yet hands-on Senior Vice President ofSales to lead growth across our Technology, Creative, Marketing, and related staffing and solutions businesses.

The SVP will lead and develop our sales organization while personally driving new client acquisition, expanding strategic accounts, and opening new markets and revenue opportunities.

The ideal candidate will be an accomplished sales leader with 10+ years of experience in technology staffing both as an individual producer and leader. Additionally, the candidate needs to have a proven record of success selling, breaking and expanding clients across areas of talent solutions to include: SOW, project-based, and temporary staffing.

The SVP, Sales will set strategy, build and coach our sales team, and stay actively engaged in the market. This person will be responsible for strengthening our sales engine, partnering with our marketing team, winning new logos, growing existing relationships, and delivering revenue and gross margin growth. This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for someone who thrives in building, scaling, and optimizing staffing organizations while driving meaningful revenue and gross margin growth.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the sales strategy across Onward Search’s Technology, Creative, Marketing, and related staffing and solutions businesses.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the sales organization, establishing clear expectations around revenue, gross margin, pipeline, activity, and new client acquisition.
  • Build strategies to expand into new markets, verticals, accounts, and service offerings while driving growth within existing accounts.
  • Use sales data, market insights, and performance metrics to evaluate results, identify opportunities, and adjust strategy.
  • Partner with executive leadership on company growth priorities, sales initiatives, and revenue objectives.

Business Development & Growth

  • Maintain a strong personal production focus, actively prospecting, developing new business, and winning new logos.
  • Build and manage an executive-level pipeline of high-value opportunities and relationships.
  • Lead strategic client presentations, proposals, negotiations, and closing efforts.
  • Grow existing accounts through executive relationship development, account penetration, cross-selling, and new service opportunities.
  • Represent Onward Search in the market through client meetings, networking, conferences, and industry relationships.

Team & Client Leadership

  • Drive a high-performance sales culture centered on accountability, urgency, collaboration, and results.
  • Coach the team on prospecting, pipeline development, account strategy, negotiation, and closing while monitoring individual and team performance.
  • Serve as an executive sponsor for key client relationships and develop strategies to strengthen retention and long-term growth.
  • Partner closely with recruiting, delivery, client services, and marketing to align sales strategy with client needs and market opportunities.

Success in this role will be measured by

  • Revenue, gross margin, and personal sales production
  • New client acquisition and sales pipeline growth
  • Strategic account growth, retention, and cross-selling
  • Sales team productivity and KPI achievement
  • Expansion and revenue across staffing and solutions offerings

Requirements

  • 10+ years of staffing industry sales and business development experience, including progressive sales leadership responsibility.
  • Proven track record of personally winning new clients, developing enterprise relationships, and growing significant staffing revenue.
  • Experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams while managing revenue, gross margin, pipeline and forecasting.
  • Strong network and experience selling Technology, Creative, Marketing, or related professional staffing and workforce solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contingent staffing, direct hire, MSP/VMS, SOW, and workforce solutions.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with proficiency in CRM, reporting, and sales analytics.
  • Entrepreneurial, competitive, and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to operate as both a senior leader and a hands-on producer.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Why Join Onward Search?

  • Lead the sales strategy for a well-established staffing and solutions organization with significant growth opportunity.
  • Build and shape a high-performing sales organization while remaining directly connected to the market.
  • Executive-level visibility and influence over company growth strategy.
  • Opportunity to develop new markets, clients, service offerings, and revenue streams.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, remote-first environment with significant earning potential tied to results.

Compensation

  • $150,000–$200,000 base salary, based on experience
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401(k) with company-sponsored programs
  • Generous PTO and paid holidays
  • 100% remote work environment

About Onward Group Holdings, LLC:

Onward Group Holdings, LLC is a platform of specialized talent and workforce solutions brands that connect leading organizations with expert talent across high-demand industries. The company combines deep domain expertise, proven infrastructure, and an expansive talent network to deliver solutions that go beyond traditional staffing.

With nearly 20 years in business, Onward Group Holdings partners with companies, schools, and organizations to help them build high-performing teams and thrive in the future of work. Its divisions include Onward Search (Marketing, Creative, Manufacturing & Technology), Onward Accessibility (Digital Accessibility), Onward Education (K-12 Education), and Talera (Behavioral Health).

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and a 401(k) program for eligible full-time employees, along with resources designed to support well-being and career development.

We have built a culture fostered on entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency. If you are energized by connecting people to opportunity, excited by emerging technologies, and motivated by measurable impact, you’ll fit in great with our team.

Onward is an equal opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law. 

Salary: $150,000 - $200,000

Summary

We're looking for a Next Gen Operations Coordinator to support two busy Senior Directors who lead partner Next Generation (Next Gen) teams and help with cross-functional coordination across teams and administrative support.

You'll provide critical support to the Senior Directors’ daily operating rhythm, prioritize competing demands, track critical deadlines, and remove administrative workload from their portfolios. With no direct reports, you will also be the connective tissue in translating busy team schedules into structured timelines to ensure initiatives move forward with clarity and speed.

Flexibility to travel and work across different time zones required.

Key Responsibilities

1. Direct support for two Senior Directors

  • Apply situational awareness to triage and optimize daily schedules within Canopy’s project management tool, ensuring critical tasks are prioritized, and high-urgency items take precedence.
  • Proactively provide deadline reminders, track deliverables, and respond to requests within a delegated scope to maintain a high-velocity communication loop.
  • Provide comprehensive administrative support including calendar management, organization of team meetings, creation of meeting agendas, reimbursement requests, and general operational logistics.
  • Report to the Impact Operations Senior Coordinator and exercise judgement to keep your work aligned with wider Impact team objectives and timelines, while supporting both Senior Directors’ day to day.

2. Cross-Functional Coordination and Communication

  • Be the connective tissue for the Next Gen teams and other teams (larger Impact, Operations, People and Culture teams) in the organization.
  • Design, implement, and maintain cross-team systems to seamlessly coordinate conferences and event participation, cross-team collaboration, and engagement with external parties.
  • Own and develop the cadence and facilitation of cross-functional meetings, establishing clear agendas and action steps to optimize participant time and outcomes.
  • Lead the logistics, planning, and execution of in-person team summits and collaborative workshops.
  • Drive end-to-end organization of professional development workshops, team deep dives, and specialized staff training programs.

3. Growth Opportunities

  • Identify, propose, and take ownership of special projects and team support.
  • Participate in Impact efforts by providing project management and other support.
  • Attend and represent Canopy at select events.
  • Drive the follow-through and organizational clarity that lets the Senior Directors operate at their highest level.
  • Ensure the Next Generation teams have strong visibility into priorities and progress to function as a cohesive unit.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Three to five years in executive assistant, operations coordinator, or leadership support roles in a complex and fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable in a remote-work environment; tech-savvy and quick to learn new tools.
  • Experience working in sustainability, forest conservation, supply chains, or mission-driven environments is an asset.
  • Exceptionally organized and dependable.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions oriented.
  • A thoughtful, clear, and influential communicator.
  • Embrace a “Yes, AND...” mindset to foster innovation and collaboration
  • A sense of humour!

Assets

  • Experience with Asana or similar project management tools.
  • Environmental experience and/or interest.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a cover letter which includes a separate response to the prompt below. Applications missing either the cover letter or the prompt response will not be considered. Please keep your response to 300–400 words.

Describe a specific situation where you had to support a busy leader navigating competing priorities. Using the STAR method, introduce the situation and challenges. Be sure to detail your internal logic, the frameworks or tools you used to triage the issues and summarize the quantifiable results.

On AI use and authenticity: You may use AI tools to brainstorm, edit, or proofread, but please do not use AI to write your cover letter. We want to hear your voice, experiences, and perspective. If you use AI for minor editing, add a short note at the end of your cover letter (e.g., "I used [tool name] to proofread this response"). Applications written in a genuine, original voice will be prioritized.

Canopy is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including those underrepresented in the sector. If you require accommodations at any stage, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs. All applications are treated in confidence. We thank all applicants; however, we will only contact candidates selected for an interview.

If you love to optimize operations by proactively supporting directors and busy teams, this role is for you!

Canopy is a solutions-driven not-for-profit environmental organization dedicated to protecting forests, species, and the climate. For more than 25 years, we've been transforming wood-based supply chains, from publishing and packaging to fashion and textiles, to eliminate fibre from the world's most critical forests and help secure a thriving planet for all.

Salary: CAD$66,950 – $85,000

Job Title:

Business Development Director, Data Centers (Western Europe & Nordics)

IMI plc 

We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world – creating lasting impact for everyone. 

We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport. 

Climate Control offers hydraulic solutions for water-based heating and cooling systems to achieve a perfect indoor climate with minimal energy consumption. Our leading brands have been used in over 100,000 building projects worldwide and offer products and solutions in three key areas: Pressure maintenance and water quality, regulation, control and actuators, and thermostatic control. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Business Development Director, Data Centers to accelerate our growth into Global accounts positioned with presence and decision making located across Europe (concentration of networking will include, but not limited to, Western Europe & the Nordics).

This is a senior commercial role requiring direct experience selling into the senior level decision makers in the Data Center industry. You will develop and grow strategic customer relationships, identify major projects and build a strong pipeline across hyperscale, colocation, neocloud and select OEM providers of cooling technologies.

You will work closely with customers, consultants influencers, and internal engineering teams to position IMI’s cooling, hydronic and flow-control solutions within mission-critical Data Center environments.

Work Environment: Hybrid/Remote

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Market Development: Develop and execute the Data Center growth strategy across Western Europe & the Nordics, identifying new-build, expansion and infrastructure opportunities.
  • Business Development: Build and convert a strong pipeline across OEM, distribution partner, hyperscale, colocation and neocloud Data Center customers.
  • Strategic Relationships: Develop senior relationships with Data Center owners/operators, hyperscalers, colocation providers, consultants, A&E firms, EPCs and engineering partners.
  • Complex Deal Management: Lead high-value, multi-stakeholder opportunities from early engagement and specification through commercial negotiation and close.
  • Customer Value: Partner with product and engineering teams to position IMI’s capabilities in hydronic balancing, HVAC flow control and liquid cooling around efficiency, reliability and Total Cost of Ownership.
  • Market Intelligence: Monitor Data Center investment, customer requirements, cooling trends and competitor activity to identify new opportunities.
  • Industry Presence: Represent IMI at key Data Center events, conferences and customer forums.
  • Internal Collaboration: Work across sales, finance, product, engineering, operations and logistics to ensure successful project delivery.

Critical Competencies for Success

  • Minimum 7 years of B2B sales, business development or strategic account experience.
  • Direct commercial experience within the Data Center industry is required, ideally 5+ years.
  • Proven track record of developing and winning Data Center projects or strategic accounts.
  • Strong network across Data Center owners/operators, hyperscalers, colocation providers, consultants, EPCs and/or engineering partners.
  • Good understanding of the Data Center project lifecycle, from design and specification through procurement and delivery.
  • Experience managing complex, technical and multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Understanding of mission-critical cooling environments, ideally including HVAC, hydronics, flow control and/or liquid cooling.
  • Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to engage credibly with both executive and technical stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable operating independently across a regional market.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% across Europe.

Health & Safety 

The physical demands described within the Key Duties & Responsibilities section of this job description are required to perform the essential functions of this position.  Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.  Please contact the talent team to discuss the specific Work Conditions and Physical Requirements of this role.   

Health, Safety, and Environmental Duties – At IMI we are all personally committed to protecting our people, minimizing our impact to the environment, the communities we operate in and our company. All members of our workforce have the duty to ensure the health, safety and welfare of themselves, others, and the environment. Every employee is expected to follow all HSE operating procedures, also to challenge any observed behaviors or unsafe acts. 

Code of Ethics 

IMI requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, particularly with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and the authorities. In accordance with the IMI Way: Our Code of Responsible Business. 

Changes to This Job Description 

IMI may amend this job description in whole or part at any time. 

IMI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status.

About Orbia Connectivity Solutions Dura-Line:

As a leading global manufacturer of conduit products and accessories, Dura‑Line creates the pathways that power connectivity across a wide range of markets worldwide. Be part of our shared mission with Orbia to Advance Life Around the World.

Are you a detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys working across countries, improving processes, and ensuring high-quality financial reporting? Dura-Line, an Orbia Business, is looking for a motivated Financial Accountant – Europe to join our European Finance team.

In this regional role, you will contribute to our growing accounting and compliance function and collaborate with Finance teams, the Shared Service Center, external advisors, auditors, service providers, and business stakeholders across Europe. You will help us build consistent, reliable, and sustainable accounting processes across multiple countries.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Month-End Closing: Support the month-end close process, including journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and completion of the close checklist.

  • Audit Support: Assist with external audits by preparing schedules, gathering supporting documentation, and following up on audit requests.

  • Statutory Reporting: Prepare statutory reporting schedules and reconcile SAP records with local statutory financial statements.

  • Tax and Compliance Coordination: Work closely with external advisors on local taxes, statutory reporting, and country-specific compliance requirements.

  • Shared Service Center Collaboration: Follow up on outstanding items with the Shared Service Center and external service providers, supporting the timely resolution of accounting issues.

  • Process Documentation and Controls: Maintain accounting process manuals, checklists, and internal control documentation.

  • Regional Finance Projects: Support regional initiatives, including e-invoicing projects and the implementation of new systems and accounting solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Cooperation: Partner with Commercial, Procurement, Operations, plant teams, and other Finance stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure consistent processes across the region.

Requirements:

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or an equivalent practical background.

  • Preferably at least 2 years of relevant accounting experience.

  • Good understanding of accounting principles, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP system.

  • Confidence working with numbers, financial data, and Microsoft Excel.

  • Fluent English; Polish or another European language would be an advantage.

  • Excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, combined with a collaborative and customer-focused mindset.

What You Can Expect:

  • The opportunity to contribute to the development of consistent and sustainable accounting processes.

  • Collaboration with teams and external partners across multiple European countries.

  • Involvement in accounting, compliance, audit, e-invoicing, and systems implementation projects.

  • A remote-working opportunity, with Poland as the preferred location.

If you are ready to develop your accounting expertise in an international environment and help strengthen our European finance processes, we would be happy to hear from you. Apply today and join Dura-Line, an Orbia Business.

Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

Now we are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to join our team!

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Providing technical support, configuration, and troubleshooting for issues with the Sumsub platform for our B2B clients.

  • Performing a technical analysis of reported problems and define plans for resolving them.

  • Interacting daily with other engineers to provide technical action plans or take ownership of cases that require escalation.

  • Collaborating closely with other teams to answer clients’ technical questions, acting as a liaison between the client and internal Sumsub resources.

About You:

  • 1+ year of experience in technical support, preferably for SaaS, web, or mobile applications. (L1 experience and a clear drive to grow into more technical work is welcome.)

  • Confident with web fundamentals: HTTP requests and status codes, REST APIs, JSON, and debugging network requests in the browser's developer console.

  • Able to read and write basic SQL queries to investigate data-related issues.

  • Understanding of how requests flow through web and mobile SDK integrations, from the client through to the backend - enough to narrow a problem down to the right layer.

  • A genuine, customer-first attitude: friendly, patient, and sincerely motivated to help.

  • Analytical mindset and the ability to stay oriented in a large, constantly changing flow of information.

Would be considered a plus:

  • Hands-on experience with Postman or similar tools for API troubleshooting.

  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g. Grafana, Kibana, Datadog).

  • Understanding of KYC/AML, identity verification, or fintech/compliance domains.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility.We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters.Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation.We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global.We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design.Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

The hiring stages:TA screening -> Hiring Manager Interview

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.



We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.
This role is open to candidates in multiple countries, and compensation differs based on the candidate’s confirmed work location. For this reason, a single universal salary range is not included in this job posting.

About Ardena

Ardena is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) and Contract Research Organization (CRO) supporting pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in developing complex and innovative medicines from discovery to market.

With more than 750 professionals across Europe and the United States, Ardena provides integrated services spanning drug substance and drug product development, GMP manufacturing, bioanalysis, nanomedicine, fill & finish, clinical logistics, and CMC regulatory support.

Our sites are located in Oss and Assen (the Netherlands), Ghent (Belgium), Pamplona (Spain), and Somerset (USA).

The Role

Ardena is looking for a Business Development Associate to support our commercial growth by identifying new opportunities, engaging prospective customers, and generating qualified meetings for our Business Development Directors.

This is a hands-on commercial role focused on prospecting, lead generation, account research, and opportunity creation within the biotech and pharmaceutical industry.

You will work closely with Business Development and Marketing teams to identify companies and development programs that could benefit from Ardena’s CRO/CDMO capabilities and turn those insights into meaningful commercial conversations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation: Identify and qualify prospective biotech and pharmaceutical customers, from early-stage companies to commercial organizations.

  • Outbound Prospecting: Engage prospects through structured email, LinkedIn, and digital outreach campaigns.

  • Program & Market Research: Track pipelines, funding rounds, clinical milestones, licensing deals, and outsourcing activities to uncover new opportunities.

  • Target Account Development: Build and maintain prioritized account and contact lists using commercial intelligence and prospecting tools.

  • Meeting Generation: Secure qualified introductory meetings for Ardena’s Business Development Directors.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Business Development Directors and Marketing to align target accounts, campaigns, events, and follow-up strategies.

  • Brand Awareness: Introduce Ardena and its integrated CRO/CDMO capabilities to new prospective customers.Qualifications & Experienc

    Qualifications & Experience

    Mandatory

    • 1-3 years of commercial experience in business development, sales development, lead generation, or a related role.

    • Degree in Life Sciences, Business, or a related field.

    • Proven experience in outbound prospecting using email, LinkedIn, and sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Closely, ZoomInfo, Lusha, or similar.

    • Proactive, persistent, and comfortable with prospecting and disciplined follow-up.

    • Strong research, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate within an international team.

    Preferred

    • Experience within the CRO/CDMO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.

    • Experience with CRM systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar.

    • Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or Perplexity for research and outreach.

    • Understanding of drug development, pharmaceutical outsourcing, CMC, bioanalysis, or related CRO/CDMO services.

    Candidates may come from a Life Sciences background with commercial experience or a Business/Marketing background with a strong interest in biotech and pharma.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently:

  • Generating qualified meetings and new commercial opportunities.

  • Executing effective and persistent prospecting campaigns.

  • Maintaining high-quality account intelligence and CRM data.

  • Expanding Ardena’s network and awareness across target biotech and pharmaceutical companies.

  • Contributing measurable opportunities to Ardena’s commercial pipeline.

What Ardena Offers

Ardena is a science-driven, people-focused organization where employees contribute to the development of medicines for patients worldwide.

We offer:

  • Full-time permanent contract.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package (€25,500–€30,000 gross annual salary).

  • Remote working from Spain within an international European and US team.

  • Professional development and training opportunities.

  • Exposure to innovative pharmaceutical and biotechnology programs.

  • Opportunities to develop your career within an international CRO/CDMO organization.

  • A collaborative culture guided by Ardena’s CARE values: Communicative, Accountable, Reliable, and Excellent.
